# Raw-backbone endpoint auxiliary screen — locked 2026-09-23

## Question and scope

Does explicit endpoint supervision improve raw three-class SwinUNETR, and does
additional actual-label completion help? This is a new auxiliary architecture,
not a reproduction of SegFix, PointRend, the prior renderer or a proven benefit.
The final inference operation is backbone(image).argmax(1). No rendering,
presence head, predicted interval fill, or labels enter inference.

Four folds (1–4), each 166 fitting / 42 inner / 52 outer; 208 distinct outer
cases from the same 260-case reused internal development pool. Original A
backbones have training seed 0. Continuation RNG is 3401 + fold, with explicit
matched epoch data seeds 3401 + fold + 1000 + epoch. Fold variation and head
randomness are not backbone-seed replication. This is a bounded screen;
independent backbone seed confirmation would require a separate subsequent run.
No new-cohort or clinical claim. No hyperparameter grid or tuning on outer labels.

## Common start and schedule

Start each fold from verified original A/best.pt of job 666174 (NOT E raw).
Original A optimizer states were pruned; restart AdamW identically, explicitly
making this a continuation experiment with optimizer restart. Backbone AdamW:
3e-5 LR, 1e-5 decay; head AdamW: 1e-3 LR, 1e-5 decay. Constant LR throughout
this short continuation, batch size 2 and the original deterministic dataset
preprocessing. Original runs allowed 50 epochs with early stopping; recent
continuation convention was six epochs at 3e-5. Here no arm stops early.

One shared fitting pass (83 backbone updates) prepares the head on detached
decoder features while the backbone follows original A's Dice+CE expression.
Save paired model, head, both optimizers/scalers, all RNGs and counters together.
All three branches restore that same state. Then six fitting passes per arm:
Restoration deep-copies both optimizer states: PyTorch can otherwise alias
already-on-device moment tensors and mutate the reusable common state while
training the first branch. Unit and real-GPU checks verify state isolation.
498 matched branch updates, 581 backbone updates including preparation.
The preparation pass is an initialization budget, NOT an anatomy readiness
threshold. Existing A provides established segmentation; per-batch actual
overlap is the sole activation/readiness rule. We make no evidence-based claim
that one pass makes the head accurate enough; head errors and raw outcomes test it.
No loss plateau, fixed 21–25 epoch activation, or inner/outer readiness tuning.

Arms: control (Dice+CE; head stays detached), endpoint (Dice+CE + endpoint
feature gradient), endpoint_completion (same + raw-voxel completion). The
completion coefficient is the ONLY prescribed difference between the two
auxiliary arms. Moving predictions naturally make their later eligibility differ.

## Representation, labels and routing

Input is the full 24-channel last decoder tensor captured before backbone.out,
over full 64-voxel z columns; no predicted crop, four-channel compression,
probability input, GT input or endpoint anchoring. Head: Conv3d(24,24,3,pad=1),
GELU, Conv3d(24,24,3,pad=1), GELU, Conv3d(24,2,1). 31,202 parameters. Local
5x5x5 receptive field, neighboring x/y context, two independent full-column
softmax distributions over z. No normalization couples ray statistics.
This small local score network does not claim global anatomical context beyond
the backbone representation and full-column softmax competition.

Endpoint target: first/last true foreground index. Exclude empty rays, rays
touching either z boundary, and true multi-run rays from endpoint supervision.
Log all exclusions, missed thin rays and actual overlapping ray counts.
Head optimizer always learns from ALL true geometrically valid fitting rays,
including rays the backbone misses, using features.detach().

Backbone endpoint loss is mean first/last categorical CE over geometrically
valid rays with at least one raw argmax foreground voxel at a TRUE foreground
position. Argmax and eligibility are detached. Mere wrong-location presence
does not qualify. A separate head forward uses detached head parameters;
feature gradients are masked at the input ray AND loss output ray, so a
noneligible neighbor supplies context but receives no direct feature gradient.
The head fit has no path to logits/backbone. Shared upstream parameters can
still change noneligible predictions; gating does NOT guarantee preservation.

Completion uses ALL true overlapping rays (including truncated and multi-run
rays since voxel labels remain valid). For each ray, separately mean three-class
CE over true foreground and actual background, equally average the nonempty
groups, then mean rays. Includes background gaps and surrounding background.
No endpoint-derived voxel targets. Zero eligible rays give differentiable zero;
missing foreground/background groups are omitted without NaNs. Whole-volume
Dice+CE continues to supervise missed rays and empty-ray FPs in every arm.

## Weights fixed by fitting-only calibration

After shared preparation, use exactly the first four fitting batches, FP32,
without optimizer updates; restore RNG afterward. Endpoint coefficient is 0.1
times median Dice+CE decoder-feature gradient RMS divided by median endpoint
decoder-feature gradient RMS. Completion coefficient uses the analogous ratio
at raw logits. The 0.1 target follows the existing calibration convention; its
suitability for this new task is NOT established. Fail if coefficient is nonfinite
or outside [1e-6,10], do not silently clip or tune. Freeze numerical coefficients
once per fold before branches. Ramp both auxiliary coefficients from 1/83 to
1 across the first continuation pass; thereafter constant. This ramp is an
optimization precaution, not a learned/readiness threshold. Head fit weight is
1 in its separate optimizer and has no effect on baseline AMP scaling/skips.

## Evaluation and selection locked before submission

Evaluate raw predictions only. Head endpoint MAE is diagnostic, never a selection
criterion. Inner metrics every epoch: ASSD (1 mm), union and class Dice, actual
thin overlap recall, thin voxel recall, FP rays/voxels, core recall (one 3D
binary erosion), true-voxel deletion/recovery relative to shared start and
matched control epoch, and endpoint errors/exclusion counts. Historical thin
recall definition is nonborder true span <=2; deletion audit additionally uses
one/two true voxels regardless of span. Keep these definitions explicit.

Control candidates must preserve shared-start Dice, both thin recalls, core
recall, FP rays and FP voxels (no worsening). Require zero newly deleted core
and count-thin true voxels, and total true deletions <= true recoveries.
Auxiliary candidates must satisfy these same guards against BOTH shared start
and the SAME-EPOCH control, and strictly improve ASSD against each. Select
minimum inner ASSD among eligible epochs; retain epoch 0 if none qualify.
These intentionally strict guards may reject every checkpoint. No post-hoc
relaxation. Fixed epoch-six results for all arms remain the main matched-update
comparison regardless of guard failure. Selected results are separately labeled
and may have different update counts; do not conflate them with fixed-epoch results.

Outer labels only compute reports after fixed training and inner selection;
they never change optimization, weights, readiness, selection or next fold's
settings. Report both fixed epoch-six and separately selected outcomes. Mask
banks used for paired deletion audits stay on cluster, with split/case records.
Only non-identifying aggregate JSON and job/test metadata may be downloaded.

## Integrity, storage and execution

Check dataset, split, original A checkpoints against recorded hashes, and frozen
source against provenance of job 666651. Record experiment/protocol hashes,
library version, argument settings and exact head parameter count. Resume checks
configuration and arm weights, restores paired state/RNG/counters, and skips

CUDA deterministic algorithms use warn-only mode because cluster PyTorch 2.12

"""Training-only endpoint supervision. Inference is always raw backbone logits."""
from __future__ import annotations

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class EndpointHead(nn.Module):
    """Full-resolution 24-channel decoder -> 24 -> 24 -> two z scores.

    Two 3x3x3 convolutions retain neighboring x/y and local z context. Softmax
    is over the entire z column, independently for first and last endpoints.
    No normalization mixes rays; no labels or predictions enter this module.
    """
    def __init__(self, channels=24, width=24):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv3d(channels, width, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Conv3d(width, width, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Conv3d(width, 2, 1),
        ])

    def forward(self, features, *, frozen_parameters=False):
        x = features
        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
            w = layer.weight.detach() if frozen_parameters else layer.weight
            b = layer.bias.detach() if frozen_parameters else layer.bias
            x = F.conv3d(x, w, b, padding=layer.padding)
            if i < 2:
                x = F.gelu(x)
        return x


@torch.no_grad()
def targets(labels, raw):
    y = labels[:, 0] if labels.ndim == 5 else labels
    fg = y > 0
    present = fg.any(-1)
    z = torch.arange(y.shape[-1], device=y.device)
    first = torch.where(fg, z, y.shape[-1]).amin(-1)
    last = torch.where(fg, z, -1).amax(-1)
    truncated = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (fg.sum(-1) < last - first + 1)
    geometric = present & ~truncated & ~multi
    overlap = ((raw.detach().argmax(1) > 0) & fg).any(-1)
    thin = present & ~truncated & (last - first + 1 <= 2)
    return dict(first=first.clamp(0, y.shape[-1]-1),
                last=last.clamp(0, y.shape[-1]-1), present=present,
                truncated=truncated, multi=multi, geometric=geometric,
                overlap=overlap, eligible=geometric & overlap, thin=thin)


def route_features(features, eligible):
    """Stop even contextual input gradients at noneligible ray locations.

    Shared upstream parameter updates can affect other predictions; this is a
    gradient-routing rule, not a guarantee of preserved voxel decisions.
    """
    mask = eligible[:, None, ..., None].to(features.dtype)
    return features.detach() + (features - features.detach()) * mask


def endpoint_loss(scores, target, selected):
    losses = []
    for channel, name in enumerate(("first", "last")):
        logp = scores[:, channel].float().log_softmax(-1)
        losses.append(-logp.gather(-1, target[name][..., None]).squeeze(-1))
    per_ray = (losses[0] + losses[1]) / 2
    return (per_ray * selected).sum() / selected.sum().clamp_min(1)


def completion_loss(raw, labels, selected):
    """Per-ray balanced three-class CE; preserves real gaps and background.

    Completion includes overlapping multi-run/truncated rays because it uses
    actual voxel labels, never an interval target. Missing groups are omitted.
    """
    y = (labels[:, 0] if labels.ndim == 5 else labels).long()
    ce = F.cross_entropy(raw.float(), y, reduction="none")
    fg = y > 0
    nf, nb = fg.sum(-1), (~fg).sum(-1)
    positive = (ce * fg).sum(-1) / nf.clamp_min(1)
    background = (ce * ~fg).sum(-1) / nb.clamp_min(1)
    groups = (nf > 0).int() + (nb > 0).int()
    per_ray = (positive + background) / groups.clamp_min(1)
    loss = (per_ray * selected).sum() / selected.sum().clamp_min(1)
    return loss


def losses(head, features, raw, labels, *, active):
    t = targets(labels, raw)
    # Head fitting uses ALL geometrically eligible true rays, including misses.
    detached_scores = head(features.detach())
    head_loss = endpoint_loss(detached_scores, t, t["geometric"])
    if active:
        # Separate path: frozen head parameters and only eligible outputs/inputs.
        scores = head(route_features(features, t["eligible"]), frozen_parameters=True)
        boundary = endpoint_loss(scores, t, t["eligible"])
    else:
        boundary = raw.float().sum() * 0
    completion = completion_loss(raw, labels, t["overlap"])
    with torch.no_grad():
        error = sum((detached_scores[:, i].argmax(-1) - t[k]).abs()
                    for i, k in enumerate(("first", "last"))) / 2
        stats = {name: int(t[name].sum()) for name in
                 ("present", "truncated", "multi", "geometric", "overlap", "eligible", "thin")}
        stats["thin_excluded_no_overlap"] = int((t["thin"] & ~t["overlap"]).sum())
        stats["geometric_missed"] = int((t["geometric"] & ~t["overlap"]).sum())
        stats["endpoint_absolute_error_sum"] = float((error * t["geometric"]).sum())
    return head_loss, boundary, completion, stats

"""Metric/hash helpers copied from the prior aggregate audit; no renderer."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt, label


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)

def geometry(truth):
    fg = np.asarray(truth) > 0
    z = np.arange(fg.shape[-1])
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    lower = np.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).min(-1)
    upper = np.where(fg, z, -1).max(-1)
    present = count > 0
    span = np.where(present, upper - lower + 1, 0)
    border = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (count < span)
    thin = present & (span <= 2) & ~border
    return dict(fg=fg, count=count, lower=lower, upper=upper, present=present,
                span=span, border=border, multi=multi, thin=thin)

def score(pred, truth, strata=None):
    """Match historical surface-voxel ASSD; additionally measure actual overlap."""
    p, g = pred > 0, geometry(truth)
    t = g["fg"]
    pr = p.any(-1)
    overlap = (p & t).any(-1)
    thin = g["thin"]
    nt = int(thin.sum())
    nvox = int(t[thin].sum())
    denom = int(p.sum() + t.sum())
    result = dict(union_dice=float(2 * (p & t).sum() / denom) if denom else 1.,
                  presence_fp=int((pr & ~g["present"]).sum()),
                  presence_fn=int((~pr & g["present"]).sum()),
                  fp_voxels=int((p & ~t).sum()), fn_voxels=int((~p & t).sum()),
                  signed_volume_error_vox=int(p.sum()) - int(t.sum()),
                  thin_rays=nt, thin_voxels=nvox,
                  thin_present=int((pr & thin).sum()),
                  thin_overlap_rays=int((overlap & thin).sum()),
                  thin_true_positive_voxels=int((p & t)[thin].sum()),
                  thin_presence_recall=float((pr & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_overlap_recall=float((overlap & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_voxel_recall=float((p & t)[thin].sum()/nvox) if nvox else None,
                  fp_components=int(label(p & ~t)[1]))
    for cls in (1, 2):
        pc, tc = pred == cls, truth == cls
        n = pc.sum() + tc.sum()
        result[f"class{cls}_dice"] = float(2*(pc & tc).sum()/n) if n else 1.
    pg = geometry(pred)
    both = pr & g["present"]
    errors = (abs(pg["lower"] - g["lower"]) + abs(pg["upper"] - g["upper"])) / 2
    result["conditional_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both].mean()) if both.any() else None
    result["conditional_thin_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both & thin].mean()) if (both & thin).any() else None
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        penalty = float(np.linalg.norm(pred.shape)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
        result.update(assd_mm=penalty, hd95_mm=penalty, p_to_t_mm=penalty, t_to_p_mm=penalty)
        for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
            result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = 0. if t.any() else None
        result["surface_contributions"] = {"empty_mask_penalty": penalty}
        return result
    ps, ts = p ^ binary_erosion(p), t ^ binary_erosion(t)
    pd = distance_transform_edt(~ts)[ps]
    td = distance_transform_edt(~ps)[ts]
    assd = (float(pd.mean()) + float(td.mean())) / 2
    result.update(assd_mm=assd, hd95_mm=float(np.percentile(np.r_[pd, td], 95)),
                  p_to_t_mm=float(pd.mean()), t_to_p_mm=float(td.mean()))
    for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
        result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = float((td <= tolerance).mean())
    if strata is not None:
        volume_strata = np.broadcast_to(strata[..., None], p.shape)
        p_names, t_names = volume_strata[ps], volume_strata[ts]
        contributions = {}
        for name in np.unique(strata):
            a = float(pd[p_names == name].sum() / len(pd) / 2)
            b = float(td[t_names == name].sum() / len(td) / 2)
            contributions[str(name)] = dict(p_to_t=a, t_to_p=b, total=a+b)
        if not np.isclose(sum(x["total"] for x in contributions.values()), assd, atol=1e-10):
            raise AssertionError("Surface contribution decomposition does not sum to ASSD")
        result["surface_contributions"] = contributions
    return result

            for key in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][key], (int, float)) or rows[0][key] is None
            if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in rows)}

def sample():

    raw = torch.zeros(1, 3, 5, 5, 8)
    raw[:, 0] = 2
    raw[0, 1, 1, 1, 3] = 4  # actual overlap
    raw[0, 1, 3, 3, 6] = 4  # wrong-location presence
    return y, raw.requires_grad_(), torch.randn(1, 24, 5, 5, 8, requires_grad=True)


def test_geometry_and_actual_overlap():
    y, raw, _ = sample()

    assert t["geometric"].sum() == 2

    y[0, 0, 2, 2, 0:3] = 1
    y[0, 0, 4, 4, [2, 4]] = 1
    t = targets(y, raw)
    assert t["truncated"].sum() == 1 and t["multi"].sum() == 1

class Tiny(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.feature = nn.Conv3d(1, 24, 1)
        self.out = nn.Conv3d(24, 3, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        feature = self.feature(x)
        return self.out(feature), feature


def train_tiny(model, head, opt, hopt, x, y, *, prepare=False, completion=None):
    raw, features = model(x)
    opt.zero_grad(); hopt.zero_grad()
    hloss, boundary, c, _ = losses(head, features, raw, y, active=not prepare)
    total = F.cross_entropy(raw, y[:, 0])
    if not prepare:
        total = total + .1 * boundary
        if completion is not None:
            total = total + completion * c
    total.backward(); opt.step()
    hloss.backward(); hopt.step()


def assert_same(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        assert a.keys() == b.keys()
        for k in a:
            assert_same(a[k], b[k])
    elif isinstance(a, (tuple, list)):
        assert len(a) == len(b)
        for x, y in zip(a, b):
            assert_same(x, y)
    elif torch.is_tensor(a):
        assert torch.equal(a, b)
    else:
        assert a == b


def test_preparation_preserves_baseline_optimizer_trajectory():

    x = torch.randn(1, 1, 5, 5, 8)
    a = Tiny(); b = copy.deepcopy(a); head = EndpointHead()
    ao = torch.optim.AdamW(a.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    bo = torch.optim.AdamW(b.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    ho = torch.optim.AdamW(head.parameters())
    for _ in range(3):
        ao.zero_grad(); raw, _ = a(x)
        F.cross_entropy(raw, y[:, 0]).backward(); ao.step()
        train_tiny(b, head, bo, ho, x, y, prepare=True)
    assert_same(a.state_dict(), b.state_dict())
    assert_same(ao.state_dict(), bo.state_dict())


def test_matched_arm_equivalence_with_zero_completion():
    y, _, _ = sample(); x = torch.randn(1, 1, 5, 5, 8)

    b, bh = copy.deepcopy(a), copy.deepcopy(ah)
    ao, bo = [torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters()) for m in (a, b)]

    assert_same(a.state_dict(), b.state_dict())

ARMS = ("control", "endpoint", "endpoint_completion")


def seed(value):
    random.seed(value)
    np.random.seed(value)
    torch.manual_seed(value)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(value)


def rng_state():
    return dict(python=random.getstate(), numpy=np.random.get_state(),
                torch=torch.get_rng_state(), cuda=torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()
                if torch.cuda.is_available() else [])


def restore_rng(state):
    random.setstate(state["python"])
    np.random.set_state(state["numpy"])
    torch.set_rng_state(state["torch"].cpu())
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all([x.cpu() for x in state["cuda"]])


def save_pt(path, state):
    # Atomic replacement; reserve includes the temporary copy of a checkpoint.
    if os.environ.get("HIPPO_REQUIRE_BEEGFS_QUOTA") == "1":
        from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import quota_guard
        quota_guard(2.0)
    temp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    torch.save(state, temp)
    temp.replace(path)


def snapshot(model, head, opt, hopt, scaler, hscaler, **metadata):
    return dict(model=model.state_dict(), head=head.state_dict(),
                optimizer=opt.state_dict(), head_optimizer=hopt.state_dict(),
                scaler=scaler.state_dict(), head_scaler=hscaler.state_dict(),
                rng=rng_state(), **metadata)


def restore(state, model, head, opt, hopt, scaler, hscaler):
    model.load_state_dict(state["model"])
    head.load_state_dict(state["head"])
    # Optimizer.load_state_dict can alias already-on-device state tensors.
    # Never allow a branch to mutate the reusable common checkpoint in memory.
    opt.load_state_dict(copy.deepcopy(state["optimizer"]))
    hopt.load_state_dict(copy.deepcopy(state["head_optimizer"]))
    scaler.load_state_dict(state["scaler"])
    hscaler.load_state_dict(state["head_scaler"])
    restore_rng(state["rng"])


def assert_state_equal(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        assert a.keys() == b.keys()
        for key in a:
            assert_state_equal(a[key], b[key])
    elif isinstance(a, (tuple, list)):
        assert len(a) == len(b)
        for x, y in zip(a, b):
            assert_state_equal(x, y)
    elif torch.is_tensor(a):
        assert torch.equal(a, b), "Reusable checkpoint tensor mutated"
    else:
        assert a == b


def make_models(api, device):
    model = api.FullModel(False, api.FunctionConfig()).to(device)
    # A does not normally capture decoder features: explicitly hook backbone.out.
    model.backbone.out.register_forward_pre_hook(model._capture)
    head = EndpointHead().to(device)
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=3e-5, weight_decay=1e-5)
    hopt = torch.optim.AdamW(head.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    scaler = torch.amp.GradScaler("cuda", enabled=device.type == "cuda")

def base_loss(loss_fn, raw, labels):
    # Exactly the original A expression and independent backbone scaler/optimizer.
    value = loss_fn(raw, labels)
    return (value + 0.5 * value) / 1.5


def train_epoch(api, objects, loader, loss_fn, device, arm, weights, epoch,
                counters, max_batches=None):
    model, head, opt, hopt, scaler, hscaler = objects
    model.train(); head.train()
    totals = []
    started = time.monotonic()
    active = arm != "control" and epoch > 0
    for step, batch in enumerate(loader):
        image, labels = api.plain(batch["image"], device), api.plain(batch["label"], device)
        opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True); hopt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=device.type == "cuda"):
            raw = model(image)["raw"]
            base = base_loss(loss_fn, raw, labels)
            hloss, boundary, completion, stats = losses(
                head, model.features, raw, labels, active=active)
            ramp = min(1., ((epoch-1)*len(loader)+step+1)/len(loader)) if active else 0.
            total = base
            if active:
                total = total + ramp * weights["endpoint"] * boundary
            if arm == "endpoint_completion":
                total = total + ramp * weights["completion"] * completion
        if not torch.isfinite(total) or not torch.isfinite(hloss):
            raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite training objective")
        # Fully separate scaling prevents head overflow from skipping baseline updates.
        old_scale = scaler.get_scale()
        scaler.scale(total).backward()
        scaler.step(opt); scaler.update()
        if scaler.get_scale() < old_scale:
            raise FloatingPointError("Backbone AMP skipped update; matched counts invalid")
        old_head_scale = hscaler.get_scale()
        hscaler.scale(hloss).backward()
        hscaler.step(hopt); hscaler.update()
        counters["backbone_updates"] += 1
        if hscaler.get_scale() >= old_head_scale:
            counters["head_updates"] += 1
        else:
            counters["head_skipped_updates"] = counters.get("head_skipped_updates", 0) + 1
        for key, value in stats.items():
            counters[key] = counters.get(key, 0) + value
        totals.append([float(x.detach()) for x in (base, hloss, boundary, completion)])
        if step == 0:
            print(json.dumps(dict(event="first_update", arm=arm, epoch=epoch,
                                  loss=totals[-1], counts=stats)), flush=True)
        if max_batches and step+1 >= max_batches:
            break
    return dict(loss_mean=np.mean(totals, axis=0).tolist(),
                batches=len(totals), seconds=time.monotonic()-started,
                counts=copy.deepcopy(counters))


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(api, model, head, loader, device, reference=None, matched=None):
    model.eval(); head.eval()
    rows, masks = [], []
    for index, batch in enumerate(loader):
        # Labels are used only AFTER raw inference, for metrics and audit strata.
        raw = model(api.plain(batch["image"], device))["raw"]
        pred = raw.argmax(1)[0].cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)
        truth = batch["label"][0, 0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
        row = score(pred, truth)
        core = binary_erosion(truth > 0)

        row["true_voxel_recall"] = float(((pred > 0) & (truth > 0)).sum()/max(1, (truth > 0).sum()))
        for name, bank in (("reference", reference), ("matched", matched)):
            if bank is None:

            old = bank[index] > 0
            new = pred > 0
            t = truth > 0
            thin = (t.sum(-1) > 0) & (t.sum(-1) <= 2)
            deleted = old & t & ~new
            row[name+"_deleted_true"] = int(deleted.sum())
            row[name+"_recovered_true"] = int((~old & t & new).sum())
            row[name+"_deleted_core"] = int((deleted & core).sum())
            row[name+"_deleted_thin"] = int(deleted[thin].sum())
        labels = api.plain(batch["label"], device)
        t = targets(labels, raw)
        scores = head(model.features)
        error = sum((scores[:, i].argmax(-1)-t[k]).abs()

        for name in ("geometric", "overlap", "eligible", "truncated", "multi"):

        row["thin_excluded_no_overlap"] = int((t["thin"] & ~t["overlap"]).sum())
        rows.append(row); masks.append(pred)
    return means(rows), np.stack(masks)

# Frozen comparison: whole-ray versus boundary-local pooling

Written before fitting. Hypothesis: whole-ray mean pooling discards useful local
boundary evidence and contributes to the strongly coupled corrections observed
in the prior audit. Boundary-local pooling may enable more selective corrections.
This comparison tests that specific intervention, not all pooling choices or
the general adequacy of the backbone.

Use exactly the four fitting cases per existing fold from job 666786: seven
distinct cases, 16 case/fold exposures. Three head-fitting seeds, two arms,
24 fits. No inner/outer evaluation, new data selection or checkpoint selection.
Original E and all prior checkpoints remain unchanged.

Both arms receive the same 13 renderer-state input channels and have width 24
and 8,185 trainable parameters. Both use the same two-layer spatial stem and
48-channel presence readout. The only intervention is the reduction over z:

- Mean: concatenate two copies of the whole-ray hidden-feature mean.
- Boundary: concatenate hidden features pooled around the frozen lower boundary
  and around the frozen upper boundary. Each pool uses weights proportional to
  `exp(-0.5*((z-boundary)/1.0)^2)`, normalized over the available z coordinates.
  Sigma is fixed at one voxel. Softmax computes normalization stably, including
  border cases. No label defines pool centers or weights.

The normalized weights are passed as two auxiliary tensor channels for caching
and batching; the convolutional stem sees only the original 13 feature channels.
The mean arm ignores the auxiliary weights. Both trainable and frozen initial
branches use their arm's pooling. Initial-branch subtraction must produce exact
zero correction and E's unchanged masks at initialization for both arms.

Copy identical original weights into the two arms. Preserve the previous
readout initialization: first 24-channel block contains the original weights,
the second block starts at zero and remains trainable. Thus the boundary arm
initially weights its lower pool in the readout while upper-block weights can
learn; do not add a symmetric initialization intervention. Identical initial
outputs do not imply identical parameter Jacobians. Pooling also changes feature
scales and optimization conditioning; outcomes do not isolate information
retention from those effects.

Keep the frozen geometry, beta, product renderer, +/-4 bounded correction,
interval targets, group normalization and 0.01 tie term unchanged. AdamW
lr=3e-4, weight_decay=0, default betas/epsilon; identical case permutations
between arms per seed. Exactly 1,024 case updates, with diagnostic checkpoints
at 0,128,512,1024. The final step is primary, without tuning sigma, learning rate,
strength or duration after results. The mean control is freshly fitted to avoid
relying on historical optimizer execution. Record any reproduction differences.

Report fitting loss versus the best constant and matched mean arm, correction
AUROC, thin overlap/voxel recall, union Dice, true-voxel recoveries/deletions and
both FP burdens. A fitting success requires increased thin overlap relative to
E, no decline in thin-voxel recall, and no increase in mean FP rays, FP voxels or
true deletions. Lower loss/AUC alone is insufficient. No ASSD improvement is
claimed in this fitting-only diagnostic. Report every fold/seed and all harms.

At each final head, run the unchanged loss-flow audit from job 666826. Verify
loss reconstruction; report subgroup contributions, activation gaps, bounded
correction derivatives, group-gradient cosines and local SGD responses. These
are diagnostics, not AdamW reconstructions. Poor numerical reconstruction must
not be interpreted as a reliable gradient direction.

Evidence favoring the pooling hypothesis requires improved actual selective
recovery alongside less coupled responses, not just less opposed gradients.
Equal or worse selective fitting weakens this particular pooling intervention.
Better fitting without validation does not establish generalization. An apparent
failure after 1,024 updates does not prove an intrinsic representational limit.

Tests must verify label-free, normalized and localized pools; initial equality;
identical parameter counts/weights; mean-control parity with the existing state
head; two-arm fitting/save and final-audit execution; and unchanged original
weights. Verify source, input and checkpoint hashes. Save new weights and any
individual records on the cluster. Export only non-identifying aggregates under
the user's explicit authorization for this investigation.

"""Matched fitting-only test of mean versus frozen boundary-local pooling."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

from common import digest,save_json,verify_inputs
from correction_control import bounded_delta,interval_loss
from renderer_state_overfit import RendererStateProbe,renderer_inputs,assess
from train_correction_control import frozen_model,get_loaders
from train_presence import collect,tensors
from audit_correction_discrimination import prepare_targets
from audit_overfit_loss_flow import audit_head

STEPS=(0,128,512,1024)
SIGMA=1.0


@torch.no_grad()
def pool_inputs(case):
    features=renderer_inputs(case,True)
    z=torch.arange(features.shape[-1],dtype=torch.float32)
    centres=torch.stack((case['lower'][0],case['upper'][0]),1).float()
    weights=(-.5*((z-centres[...,None])/SIGMA).square()).softmax(-1)
    assert torch.isfinite(weights).all()
    torch.testing.assert_close(weights.sum(-1),torch.ones_like(weights[...,0]))
    return torch.cat((features,weights),1)


class BoundaryPoolProbe(RendererStateProbe):
    def __init__(self,original,mode,seed=0):
        if mode not in ('mean','boundary'):
            raise ValueError(mode)
        super().__init__(original,seed)
        self.mode=mode

    def _residual(self,inputs,stem,presence):
        hidden=stem(inputs[:,:13])
        if self.mode=='mean':
            first=second=hidden.mean(-1)
        else:
            first=(hidden*inputs[:,13:14]).sum(-1)
            second=(hidden*inputs[:,14:15]).sum(-1)
        return presence(torch.cat((first,second),1)).squeeze(1)


def fit_one(original,cases,mode,seed,device,dest):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if device.type=='cuda':
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    probe=BoundaryPoolProbe(original,mode,seed).to(device)
    prepared=[dict(c,inputs=pool_inputs(c)) for c in cases]
    for case in prepared:
        with torch.no_grad():
            assert bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(case,device)).eq(0).all()
    optimizer=torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in probe.parameters() if p.requires_grad),lr=3e-4,weight_decay=0.)
    generator=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    history={'0':assess(probe,prepared,device)}
    step=0
    while step<STEPS[-1]:
        for index in generator.permutation(len(prepared)):
            case=prepared[int(index)]
            probe.train()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            delta=bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(case,device))
            target={k:v.to(device) for k,v in case['diagnostic_targets'].items()}
            loss=interval_loss(delta,target,tuple(g.to(device) for g in case['groups']))
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
                raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite pooling loss')
            loss.backward()
            if not all(torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in probe.parameters() if p.grad is not None):
                raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite pooling gradient')
            optimizer.step()
            step+=1
            if step in STEPS:
                history[str(step)]=assess(probe,prepared,device)
                print(json.dumps(dict(pooling=mode,seed=seed,step=step,
                    fit_loss=history[str(step)]['controls']['objective_learned'])),flush=True)
            if step==STEPS[-1]:
                break
    dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    save_json(dest/'history.json',history)
    torch.save(dict(state={k:v.detach().cpu() for k,v in probe.state_dict().items()},mode=mode,sigma=SIGMA),dest/'final.pt')
    saved_hash=digest(dest/'final.pt')
    final_audit=audit_head(probe,prepared,device)
    assert digest(dest/'final.pt')==saved_hash
    assert abs(final_audit['total_loss']-history[str(STEPS[-1])]['controls']['objective_learned'])<1e-5
    return dict(history=history,final_audit=final_audit,
                parameter_count=sum(p.numel() for p in probe.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                final_sha256=saved_hash)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('source','root','pkl','splits','reference','saved','output'):
        parser.add_argument('--'+name,type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    verify_inputs(args)
    ref=json.loads(args.reference.read_text())
    for name,sha in ref['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(args.source/name)==sha
    sys.path.insert(0,str(args.source))
    from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import plain
    device=torch.device('cuda')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    results={}
    for fold in (1,2,3,4):
        loader,_,_,split=get_loaders(args,fold)
        chosen=json.loads((args.saved/f'fold{fold}_subset.json').read_text())
        assert chosen==sorted(split['fit'])[:4]
        model=frozen_model(args,fold,device)
        original=copy.deepcopy(model.function.residual).cpu()
        cases=collect(model,(b for b in loader if str(b['case_name'][0]) in chosen),device,plain)
        assert {c['case'] for c in cases}==set(chosen)
        prepare_targets(cases,device)
        subset_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(chosen).encode()).hexdigest()
        for seed in (0,1,2):
            for mode in ('mean','boundary'):
                key=f'{mode}_fold{fold}_seed{seed}'
                result=fit_one(original,cases,mode,seed,device,args.output/key)
                results[key]=dict(fold=fold,seed=seed,mode=mode,fitting_cases=4,subset_sha256=subset_hash,**result)
                save_json(args.output/'aggregates.json',results)
        assert all(p.grad is None for p in model.parameters())
        del model,original,cases,loader
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    save_json(args.output/'DONE.json',dict(fits=len(results),inner_evaluated=False,outer_evaluated=False,
        source_sha256=ref['source_sha256'],experiment_sha256=digest(Path(__file__))))
    print('Completed 24 matched pooling fits and frozen-head diagnostics',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Paired hard-mask changes in fixed reference-surface strata.

Counts exact three-class corrections separately from foreground-union changes.
Reference strata are descriptive evaluation regions, never inference inputs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi


STRATA = ("boundary_0_to_1mm", "boundary_1_to_2mm",
          "interior_gt_beyond_2mm", "exterior_gt_beyond_2mm")
ERROR_NAMES = ("correct", "background_to_anterior", "background_to_posterior",
               "anterior_to_background", "posterior_to_background",
               "anterior_to_posterior", "posterior_to_anterior")
STRUCTURE = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1)


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def validate_mask(mask: np.ndarray) -> None:
    if mask.ndim != 3 or not mask.size or not np.isin(mask, (0, 1, 2)).all():
        raise ValueError("Expected a nonempty 3-D mask with labels 0, 1, 2")


def error_codes(truth: np.ndarray, prediction: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    table = np.array([[0, 1, 2], [3, 0, 5], [4, 6, 0]], dtype=np.uint8)
    return table[truth.astype(np.int64), prediction.astype(np.int64)]


def reference_strata(truth: np.ndarray, spacing=(1., 1., 1.)) -> dict:
    """Disjoint exhaustive regions using distance to inner surface voxel centers."""
    validate_mask(truth)
    if len(spacing) != 3 or not np.isfinite(spacing).all() or min(spacing) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Spacing must contain three positive finite millimeter values")
    foreground = truth > 0
    surface = foreground ^ ndi.binary_erosion(foreground, structure=STRUCTURE)
    distance = (ndi.distance_transform_edt(~surface, sampling=spacing)
                if surface.any() else np.full(truth.shape, np.inf))
    return dict(zip(STRATA, (distance <= 1, (distance > 1) & (distance <= 2),
                            foreground & (distance > 2), ~foreground & (distance > 2))))


def mask_metrics(pred: np.ndarray, truth: np.ndarray, spacing) -> dict:
    p, t = pred > 0, truth > 0
    def dice(a, b):
        n = int(a.sum() + b.sum())
        return float(2 * (a & b).sum() / n) if n else 1.
    values = {"union_dice": dice(p, t),
              "class1_dice": dice(pred == 1, truth == 1),
              "class2_dice": dice(pred == 2, truth == 2)}
    values["mean_class_dice"] = (values["class1_dice"] + values["class2_dice"]) / 2
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        assd = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(pred.shape) * spacing)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
    else:
        ps = p ^ ndi.binary_erosion(p, structure=STRUCTURE)
        ts = t ^ ndi.binary_erosion(t, structure=STRUCTURE)
        assd = (float(ndi.distance_transform_edt(~ts, sampling=spacing)[ps].mean())
                + float(ndi.distance_transform_edt(~ps, sampling=spacing)[ts].mean())) / 2
    values["assd_mm"] = assd
    return values


def transition_counts(matrix: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    """Rows are baseline error states; columns are candidate error states."""
    b, c = matrix.sum(1), matrix.sum(0)
    union_wrong, union_right = [1, 2, 3, 4], [0, 5, 6]
    out = {"voxel_count": int(matrix.sum()),
           "baseline_class_errors": int(b[1:].sum()), "candidate_class_errors": int(c[1:].sum()),
           "class_fixed": int(matrix[1:, 0].sum()), "class_broken": int(matrix[0, 1:].sum()),
           "wrong_label_changed": int(matrix[1:, 1:].sum() - np.trace(matrix[1:, 1:])),
           "union_fixed": int(matrix[np.ix_(union_wrong, union_right)].sum()),
           "union_broken": int(matrix[np.ix_(union_right, union_wrong)].sum()),
           "swap_fixed_exact": int(matrix[5:, 0].sum()),
           "swap_created_from_correct": int(matrix[0, 5:].sum()),
           "swap_to_missed_foreground": int(matrix[5:, 3:5].sum()),
           "missed_foreground_to_swap": int(matrix[3:5, 5:].sum())}
    for prefix, counts in (("baseline", b), ("candidate", c)):
        out.update({f"{prefix}_fp": int(counts[1:3].sum()),
                    f"{prefix}_fn": int(counts[3:5].sum()),
                    f"{prefix}_swaps": int(counts[5:].sum()),
                    f"{prefix}_union_errors": int(counts[1:5].sum())})
    out["net_class_errors"] = out["candidate_class_errors"] - out["baseline_class_errors"]
    out["net_union_errors"] = out["candidate_union_errors"] - out["baseline_union_errors"]
    assert out["net_class_errors"] == out["class_broken"] - out["class_fixed"]
    assert out["net_union_errors"] == out["union_broken"] - out["union_fixed"]
    return out


def audit_case(truth, baseline, candidate, *, case, fold=None, spacing=(1., 1., 1.)) -> dict:
    for mask in (truth, baseline, candidate):
        validate_mask(mask)
    if baseline.shape != truth.shape or candidate.shape != truth.shape:
        raise ValueError("Truth/baseline/candidate shapes must match")
    regions = reference_strata(truth, spacing)
    pair = error_codes(truth, baseline).astype(np.int16) * 7 + error_codes(truth, candidate)
    regions["all"] = np.ones(truth.shape, dtype=bool)
    strata = {}
    for name, region in regions.items():
        matrix = np.bincount(pair[region], minlength=49).reshape(7, 7)
        strata[name] = {**transition_counts(matrix), "transition_matrix": matrix.tolist()}
    assert np.array_equal(sum(np.asarray(strata[k]["transition_matrix"]) for k in STRATA),
                          np.asarray(strata["all"]["transition_matrix"]))
    return {"case": case, "fold": fold, "strata": strata,
            "baseline_metrics": mask_metrics(baseline, truth, spacing),
            "candidate_metrics": mask_metrics(candidate, truth, spacing)}


def paired_summary(values, samples=3000) -> dict:
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    means = np.array([rng.choice(values, len(values), replace=True).mean() for _ in range(samples)])
    return {"mean": float(values.mean()), "median": float(np.median(values)),
            "conditional_case_bootstrap_ci95": np.quantile(means, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
            "negative_cases": int((values < 0).sum()), "positive_cases": int((values > 0).sum()),
            "tied_cases": int((values == 0).sum())}


def summarize(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    if not rows or len({r["case"] for r in rows}) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("Expected nonempty unique case IDs; duplicate cases must not be pooled")
    metrics = {}
    for name in rows[0]["baseline_metrics"]:
        b = np.array([r["baseline_metrics"][name] for r in rows])
        c = np.array([r["candidate_metrics"][name] for r in rows])
        metrics[name] = {"baseline_mean": float(b.mean()), "candidate_mean": float(c.mean()),
                         "candidate_minus_baseline": paired_summary(c - b)}
    strata = {}
    for name in (*STRATA, "all"):
        matrix = sum(np.asarray(r["strata"][name]["transition_matrix"], dtype=np.int64) for r in rows)
        counts = transition_counts(matrix)
        strata[name] = {"pooled_counts": counts, "transition_matrix": matrix.tolist(),
                        "mean_counts_per_case": {k: v / len(rows) for k, v in counts.items()},
                        "net_class_errors": paired_summary([r["strata"][name]["net_class_errors"] for r in rows]),
                        "net_union_errors": paired_summary([r["strata"][name]["net_union_errors"] for r in rows])}
    return {"n_cases": len(rows), "metrics": metrics, "strata": strata}

                              "union_fixed": "wrong foreground/background assignment becomes correct, even if A/P swap remains",
                              "transition_order": ERROR_NAMES,

    flat = []

# Contextual boundary reconstruction — frozen diagnostic, 2026-09-23

Question: can neighboring boundary structure discriminate missing anatomy from
false foreground, beyond independent-ray prediction and ordinary smoothing?
This is a new head experiment, not another backbone continuation or a promotion
of a new segmentation model. User authorized the proposed reconstruction test.

## Scope and data

Use historical fold 1, original A backbone from job 666174, seed 0. Of its 166
fitting cases, split deterministically by SHA256('reconstruct-v1:'+case): first
32 for loss monitoring, remaining 134 for head training. Historical inner 42
cases form the final held development evaluation. Historical outer 52 do not
supply training or evaluation examples. No external or independent-seed confirmation is claimed;
this entire pool has been reused in earlier development.

Source, original checkpoint, dataset and split hashes must match corrected
experiment 666967's provenance. Apply identical source preprocessing. Original
multiclass truth becomes union foreground; this diagnostic does not model the
anterior/posterior boundary. Images/labels and baseline masks remain in RAM on
cluster; private split records and small final head weights stay on cluster.
Download only aggregate metrics, provenance without case IDs, and job metadata.

## Representation and explicit limitations

Each 64-voxel ray has 2,080 allowed discrete intervals L<=U and an empty state.
Network emits lower scores a[L], upper scores b[U], and empty score e. Interval
score is a[L]+b[U]-log(2080), jointly normalized with e. This is a factorized
ordered joint model, not an unrestricted arbitrary pair distribution. Exact
partition and voxel occupancy marginals use cumulative log-sum-exp in O(64).
Hard decoding selects the highest-scoring legal interval or empty state; it
does not threshold potentially multimodal occupancy marginals or average edges.
The current stage trains joint state likelihood, not a backbone/segmentation loss.

Audit multi-run and truncated true rays and false voxels introduced by naive
interval filling. Ignore occupied multi-run/truncated targets in head loss;
empty targets remain supervised. At inference, preserve any visibly multi-run
or border-touching INPUT ray exactly, identified without labels. All methods,
including the image-only head, share this exception fallback; therefore that
control is image-only for its learned input, not completely mask-free output.
Report whole-volume errors including exceptional rays; do not silently remove
them from evaluation. No oracle validity gate, foreground box or overlap gate
is used to select inference corrections. Fully missed thin rays are supervised.

## Four neural arms and two fixed baselines

Input: full binary z-column as 64 channels plus full normalized MRI z-column as
64 channels. No ground-truth feature at deployment. Geometry-only arms receive
zeros in image channels; image-only receives zeros in mask channels. Context
heads use a 1x1 stem of width 32, four residual 3x3 convolutions with dilation
1/2/4/8, GELU, and 1x1 output. This gives 31x31 cross-ray context in x/y and the
entire z-column, without compressing z by mean pooling. Spatial coordinates
are implicit in the fixed preprocessing; no registration/atlas is fitted.

- independent: pointwise convolutions, width 76, 43,145 parameters.
- context: geometry input only, width 32, 45,377 parameters.
- context_image: same context architecture and parameter count, MRI enabled.
- image_only: same context architecture, mask input zeroed.
- identity: retain damaged input or real baseline mask unchanged.
- smoothing: 3x3 majority occupancy and median lower/upper endpoints over
  occupied neighbors; preserve input exceptions. No fitted smoothing strength.

Independent/context parameter counts differ about 5%; context versus image
context has equal allocated size but different effective input capacity. Do not
attribute all differences solely to anatomical information. Image-only tests
whether apparent benefit can be obtained without learned boundary input.

## Corruption and optimization

Training cycles equally through clean input; complete deletion of an occupied
patch; local interval shift +/-1..3 voxels; deletion of thin patches; spurious
occupied patches near the footprint; and a mixed deletion/shift/addition.
Patch radius is 1..3 rays (spurious radius capped at 2). No corruption mask is
given to the model. Synthetic truth-derived inputs are denoising examples, not
evidence that true boundaries will be available at inference. Original arrays
are never mutated. Clean examples discourage gratuitous alterations.

All arms use exactly matched case order and corruption per head seed. Seeds
101 and 202, fixed 40 epochs, batch 8, AdamW lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5, gradient
norm cap 5. Full precision; no AMP skips. Final epoch is primary; no early
stopping, validation checkpoint selection or post-hoc extensions. Monitor loss
at epochs 1/10/20/30/40 on the 32 validation cases under fixed corruptions.
Head likelihood is averaged equally across nonempty groups: near-empty rays
(7x7 occupied dilation), far-empty, true thin (1–2 voxels), and other valid
occupied rays. Group labels are training targets only. No outer tuning.

## Final tests and interpretation

Evaluate all fixed final heads on the 42 held development cases, using clean
input once, each damaged condition under two new corruption seeds, and a
missing-patch stress condition of radius 6. Exposures are not independent cases.
Then evaluate actual frozen A predictions, with no synthetic corruption. The
real-error test is zero-shot transfer: no head trains on these predictions.
No backbone parameters or A/E reference files change.

Bend proxy: valid occupied neighboring rays with absolute second finite

"""Ordered discrete interval model; no GT-dependent inference gate."""
import math
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from scipy.ndimage import maximum_filter, median_filter

MODES = ('clean', 'missing_patch', 'shifted_boundary', 'thin_erode', 'spurious_patch', 'mixed')
ARMS = ('independent', 'context', 'context_image', 'image_only')

def geometry(mask):
    m=np.asarray(mask,dtype=bool); present=m.any(-1)
    lo=m.argmax(-1); hi=m.shape[-1]-1-m[...,::-1].argmax(-1)
    count=m.sum(-1); border=m[...,0]|m[...,-1]
    multi=present & (count != hi-lo+1)
    valid=present & ~border & ~multi
    return dict(present=present,lo=lo,hi=hi,count=count,border=border,multi=multi,valid=valid,thin=valid & (count<=2))

def interval_mask(lo,hi,present,zsize=64):
    z=np.arange(zsize)
    return present[...,None] & (z>=lo[...,None]) & (z<=hi[...,None])

def corruption(truth, mode, seed, stress=False):
    """Synthetic supervision only. Never called on real evaluation predictions."""
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); original=np.asarray(truth,dtype=bool)
    m=original.copy(); g=geometry(original)
    if mode=='clean': return m
    if mode=='mixed':
        for i,k in enumerate(('missing_patch','shifted_boundary','spurious_patch')):
            m=corruption(m,k,seed+1009*(i+1),stress)
        return m
    candidates=np.argwhere(g['thin'] if mode=='thin_erode' else g['valid'])
    if not len(candidates): return m
    x,y=candidates[rng.integers(len(candidates))]
    r=6 if stress else int(rng.integers(1,4))
    xx,yy=np.indices(g['present'].shape)
    patch=(abs(xx-x)<=r)&(abs(yy-y)<=r)
    if mode=='missing_patch': m[patch & g['valid']]=False
    elif mode=='thin_erode':
        # Remove several small true thin patches, including complete misses.
        for _ in range(3):
            x,y=candidates[rng.integers(len(candidates))]
            patch=(abs(xx-x)<=r)&(abs(yy-y)<=r)
            m[patch & g['thin']]=False
    elif mode=='shifted_boundary':
        delta=int(rng.choice((-3,-2,-1,1,2,3)))
        lo=np.clip(g['lo']+delta,1,62); hi=np.clip(g['hi']+delta,1,62)
        proposal=interval_mask(lo,hi,g['present'])
        m[patch & g['valid']]=proposal[patch & g['valid']]
    elif mode=='spurious_patch':
        near=maximum_filter(g['present'],size=9)&~g['present']
        empty=np.argwhere(near)
        if not len(empty): return m
        ex,ey=empty[rng.integers(len(empty))]
        nearest=candidates[np.argmin(((candidates-(ex,ey))**2).sum(1))]
        lx,ly=nearest; lo,hi=int(g['lo'][lx,ly]),int(g['hi'][lx,ly])
        patch=(abs(xx-ex)<=min(r,2))&(abs(yy-ey)<=min(r,2))&~g['present']
        m[patch]=interval_mask(np.full_like(xx,lo),np.full_like(xx,hi),patch)[patch]
    else: raise ValueError(mode)
    return m

def smooth(mask):
    g=geometry(mask)
    pres=median_filter(g['present'].astype(np.uint8),size=3)>0
    # Median endpoints only from occupied neighbors; empty rays do not supply zero coordinates.
    lo=np.where(g['present'],g['lo'],np.nan); hi=np.where(g['present'],g['hi'],np.nan)
    from scipy.ndimage import generic_filter
    def median(v):
        v=v[np.isfinite(v)]
        return np.median(v) if len(v) else 0.
    l=generic_filter(lo.astype(float),median,size=3,mode='nearest')
    u=generic_filter(hi.astype(float),median,size=3,mode='nearest')
    pred=interval_mask(np.rint(l),np.rint(u),pres)
    protected=g['multi']|g['border']
    pred[protected]=mask[protected]
    return pred

class IntervalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,arm,z=64):
        super().__init__(); self.arm=arm; self.z=z
        width=76 if arm=='independent' else 32
        self.stem=nn.Conv2d(2*z,width,1)
        self.layers=nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(width,width,1 if arm=='independent' else 3,
                                dilation=1 if arm=='independent' else d,
                                padding=0 if arm=='independent' else d) for d in (1,2,4,8)])
        self.out=nn.Conv2d(width,2*z+1,1)
    def forward(self,mask,image):
        mask=mask.float().permute(0,3,1,2); image=image.float().permute(0,3,1,2)
        if self.arm=='image_only': mask=mask*0
        if self.arm not in ('image_only','context_image'): image=image*0
        x=F.gelu(self.stem(torch.cat((mask,image),1)))
        for layer in self.layers: x=x+F.gelu(layer(x))
        return self.out(x).permute(0,2,3,1)

def distribution(logits):
    """P(empty), P(L,U) with L<=U. Exact partition in O(Z), not endpoint means."""
    z=(logits.shape[-1]-1)//2
    a,b,e=logits[...,:z],logits[...,z:2*z],logits[...,-1]
    prior=math.log(z*(z+1)/2)
    prefix=torch.logcumsumexp(a,-1)
    log_intervals=torch.logsumexp(prefix+b,-1)-prior
    norm=torch.logaddexp(e,log_intervals)
    return a,b,e,norm,prior

def occupancy(logits):
    a,b,e,norm,prior=distribution(logits)
    left=torch.logcumsumexp(a,-1)
    right=torch.logcumsumexp(b.flip(-1),-1).flip(-1)
    return (left+right-prior-norm[...,None]).exp()

def objective(logits,truth):
    a,b,e,norm,prior=distribution(logits); z=a.shape[-1]
    t=truth.bool(); pres=t.any(-1)
    lo=t.long().argmax(-1); hi=z-1-t.flip(-1).long().argmax(-1)
    count=t.sum(-1); valid=pres & ~t[...,0] & ~t[...,-1] & (count==hi-lo+1)
    target=a.gather(-1,lo[...,None]).squeeze(-1)+b.gather(-1,hi[...,None]).squeeze(-1)-prior
    nll=norm-torch.where(pres,target,e)
    near=F.max_pool2d(pres.float()[:,None],7,stride=1,padding=3)[:,0]>0
    groups=(~pres & near,~pres & ~near,valid & (count<=2),valid & (count>2))
    terms=[nll[g].mean() for g in groups if g.any()]
    return torch.stack(terms).mean()

@torch.no_grad()
def decode(logits,source_mask):
    a,b,e,norm,prior=distribution(logits)
    prefix,indices=torch.cummax(a,-1)
    score,hi=(prefix+b-prior).max(-1)
    lo=indices.gather(-1,hi[...,None]).squeeze(-1)
    z=torch.arange(a.shape[-1],device=a.device)
    pred=(score>e)[...,None] & (z>=lo[...,None]) & (z<=hi[...,None])
    # Visible multi-run/truncated input rays retain their exact input occupancy.
    # This exception is inferred from input only, never from evaluation labels.
    s=source_mask.bool(); sp=s.any(-1)
    sl=s.long().argmax(-1); su=s.shape[-1]-1-s.flip(-1).long().argmax(-1)
    invalid=s[...,0]|s[...,-1]|(sp & (s.sum(-1)!=su-sl+1))
    return torch.where(invalid[...,None],s,pred)

import argparse, hashlib, json, os, random, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion
from model import ARMS, MODES, IntervalNet, corruption, geometry, interval_mask, smooth, objective, decode, occupancy

ROOT=Path('/home/3160552')
SOURCE=ROOT/'function_head_robustness_20260922'
PREVIOUS=ROOT/'boundary_auxiliary_20260923_34d3_v4'

def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def save(path,value):
    tmp=path.with_suffix('.tmp'); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n'); tmp.replace(path)
def seed(n): random.seed(n); np.random.seed(n); torch.manual_seed(n); torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(n)
def tensor(a,device): return torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(a),device=device)

def metric(pred,truth,source,score):
    p=pred.astype(bool); t=truth.astype(bool); old=source.astype(bool)
    row=score(p.astype(np.uint8),t.astype(np.uint8))
    row={k:float(v) for k,v in row.items() if isinstance(v,(float,int))}
    core=binary_erosion(t); deleted=old&t&~p; recovered=~old&t&p
    g=geometry(t); gp=geometry(p); gs=geometry(old)
    curvature=np.zeros(g['present'].shape,dtype=bool)
    for axis in (0,1):
        good=g['valid'] & np.roll(g['valid'],1,axis) & np.roll(g['valid'],-1,axis)
        for field in ('lo','hi'):
            v=g[field].astype(float)
            curvature |= good & (abs(np.roll(v,1,axis)+np.roll(v,-1,axis)-2*v)>=2)
    curvature[[0,-1],:]=False; curvature[:,[0,-1]]=False
    thin=g['thin']; before=(old&t).any(-1); after=(p&t).any(-1)
    row.update(deleted_true=float(deleted.sum()),recovered_true=float(recovered.sum()),
               deleted_core=float((deleted&core).sum()),deleted_thin=float(deleted[thin].sum()),
               deleted_bend_true=float(deleted[curvature].sum()),
               recovered_missing_thin_rays=float((thin&~before&after).sum()),
               broken_correct_thin_rays=float((thin&before&~after).sum()),
               source_missing_thin_rays=float((thin&~before).sum()),
               core_recall=float((p&core).sum()/max(1,core.sum())),
               changed_voxels=float((p!=old).sum()))
    both=g['valid']&gp['present']
    row['endpoint_mae_valid_present']=float((abs(gp['lo'][both]-g['lo'][both])+abs(gp['hi'][both]-g['hi'][both])).mean()/2) if both.any() else None
    return row

def average(rows):
    keys=set().union(*(r.keys() for r in rows))
    return {k:float(np.mean([r[k] for r in rows if r.get(k) is not None])) for k in sorted(keys) if any(r.get(k) is not None for r in rows)}

def corruption_seed(stage,repeat,index,mode):
    return stage+100000*repeat+100*index+MODES.index(mode)

@torch.no_grad()
def loss_eval(model,cases,device):
    values=[]; model.eval()
    for i,c in enumerate(cases):
        mode=MODES[i%len(MODES)]
        m=corruption(c['truth'],mode,corruption_seed(700000,0,i,mode))
        logits=model(tensor(m[None],device),tensor(c['image'][None],device))
        values.append(float(objective(logits,tensor(c['truth'][None],device))))
    return float(np.mean(values))

def train(arm,runseed,cases,val,device,output,smoke):
    seed(runseed); model=IntervalNet(arm).to(device)
    opt=torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(),lr=1e-3,weight_decay=1e-5)
    history=[]; epochs=1 if smoke else 40; started=time.monotonic()
    for epoch in range(1,epochs+1):
        order=np.random.default_rng(880000+runseed*100+epoch).permutation(len(cases))
        model.train(); losses=[]
        for offset in range(0,len(order),8):
            ids=order[offset:offset+8]; cs=[cases[i] for i in ids]
            masks=[]
            for i,c in zip(ids,cs):
                mode=MODES[(int(i)+epoch)%len(MODES)]
                # Identical case order and corruption across arms within each seed.
                masks.append(corruption(c['truth'],mode,corruption_seed(900000+runseed*1000000,epoch,int(i),mode)))
            opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            logits=model(tensor(np.stack(masks),device),tensor(np.stack([c['image'] for c in cs]),device))
            loss=objective(logits,tensor(np.stack([c['truth'] for c in cs]),device))
            if not torch.isfinite(loss): raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite reconstruction loss')
            loss.backward(); torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(),5.); opt.step(); losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
            if smoke: break
        if epoch==1 or epoch%10==0:
            record=dict(arm=arm,seed=runseed,epoch=epoch,train_loss=float(np.mean(losses)),validation_loss=loss_eval(model,val[:2] if smoke else val,device),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
            history.append(record); print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
            save(output/f'history_{arm}_{runseed}.json',history)
    path=output/f'{arm}_{runseed}.pt'
    from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import quota_guard
    quota_guard(2.)
    torch.save(dict(model=model.state_dict(),arm=arm,seed=runseed,epoch=epochs),path)
    return model,dict(arm=arm,seed=runseed,epochs=epochs,parameter_count=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),checkpoint_sha256=sha(path),history=history)

@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(model,arm,cases,real,device,score,smoke):
    if model is not None: model.eval()
    result={}; repeats=1 if smoke else 2
    conditions=list(MODES)+['missing_patch_stress','real_baseline']
    for condition in conditions:
        rows=[]
        for repeat in range(1 if condition in ('clean','real_baseline') else repeats):
            for i,c in enumerate(cases):
                if condition=='real_baseline': m=real[i]
                else:
                    mode='missing_patch' if condition=='missing_patch_stress' else condition
                    m=corruption(c['truth'],mode,corruption_seed(12000000,repeat,i,mode),stress=condition=='missing_patch_stress')
                if arm=='identity': p=m
                elif arm=='smoothing': p=smooth(m)
                else:
                    logits=model(tensor(m[None],device),tensor(c['image'][None],device))
                    p=decode(logits,tensor(m[None],device))[0].cpu().numpy()
                rows.append(metric(p,c['truth'],m,score))
        result[condition]=dict(case_exposures=len(rows),distinct_cases=len(cases),means=average(rows))
    return result

def test_joint_partition_and_occupancy_match_enumeration():
    torch.manual_seed(1); x=torch.randn(2,3,4,11,dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
    a,b,e,norm,prior=distribution(x); states=[(l,u) for l in range(5) for u in range(l,5)]
    scores=torch.stack([e]+[a[...,l]+b[...,u]-prior for l,u in states],-1)
    assert torch.allclose(norm,torch.logsumexp(scores,-1))
    probs=scores.softmax(-1)
    exact=torch.stack([sum(probs[...,i+1] for i,(l,u) in enumerate(states) if l<=z<=u) for z in range(5)],-1)
    assert torch.allclose(occupancy(x),exact)
    occupancy(x).sum().backward(); assert torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()

    torch.manual_seed(2); m=torch.rand(1,9,9,8,requires_grad=True); im=torch.rand_like(m)
    net=IntervalNet('independent',8); net(m,im)[0,4,4].sum().backward()
    grad=m.grad.clone(); grad[0,4,4]=0; assert grad.abs().sum()==0
    net=IntervalNet('context',8); m.grad=None; net(m,im)[0,4,4].sum().backward()
    grad=m.grad.clone(); grad[0,4,4]=0; assert grad.abs().sum()>0

def test_image_and_geometry_ablation_inputs():
    torch.manual_seed(3); m=torch.rand(1,7,7,8); im=torch.rand_like(m)
    net=IntervalNet('context',8); assert torch.equal(net(m,im),net(m,im*0))
    net=IntervalNet('image_only',8); assert torch.equal(net(m,im),net(m*0,im))
    net=IntervalNet('context_image',8); assert not torch.equal(net(m,im),net(m,im*0))

def test_corruption_reproducible_and_nonmutating():
    t=np.zeros((64,64,64),bool); t[20:40,20:40,20:30]=True; t[18:20,20:40,24:26]=True
    original=t.copy()
    for mode in MODES:
        p=corruption(t,mode,3); assert np.array_equal(p,corruption(t,mode,3))
        assert np.array_equal(t,original)
        if mode=='clean': assert np.array_equal(p,t)
        else: assert not np.array_equal(p,t)

def test_loss_supervises_missed_thin_and_empty_rays():
    x=torch.zeros(1,8,8,17,requires_grad=True); t=torch.zeros(1,8,8,8,dtype=torch.bool); t[0,4,4,3]=True
    loss=objective(x,t); loss.backward()
    assert torch.isfinite(loss) and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()
    assert x.grad[0,4,4,3]<0 and x.grad[0,4,4,11]<0
    assert x.grad[0,4,4,-1]>0 and x.grad[0,0,0,-1]<0

# Residual translation sensitivity after augmentation

Use the four frozen pilot selected models, starting with augmented Dice. Identity plus the existing12 integer shifts(±1,±2 along each axis), inverse-mapped with valid-view probability averaging. Three-class argmax throughout. No target, predicted component selection, or validation-tuned parameter enters prediction. Score all50training/52validation cases; retain paired corrections/regressions and per-view disagreement. Record any cropped nonzero input or foreground and distinguish complete-support cases from those with clipping.

This exact input-coordinate intervention tests residual translation dependence under a fixed checkpoint. TTA improvement is an inference remedy, not evidence that a new constraint has been learned. Positive results require additional checkpoint/seed confirmation, starting with existing augmented reference models if compatible. A negative result argues against this specific residual-translation remedy; it cannot establish a noise floor.

Original inference runtime, frozen source, data/split/checkpoint hashes verified. Identity repeat measured against the original audit. No new training or persistent dense prediction caches. This is an evidence-driven follow-up to the historical unaugmented13-viewTTA benefit; that earlier result cannot establish a benefit after mild augmentation.

"""Exact integer-translation intervention on frozen selected models."""
import argparse
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import os
import sys


def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p,x):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--pilot',type=Path,required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--arms',nargs='+',default=['dice_aug','sum_aug','dice','sum'])
    ap.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=0)
    args=ap.parse_args();args.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    src=args.pilot/'source'
    for name,h in read(src/'PAYLOAD.json')['files'].items():assert sha(src/name)==h
    sys.path[:0]=[str(src),str(src/'scripts')]
    import torch
    import numpy as np
    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
    from train_boundary_causal import spatial_metrics
    from train_separated_edge import build_model,objectives
    from train_pcgrad_50cases import loaders
    from audit_edge_coherence import geometry
    from thesis.new_constraints import train_swinunetr_constraints as trainer
    from thesis.new_constraints.equivariance import translate_3d,restore_translation,translation_valid_mask
    from thesis.new_constraints.teacher.translation_teacher import DEFAULT_TEACHER_SHIFTS
    torch.set_num_threads(4);device=torch.device('cuda');assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    bindings=[]
    for arm in args.arms:
        folder=args.pilot/f'seed{args.seed}'/arm;config=read(folder/'config.json');done=read(folder/'completion.json')
        assert done['status']=='complete' and config['run']==done['run']
        assert sha(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt')==done['checkpoint_sha256']
        assert sha(folder/'selected_cases.json')==done['selected_cases_sha256']
        for k in ('pkl','splits_json'):assert sha(config[k])==config[k+'_sha256']
        assert trainer.collect_runtime_provenance()==config['runtime_provenance']
        trainer.validate_calibration_execution(config['execution_provenance'],trainer.collect_execution_provenance(device),allow_mig_profile_change=True)
        trainer.seed_everything(config['run']['seed'])
        train,val,_,_=loaders(config)
        cp=torch.load(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
        assert cp['epoch']==done['selected_epoch'] and cp['run']==config['run']
        model=build_model(config,device);model.load_state_dict(cp['model'],strict=True);model.eval();del cp
        _,obj=objectives(config)
        old={(r['split'],r['case_name']):r['metrics'] for r in read(folder/'selected_cases.json')}
        rows=[]
        for split,loader in [('train',DataLoader(train.dataset,batch_size=1,shuffle=False)),('validation',val)]:
            for batch in loader:
                image=batch['image'].to(device);label=batch['label'].to(device)
                truth=batch['label'][0,0].numpy().astype(np.uint8);y,inner,outer=geometry(truth);shell=inner|outer
                ap_faces=0
                ap_endpoints=np.zeros_like(y)
                outer_endpoints=np.zeros_like(y)
                for axis in range(3):
                    a=[slice(None)]*3;b=a.copy();a[axis]=slice(None,-1);b[axis]=slice(1,None);a,b=tuple(a),tuple(b)
                    am=(truth[a]>0)&(truth[b]>0)&(truth[a]!=truth[b]);om=y[a]!=y[b]
                    ap_faces+=int(am.sum())
                    ap_endpoints[a]|=am;ap_endpoints[b]|=am;outer_endpoints[a]|=om;outer_endpoints[b]|=om
                gt_geometry=dict(label_sha256=hashlib.sha256(truth.tobytes()).hexdigest(),ap_faces=ap_faces,
                    ap_endpoints=int(ap_endpoints.sum()),outer_endpoints=int(outer_endpoints.sum()))
                with torch.inference_mode(),torch.autocast('cuda',enabled=True):base_logits=model(image)
                base_p=base_logits.float().softmax(1)
                probability_sum=base_p.clone();counts=torch.ones_like(base_p[:,:1]);views=[]
                base_pred=base_p[0].argmax(0).cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)
                for shift in DEFAULT_TEACHER_SHIFTS:
                    valid=translation_valid_mask(image.shape[-3:],shift,device=device)
                    # Record clipping; the intervention does not use GT to select a view.
                    lost_input_voxels=int(((image!=0)&~valid.bool()).sum())
                    lost_gt_voxels=int(((label>0)&~valid.bool()).sum())
                    with torch.inference_mode(),torch.autocast('cuda',enabled=True):z=model(translate_3d(image,shift))
                    aligned=restore_translation(z.float().softmax(1),shift)
                    probability_sum.add_(aligned*valid);counts.add_(valid)
                    h=aligned[0].argmax(0).cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8);v=valid[0,0].cpu().numpy().astype(bool)
                    views.append(dict(shift=list(shift),lost_input_nonzero_voxels=lost_input_voxels,
                        lost_gt_foreground_voxels=lost_gt_voxels,
                        boundary_union_disagreement_voxels=int(((h>0)!=(base_pred>0))[shell&v].sum()),
                        common_union_errors=int(((h>0)!=y)[shell&v].sum()),
                        identity_common_union_errors=int(((base_pred>0)!=y)[shell&v].sum())))
                ensemble=probability_sum/counts
                assert torch.allclose(ensemble.sum(1),torch.ones_like(ensemble[:,0]),atol=2e-6)
                pp=[base_p[0].cpu().numpy(),ensemble[0].cpu().numpy()]
                mm=[]
                for q in pp:
                    pred=q.argmax(0).astype(np.uint8);m=spatial_metrics(q,pred,truth)
                    with torch.inference_mode():b=obj.bands(torch.from_numpy(np.log(q.clip(1e-30)))[None].to(device),label)
                    m.update(bands_bce=float(b.details['case_loss'][0]),bands_truth=float(b.truth[0]))
                    mm.append(m)
                ensemble_pred=pp[1].argmax(0)
                a=(base_pred>0)!=y;b=(ensemble_pred>0)!=y
                transitions=dict(shell_errors_corrected=int((a&~b&shell).sum()),
                    shell_errors_introduced=int((~a&b&shell).sum()))
                assert transitions['shell_errors_corrected']-transitions['shell_errors_introduced']==mm[0]['boundary_union_errors']-mm[1]['boundary_union_errors']
                name=str(batch['case_name'][0])
                rows.append(dict(split=split,case_name=name,identity=mm[0],tta13=mm[1],views=views,
                    gt_geometry=gt_geometry,
                    transitions=transitions,identity_drift={k:mm[0][k]-old[split,name][k] for k in ['macro_dice','all_fp','all_fn','boundary_union_errors']}))
            save(args.out/f'{arm}.json',dict(arm=arm,seed=args.seed,selected_epoch=done['selected_epoch'],cases=rows))
            print(json.dumps(dict(arm=arm,split=split,cases=len(rows))),flush=True)
        assert sha(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt')==done['checkpoint_sha256']
        bindings.append(dict(arm=arm,seed=args.seed,checkpoint_sha256=done['checkpoint_sha256'],selected_epoch=done['selected_epoch']))
        del model,obj;torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    save(args.out/'completion.json',dict(status='complete',training=False,job_id=os.getenv('SLURM_JOB_ID'),
        model_bindings=bindings,script_sha256=sha(__file__),source_manifest_sha256=sha(src/'PAYLOAD.json'),
        shifts=[list(s) for s in DEFAULT_TEACHER_SHIFTS],view_policy='identity plus fixed12integer shifts; equal valid-view probability average; no GT used for prediction'))


if __name__=='__main__':main()

Compare original E, a selected scalar-bias control, a residual head trained with
balanced existence BCE, and an identical residual head trained with correction

beta. Fit 24 heads: two objectives x three head-fitting seeds x four folds.

The residual acts only in rendering, not in fitting geometry. The correction

Bound the residual to +/-4 logits with 4*tanh(residual/4). Original E is
reproduced exactly at initialization, checked on every inner case. Geometry,
temperature 0.5, product occupancy and beta are identical in all arms.

## Fitting target and loss

Use 166 fitting cases per fold; 42 inner cases select checkpoints; 52 outer
cases per fold remain unevaluated until every one of the 24 selections is locked.
Use the existing source split and preprocessing, inner seed 0.

For fitting rays, retain all currently correct foreground union voxels and all

allowed residual interval within [-4,4]. Use 24 iterations and a 0.001-logit
inward safety margin on finite activation boundaries. Match the actual
float32 renderer and background-wins-ties argmax operation order.

The target action is the projection of zero onto a feasible interval. For
incompatible or numerically unsafe constraints, the target is zero/no change.

multi-run rays without assuming that their intervals are feasible. Record
feasibility and missed-ray counts by stratum. Empty foreground and beta=0 are
handled by the same explicit decision predicates.

For feasible rays, loss is squared distance outside the interval plus
0.01*(residual-target_action)^2. The second term favors the smallest valid edit;
it does not penalize distance to zero when zero would fail the rescue target.
For infeasible rays, loss is residual^2. Average within each nonempty fixed
group (thin, other true, hard empty, other empty), then equally across groups.

per seed across objectives. Twelve epochs, one full cached case per step,
float32 AdamW lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-5, default betas/eps, no scheduler,
