"""Auditable helpers shared by the presence mechanism experiments."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt, label


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def geometry(truth):
    fg = np.asarray(truth) > 0
    z = np.arange(fg.shape[-1])
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    lower = np.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).min(-1)
    upper = np.where(fg, z, -1).max(-1)
    present = count > 0
    span = np.where(present, upper - lower + 1, 0)
    border = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (count < span)
    thin = present & (span <= 2) & ~border
    return dict(fg=fg, count=count, lower=lower, upper=upper, present=present,
                span=span, border=border, multi=multi, thin=thin)


def render(raw, lower, upper, log_presence, beta, mode="product", tau=0.5):
    """Original log-space renderer, also usable with detached geometry."""
    z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    if mode == "product":
        log_o = (log_presence[..., None]
                 + F.logsigmoid((z - lower[..., None] + .5) / tau)
                 + F.logsigmoid((upper[..., None] - z + .5) / tau))
    elif mode == "distance":
        centre, radius = (upper + lower) / 2, (upper - lower + 1) / 2
        log_o = log_presence[..., None] + F.logsigmoid(
            (radius[..., None] - (z - centre[..., None]).abs()) / tau)
    else:
        raise ValueError(mode)
    logit_o = log_o - torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
    shift = 6 * torch.tanh(logit_o / 6)
    return torch.cat(((raw[:, 0] - beta * shift)[:, None], raw[:, 1:]), 1)


def mask(logits):
    return logits.argmax(1)[0].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)


def ray_strata(truth, original_e):
    g = geometry(truth)
    s = np.full(g["present"].shape, "empty", dtype="U32")
    s[g["span"] == 1] = "thin1"
    s[g["span"] == 2] = "thin2"
    s[(g["span"] >= 3) & (g["span"] <= 5)] = "length3_5"
    s[g["span"] >= 6] = "length6plus"
    s[g["multi"]] = "multi_run"
    s[g["border"]] = "border"
    present_e = (original_e > 0).any(-1)
    for name in ("thin1", "thin2", "length3_5", "length6plus", "multi_run", "border"):
        chosen = s == name
        s[chosen & present_e] = name + "_E_present"
        s[chosen & ~present_e] = name + "_E_missed"
    return s


def score(pred, truth, strata=None):
    """Match historical surface-voxel ASSD; additionally measure actual overlap."""
    p, g = pred > 0, geometry(truth)
    t = g["fg"]
    pr = p.any(-1)
    overlap = (p & t).any(-1)
    thin = g["thin"]
    nt = int(thin.sum())
    nvox = int(t[thin].sum())
    denom = int(p.sum() + t.sum())
    result = dict(union_dice=float(2 * (p & t).sum() / denom) if denom else 1.,
                  presence_fp=int((pr & ~g["present"]).sum()),
                  presence_fn=int((~pr & g["present"]).sum()),
                  fp_voxels=int((p & ~t).sum()), fn_voxels=int((~p & t).sum()),
                  signed_volume_error_vox=int(p.sum()) - int(t.sum()),
                  thin_rays=nt, thin_voxels=nvox,
                  thin_present=int((pr & thin).sum()),
                  thin_overlap_rays=int((overlap & thin).sum()),
                  thin_true_positive_voxels=int((p & t)[thin].sum()),
                  thin_presence_recall=float((pr & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_overlap_recall=float((overlap & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_voxel_recall=float((p & t)[thin].sum()/nvox) if nvox else None,
                  fp_components=int(label(p & ~t)[1]))
    for cls in (1, 2):
        pc, tc = pred == cls, truth == cls
        n = pc.sum() + tc.sum()
        result[f"class{cls}_dice"] = float(2*(pc & tc).sum()/n) if n else 1.
    pg = geometry(pred)
    both = pr & g["present"]
    errors = (abs(pg["lower"] - g["lower"]) + abs(pg["upper"] - g["upper"])) / 2
    result["conditional_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both].mean()) if both.any() else None
    result["conditional_thin_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both & thin].mean()) if (both & thin).any() else None
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        penalty = float(np.linalg.norm(pred.shape)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
        result.update(assd_mm=penalty, hd95_mm=penalty, p_to_t_mm=penalty, t_to_p_mm=penalty)
        for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
            result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = 0. if t.any() else None
        result["surface_contributions"] = {"empty_mask_penalty": penalty}
        return result
    ps, ts = p ^ binary_erosion(p), t ^ binary_erosion(t)
    pd = distance_transform_edt(~ts)[ps]
    td = distance_transform_edt(~ps)[ts]
    assd = (float(pd.mean()) + float(td.mean())) / 2
    result.update(assd_mm=assd, hd95_mm=float(np.percentile(np.r_[pd, td], 95)),
                  p_to_t_mm=float(pd.mean()), t_to_p_mm=float(td.mean()))
    for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
        result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = float((td <= tolerance).mean())
    if strata is not None:
        volume_strata = np.broadcast_to(strata[..., None], p.shape)
        p_names, t_names = volume_strata[ps], volume_strata[ts]
        contributions = {}
        for name in np.unique(strata):
            a = float(pd[p_names == name].sum() / len(pd) / 2)
            b = float(td[t_names == name].sum() / len(td) / 2)
            contributions[str(name)] = dict(p_to_t=a, t_to_p=b, total=a+b)
        if not np.isclose(sum(x["total"] for x in contributions.values()), assd, atol=1e-10):
            raise AssertionError("Surface contribution decomposition does not sum to ASSD")
        result["surface_contributions"] = contributions
    return result


def means(rows):
    return {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows if r.get(key) is not None]))
            for key in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][key], (int, float)) or rows[0][key] is None
            if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in rows)}


def paired(values, seed=0):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = [float(rng.choice(values, size=len(values), replace=True).mean()) for _ in range(3000)]
    return dict(mean=float(values.mean()), median=float(np.median(values)),
                ci95_conditional_case_bootstrap=np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5]).tolist(),
                improved=int((values < 0).sum()), worsened=int((values > 0).sum()), n=len(values))


def verify_inputs(args):
    for path, expected in ((args.pkl, "3311d2233b99e09080c40ca80f1035781d9c1dc9c5b109dc266c73eb52a3df01"),
                           (args.splits, "1d6a3fe993359ad85e9c28a29901162251c3359449b710c09cb9e92d66dda472")):
        if digest(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"Input hash mismatch: {path}")


def checkpoint(args, fold, arm):
    root = args.root / f"fold{fold}" / arm
    path = root / "best.pt"
    expected = json.loads((root / "done.json").read_text())["best_sha256"]
    if digest(path) != expected:
        raise ValueError(f"Checkpoint hash mismatch: {path}")
    return path


def provenance(args):
    local = Path(__file__).parent
    result = {"arguments": {k: str(v) if isinstance(v, Path) else v for k, v in vars(args).items()},
              "experiment_sha256": {p.name: digest(p) for p in local.iterdir()
                                    if p.suffix in {".py", ".md", ".sh"}},
              "pkl_sha256": digest(args.pkl), "splits_sha256": digest(args.splits),
              "torch_version": torch.__version__,
              "status": "internal development; labels previously used in method design"}
    source_files = ["thesis/new_constraints/function_head.py", "thesis/new_constraints/train_function_head.py",
                    "thesis/new_constraints/supervised.py", "baselines/swin_unetr/swin_unetr.py"]

"""Bounded renderer-only control and fitting-label edit-interval targets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

LIMIT = 4.0
SAFETY = 1e-3
TIE_WEIGHT = .01
STRENGTHS = (0., .25, .5, 1.)
BIAS_OFFSETS = (-4., -2., -1., -.5, 0., .5, 1., 2., 4.)


def bounded_delta(probe, inputs, anchor):
    return LIMIT * torch.tanh((probe(inputs, anchor)-anchor) / LIMIT)


class FrozenRayDecisions:
    """Exactly the foreground argmax decision of the frozen product renderer."""
    def __init__(self, raw, lower, upper, beta, anchor):
        self.background = raw[0, 0].float()
        self.foreground = raw[0, 1:].float().amax(0)
        self.beta = beta.float()
        self.anchor = anchor.float()
        z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.log_lower = F.logsigmoid((z-lower[0, ..., None]+.5)/.5)
        self.log_upper = F.logsigmoid((upper[0, ..., None]-z+.5)/.5)

    def __call__(self, delta):
        log_o = F.logsigmoid(self.anchor+delta)[..., None] + self.log_lower + self.log_upper
        logit = log_o-torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
        shift = 6*torch.tanh(logit/6)
        # Preserve reference operation order and background-wins-ties behavior.
        return self.foreground > self.background-self.beta*shift


@torch.no_grad()
def interval_targets(decisions, truth, baseline):
    """Evaluation labels are forbidden here: call on fitting cases only.

    Feasible targets retain correct baseline FG and BG and overlap each true
    ray. Bisection follows actual float32 decisions, within the fixed +/-4
    residual-logit domain. Infeasible or numerically unsafe rays target zero.
    """
    fg = truth > 0
    base = baseline > 0
    shape = truth.shape[:-1]
    zero = torch.zeros(shape, device=truth.device)
    if not torch.equal(decisions(zero), base):
        raise AssertionError("Target decision path does not reproduce E")
    protected_fg, protected_bg = fg & base, ~fg & ~base
    present = fg.any(-1)

    def foreground_ok(delta):
        pred = decisions(delta)
        return (~protected_fg | pred).all(-1) & (~present | (fg & pred).any(-1))

    def background_ok(delta):
        return (~protected_bg | ~decisions(delta)).all(-1)

    minimum = torch.full(shape, -LIMIT, device=truth.device)
    maximum = torch.full(shape, LIMIT, device=truth.device)
    fg_at_min, fg_at_max = foreground_ok(minimum), foreground_ok(maximum)
    bg_at_min, bg_at_max = background_ok(minimum), background_ok(maximum)
    left, right = minimum.clone(), maximum.clone()
    for _ in range(24):
        middle = (left+right)/2
        valid = foreground_ok(middle)
        left, right = torch.where(valid, left, middle), torch.where(valid, middle, right)
    lower = torch.where(fg_at_min, minimum, right+SAFETY)
    left, right = minimum.clone(), maximum.clone()
    for _ in range(24):
        middle = (left+right)/2
        valid = background_ok(middle)
        left, right = torch.where(valid, middle, left), torch.where(valid, right, middle)
    upper = torch.where(bg_at_max, maximum, left-SAFETY)
    feasible = fg_at_max & bg_at_min & (lower <= upper)
    proposed = torch.maximum(lower, torch.minimum(upper, zero))
    # Verify the actual selected action, not just arithmetic bound consistency.
    feasible &= foreground_ok(proposed) & background_ok(proposed)
    target = torch.where(feasible, proposed, zero)
    lower = torch.where(feasible, lower, zero)
    upper = torch.where(feasible, upper, zero)
    teacher = decisions(target)
    assert not (teacher & protected_bg).any()
    assert not (~teacher & protected_fg).any()
    assert ((teacher & fg).any(-1) | ~present | ~feasible).all()
    return dict(lower=lower, upper=upper, target=target, feasible=feasible,
                initially_missed=present & ~(base & fg).any(-1))


def interval_loss(delta, targets, groups):
    distance = (targets["lower"]-delta).relu().square() + (delta-targets["upper"]).relu().square()
    # Prefer the closest valid action, not zero when zero is outside the range.
    # Penalizing delta^2 there would pull the optimum short of the rescue threshold.
    per_ray = torch.where(targets["feasible"],
        distance + TIE_WEIGHT*(delta-targets["target"]).square(), delta.square())
    terms = [per_ray[g].mean() for g in groups if g.any()]
    if not terms:
        raise ValueError("No fitting rays")
    return torch.stack(terms).mean()


def eligible_correction(metrics, baseline):
    from presence_model import eligible
    return (eligible(metrics, baseline)
            and metrics["renderer_deleted_true_voxels"] <= baseline["renderer_deleted_true_voxels"] + 1e-9)


def correction_selection_key(metrics, epoch, strength):
    return (-metrics["thin_overlap_recall"], metrics["assd_mm"], metrics["presence_fp"],
            epoch, strength)

"""Function-preserving capacity/pooling interventions on a frozen E model."""
from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import copy
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class PresenceProbe(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original, width=24, pooling="mean", seed=0):
        super().__init__()
        if width not in (24, 48) or pooling not in ("mean", "meanmax"):
            raise ValueError("Only the prespecified width/pooling factorial is allowed")
        self.width, self.pooling = width, pooling
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(7, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU(),
                                  nn.Conv2d(width, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU())
        self.presence = nn.Conv1d(width * 2, 1, 3, padding=1)
        multiplier = width // 24
        idx = torch.arange(width) % 24
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.stem[0].weight.copy_(original.stem[0].weight[idx])
            self.stem[0].bias.copy_(original.stem[0].bias[idx])
            self.stem[2].weight.copy_(original.stem[2].weight[idx][:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.stem[2].bias.copy_(original.stem[2].bias[idx])
            self.presence.weight.zero_()
            self.presence.weight[:, :width].copy_(original.presence.weight[:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.presence.bias.copy_(original.presence.bias)
            if multiplier == 2:
                generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
                noise = torch.randn((1, 24, 3), generator=generator) * 1e-3
                # Identical initial output; unequal channel gradients allow extra
                # channels to become useful rather than remain exact duplicates.
                self.presence.weight[:, :24].add_(noise)
                self.presence.weight[:, 24:48].sub_(noise)
        # GPU convolution algorithms may round duplicated channels differently.
        # Subtract an identical frozen initial branch, making the initial update
        # bitwise zero rather than relying on algebraic Net2Wider equivalence.
        self.initial_stem = copy.deepcopy(self.stem).requires_grad_(False)
        self.initial_presence = copy.deepcopy(self.presence).requires_grad_(False)

    def _residual(self, inputs, stem, presence):
        hidden = stem(inputs)
        mean = hidden.mean(-1)
        second = mean if self.pooling == "mean" else hidden.amax(-1)
        return presence(torch.cat((mean, second), 1)).squeeze(1)

    def forward(self, inputs, anchor):
        """Anchor is the cached full E presence logit, not its voxel-only anchor."""
        residual = self._residual(inputs, self.stem, self.presence)
        with torch.no_grad():
            initial = self._residual(inputs, self.initial_stem, self.initial_presence)
        return anchor + (residual - initial)


def ray_groups(truth, raw_mask, original_q):
    """Frozen fitting labels/negative groups, never used to construct features."""
    fg = truth > 0
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    z = torch.arange(fg.shape[-1], device=truth.device)
    lower = torch.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).amin(-1)
    upper = torch.where(fg, z, -1).amax(-1)
    present = count > 0
    thin = present & ((upper-lower+1) <= 2) & ~fg[..., 0] & ~fg[..., -1]
    hard_empty = ~present & ((raw_mask > 0).any(-1) | (original_q >= .5))
    return (thin, present & ~thin, hard_empty, ~present & ~hard_empty)


def balanced_presence_loss(logits, groups):
    losses = []
    for index, group in enumerate(groups):
        if group.any():
            target = torch.full_like(logits[group], float(index < 2))
            losses.append(F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits[group], target))
    if not losses:
        raise ValueError("No supervised rays")
    return torch.stack(losses).mean()


def eligible(metrics, baseline):
    return (metrics["presence_fp"] <= baseline["presence_fp"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["fp_voxels"] <= baseline["fp_voxels"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["thin_voxel_recall"] >= baseline["thin_voxel_recall"] - 1e-9
            and metrics["assd_mm"] <= baseline["assd_mm"] + .002 + 1e-9)


def selection_key(metrics, epoch, offset):
    return (-metrics["thin_overlap_recall"], metrics["assd_mm"], metrics["presence_fp"],
            epoch, abs(offset), offset)

                  recovered_true_voxels=int((fg & ~before & after).sum()),
                  core_fn=int((case["core"] & ~after).sum()))
    for name, group in zip(("thin", "other_true", "hard_empty", "other_empty"), case["groups"]):
        mask = group.numpy()

    return dict(case=case["case"], **result)


@torch.no_grad()
def build_targets(cases, device):
    totals = {name: dict(rays=0, feasible=0, missed=0, feasible_missed=0, changed_teacher=0)
              for name in ("thin", "other_true", "hard_empty", "other_empty")}
    for case in cases:
        context = FrozenRayDecisions(*(case[k].to(device) for k in ("raw", "lower", "upper", "beta", "anchor")))
        target = interval_targets(context, torch.from_numpy(case["truth"]).to(device),
                                  torch.from_numpy(case["baseline"]).to(device))
        case["targets"] = {k: v.cpu() for k, v in target.items()}
        for name, group in zip(totals, case["groups"]):
            t = case["targets"]
            totals[name]["rays"] += int(group.sum())
            totals[name]["feasible"] += int((group & t["feasible"]).sum())
            totals[name]["missed"] += int((group & t["initially_missed"]).sum())
            totals[name]["feasible_missed"] += int((group & t["initially_missed"] & t["feasible"]).sum())
            totals[name]["changed_teacher"] += int((group & (t["target"] != 0)).sum())
    return totals


def targets_on(case, device):

def calibrate(cases, device):
    squared = {k: [] for k in ARMS}
    for case in cases[:4]:
        anchor = case["anchor"].to(device)
        delta = torch.zeros_like(anchor, requires_grad=True)
        groups = tuple(g.to(device) for g in case["groups"])
        losses = dict(existence=balanced_presence_loss(anchor+delta, groups),
                      interval=interval_loss(delta, targets_on(case, device), groups))
        for arm, loss in losses.items():
            gradient = torch.autograd.grad(loss, delta, retain_graph=True)[0]
            squared[arm].append(float(gradient.square().mean()))
    rms = {k: float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v))) for k, v in squared.items()}
    if min(rms.values()) <= 0 or not all(np.isfinite(v) for v in rms.values()):
        raise ValueError("Locked four-case gradient calibration has no finite nonzero signal")
    return dict(interval_scale=rms["existence"]/rms["interval"], output_delta_gradient_rms=rms,
                fitting_case_count=4, method="first four sorted fitting cases, at zero correction")


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(probe, cases, strengths, device, check_initial=False):
    probe.eval()
    jobs = []
    records = {a: [] for a in strengths}
    for case in cases:
        inputs, anchor = tensors(case, device)
        delta = bounded_delta(probe, inputs, anchor)
        if check_initial and not torch.equal(delta, torch.zeros_like(delta)):
            raise AssertionError("Nonzero initial residual")
        for strength in strengths:
            if strength == 0:
                records[strength].append(case["baseline_metrics"])
                continue
            actual = strength*delta
            pred = prediction(case, anchor+actual, 0., device)
            if check_initial and not np.array_equal(pred, case["baseline"]):
                raise AssertionError("Initial correction changes E mask")
            jobs.append((strength, case, pred, actual.cpu().numpy()))
    def work(job):
        strength, case, pred, delta = job
        return strength, measured(case, pred, delta)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        for strength, row in pool.map(work, jobs):
            records[strength].append(row)
    return {a: means(v) for a,v in records.items()}, records


@torch.no_grad()

    best = dict(offset=0., metrics=baseline, fallback=True)
    results = {}
    for offset in BIAS_OFFSETS:
        rows = []
        for case in cases:
            pred = case["baseline"] if offset == 0 else prediction(case, case["anchor"].to(device), offset, device)
            rows.append(measured(case, pred, np.full(case["anchor"].shape, offset)))
        metric = means(rows)
        results[str(offset)] = dict(metrics=metric, eligible=eligible_correction(metric, baseline))
        key = (-metric["thin_overlap_recall"], metric["assd_mm"], metric["presence_fp"], abs(offset), offset)
        old = best["metrics"]
        oldkey = (-old["thin_overlap_recall"], old["assd_mm"], old["presence_fp"], abs(best["offset"]), best["offset"])
        if eligible_correction(metric, baseline) and key < oldkey:
            best = dict(offset=offset, metrics=metric, fallback=False)
    return dict(selected=best, candidates=results)

def head_metrics(logits, truth, groups):
    probability = logits.sigmoid().cpu().numpy()
    gt = geometry(truth)
    result = dict(head_presence_brier=float(((probability-gt["present"])**2).mean()),
                  head_presence_fp=int(((probability >= .5) & ~gt["present"]).sum()),
                  head_presence_fn=int(((probability < .5) & gt["present"]).sum()))
    for name, group in zip(("thin", "other_true", "hard_empty", "other_empty"), groups):
        chosen = group.numpy()
        result[f"head_mean_q_{name}"] = float(probability[chosen].mean()) if chosen.any() else None
    positive = logits.cpu().numpy()[groups[0].numpy()]
    negative = logits.cpu().numpy()[groups[2].numpy()]
    if len(positive) and len(negative):
        ranks = rankdata(np.r_[positive, negative])
        n, m = len(positive), len(negative)
        result["thin_vs_hard_empty_auc"] = float((ranks[:n].sum()-n*(n+1)/2)/(n*m))
    else:
        result["thin_vs_hard_empty_auc"] = None
    return result


@torch.no_grad()

        losses.append(float(balanced_presence_loss(logits, tuple(g.to(device) for g in case["groups"]))))
        if check_initial:
            torch.testing.assert_close(logits.cpu(), case["original_logit"], atol=2e-4, rtol=1e-5)
        for offset in offsets:
            pred = prediction(case, logits, offset, device)
            if check_initial and offset == 0 and not np.array_equal(pred, case["baseline"]):
                raise AssertionError(f"Initial head changes labels: {case['case']}")
            jobs.append((offset, case["case"], pred, case["truth"],
                         head_metrics(logits+offset, case["truth"], case["groups"])))
    # SciPy distance transforms release the GIL. The order of records and all
    # metric/selection definitions stay identical to sequential evaluation.
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
        for offset, record in executor.map(_score_prediction, jobs):
            rows[offset].append(record)
    return {offset: means(values) for offset, values in rows.items()}, float(np.mean(losses)), rows


def train_one(original, fit, inner, baseline, width, pooling, seed, device, output, epochs):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    model = PresenceProbe(original, width, pooling, seed).to(device)
    # Verify functional equivalence on the entire inner set, not just a toy input.
    initial, initial_loss, _ = evaluate(model, inner, (0.,), device, check_initial=True)
    best = dict(epoch=0, offset=0., metrics=baseline, fallback=True)
    best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.cpu().state_dict())
    model.to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-5)
    history = [dict(epoch=0, inner=initial[0.], inner_presence_loss=initial_loss)]
    generator = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        model.train()
        losses = []
        for index in generator.permutation(len(fit)):
            case = fit[int(index)]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            logits = model(*tensors(case, device))
            loss = balanced_presence_loss(logits, tuple(g.to(device) for g in case["groups"]))
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
                raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite presence loss")
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
        entry = dict(epoch=epoch, fit_loss=float(np.mean(losses)), train_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
        if epoch in (4, 8, 12):
            validation_started = time.perf_counter()
            metrics, inner_loss, _ = evaluate(model, inner, OFFSETS, device)
            entry.update(inner_presence_loss=inner_loss, validation_seconds=time.perf_counter()-validation_started,
                         candidates={str(offset): dict(metrics=values, eligible=eligible(values, baseline))
                                     for offset, values in metrics.items()})
            for offset, values in metrics.items():
                if eligible(values, baseline) and selection_key(values, epoch, offset) < selection_key(best["metrics"], best["epoch"], best["offset"]):
                    best = dict(epoch=epoch, offset=offset, metrics=values, fallback=False)
                    best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
        history.append(entry)
        save_json(output / "history.json", history)
        print(json.dumps(dict(arm=f"w{width}_{pooling}", seed=seed, **entry)), flush=True)
    final_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
    torch.save(dict(state=best_state, selected=best, width=width, pooling=pooling, seed=seed), output / "selected.pt")
    torch.save(dict(state=final_state, width=width, pooling=pooling, seed=seed), output / "final.pt")
    selection = dict(selected=best, parameter_count=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                     selected_sha256=digest(output / "selected.pt"), final_sha256=digest(output / "final.pt"))
    save_json(output / "selection.json", selection)
    del model
    return selection

                        ("w48_meanmax_selected", "w48_mean_selected")):

            metric: paired([values[left][case][metric] - values[right][case][metric]

    return dict(arms=summary, contrasts=contrasts,
                uncertainty="case bootstrap after averaging presence seeds; conditional on saved E backbones")

GROUPS = ('thin', 'other_true', 'hard_empty', 'other_empty', 'feasible_missed_thin')


def auc(positive, negative):
    positive, negative = np.asarray(positive), np.asarray(negative)
    n, m = len(positive), len(negative)
    if not n or not m:
        return None
    ranks = rankdata(np.r_[positive, negative])
    return float((ranks[:n].sum()-n*(n+1)/2)/(n*m))


def distribution(values):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    if not len(values):
        return dict(n=0)
    return dict(n=len(values), mean=float(values.mean()), std=float(values.std()),
                min=float(values.min()), max=float(values.max()),
                quantiles=dict(zip(('p01','p05','p50','p95','p99'),
                                   np.quantile(values,[.01,.05,.5,.95,.99]).tolist())))


def weighted_objective(delta, data, arm):
    if arm == 'interval':
        outside = np.maximum(data['lower']-delta,0)**2 + np.maximum(delta-data['upper'],0)**2
        per_ray = np.where(data['feasible'], outside + TIE_WEIGHT*(delta-data['target'])**2, delta**2)
    else:
        logits = data['anchor']+delta
        per_ray = np.logaddexp(0,logits)-data['present']*logits
    return float(np.sum(data['weight']*per_ray))


def fit_constants(cases, deltas, arm):
    parts = {k:[] for k in ('anchor','lower','upper','target','feasible','present','weight')}
    for case in cases:
        groups = [g.numpy() for g in case['groups']]
        nonempty = sum(g.any() for g in groups)
        weight = np.zeros(case['anchor'].shape, dtype=np.float64)
        for g in groups:
            if g.any():
                weight[g] = 1/(len(cases)*nonempty*g.sum())
        parts['weight'].append(weight.ravel())
        parts['anchor'].append(case['anchor'].numpy().ravel())
        parts['present'].append((case['truth']>0).any(-1).ravel())
        for k in ('lower','upper','target','feasible'):
            parts[k].append(case['diagnostic_targets'][k].numpy().ravel())
    data = {k:np.concatenate(v) for k,v in parts.items()}
    assert np.isclose(data['weight'].sum(),1)
    result = minimize_scalar(lambda x:weighted_objective(x,data,arm),bounds=(-4,4),
                             method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-7})
    if not result.success:
        raise RuntimeError('Constant objective minimization failed')
    choices = (-4.,0.,4.,float(result.x))
    best = min(choices,key=lambda x:weighted_objective(x,data,arm))
    return dict(fit_mean=float(np.mean([d.mean() for d in deltas])), fit_optimal=best,
                objective_zero=weighted_objective(0.,data,arm),
                objective_learned=weighted_objective(np.concatenate([d.ravel() for d in deltas]),data,arm),
                objective_optimal_constant=weighted_objective(best,data,arm))


def mask_metrics(pred, case):
    fg, before = case['truth']>0, case['baseline']>0
    thin = case['groups'][0].numpy()
    present = fg.any(-1)
    n, nv = thin.sum(), fg[thin].sum()
    denom = pred.sum()+fg.sum()
    return dict(union_dice=float(2*(pred & fg).sum()/denom) if denom else 1.,
                thin_overlap_recall=float((pred & fg).any(-1)[thin].sum()/n) if n else None,
                thin_voxel_recall=float((pred & fg)[thin].sum()/nv) if nv else None,
                fp_rays=int((pred.any(-1)&~present).sum()), fp_voxels=int((pred&~fg).sum()),
                recovered_true_voxels=int((pred&fg&~before).sum()),
                newly_deleted_true_voxels=int((~pred&fg&before).sum()),
                new_fp_voxels=int((pred&~fg&~before).sum()),
                removed_fp_voxels=int((~pred&~fg&before).sum()))


@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_targets(cases, device):
    # Inner targets are diagnostic reference intervals only; never passed to
    # fitting/optimization. Both strata use the exact frozen renderer predicates.
    for case in cases:
        context = FrozenRayDecisions(*(case[k].to(device) for k in ('raw','lower','upper','beta','anchor')))
        target = interval_targets(context,torch.from_numpy(case['truth']).to(device),
                                   torch.from_numpy(case['baseline']).to(device))
        case['diagnostic_targets'] = {k:v.cpu() for k,v in target.items()}


@torch.no_grad()
def diagnostics(cases, deltas, controls, device):
    arrays = {g:[] for g in GROUPS}
    rows = []
    masks = {name:[] for name in ('E','learned','fit_mean','fit_optimal')}
    case_differences = {name:[] for name in ('fit_mean','fit_optimal')}
    for case, delta in zip(cases,deltas):
        groups = dict(zip(GROUPS[:4],[g.numpy() for g in case['groups']]))
        t = {k:v.numpy() for k,v in case['diagnostic_targets'].items()}
        groups['feasible_missed_thin'] = groups['thin'] & t['feasible'] & t['initially_missed']
        anchor = case['anchor'].numpy()
        row = dict(delta_spatial_std=float(delta.std()))
        for name, g in groups.items():
            arrays[name].append(delta[g])
            if g.any():
                row[f'{name}_lower_violation'] = float((delta[g]<t['lower'][g]).mean())
                row[f'{name}_upper_violation'] = float((delta[g]>t['upper'][g]).mean())
                row[f'{name}_mean_delta'] = float(delta[g].mean())
        for positive in ('thin','feasible_missed_thin'):
            for label, value in (('delta',delta),('anchor',anchor),('final_control',anchor+delta)):
                row[f'{positive}_{label}_auc'] = auc(value[groups[positive]],value[groups['hard_empty']])
        context = FrozenRayDecisions(*(case[k].to(device) for k in ('raw','lower','upper','beta','anchor')))
        predictions = dict(E=case['baseline']>0)
        for name, value in (('learned',delta),('fit_mean',controls['fit_mean']),('fit_optimal',controls['fit_optimal'])):
            predictions[name] = context(torch.as_tensor(value,device=device,dtype=torch.float32)).cpu().numpy()
        for name,pred in predictions.items():
            masks[name].append(mask_metrics(pred,case))
        for name in case_differences:
            model, constant = predictions['learned'],predictions[name]
            row[f'learned_vs_{name}_mask_disagreement_voxels'] = int((model!=constant).sum())
            row[f'learned_vs_{name}_delta_rmse'] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((delta-controls[name])**2)))
            case_differences[name].append({k:masks['learned'][-1][k]-masks[name][-1][k]
                for k in masks[name][-1] if masks[name][-1][k] is not None})
        rows.append(row)
    paired = {name:{key:dict(mean=float(np.mean([r[key] for r in records if key in r])),
                             negative_cases=sum(r.get(key,0)<0 for r in records),
                             positive_cases=sum(r.get(key,0)>0 for r in records))
                         for key in records[0]} for name,records in case_differences.items()}
    # keys with absent groups in the first case must not disappear from means.
    keys = set().union(*(r.keys() for r in rows))
    averages = {k:float(np.mean([r[k] for r in rows if r.get(k) is not None]))
                for k in keys if any(r.get(k) is not None for r in rows)}
    return dict(cases=len(cases), correction_distributions={g:distribution(np.concatenate(v)) for g,v in arrays.items()},
                case_mean_diagnostics=averages, masks={k:means(v) for k,v in masks.items()},
                learned_minus_constant=paired)

# Direct annotated-contour supervision — locked pilot, 2026-09-23

The user authorized testing annotated contour supervision directly on backbone
segmentation probabilities. The minimal comparison is Dice/CE versus the same
Dice/CE plus a signed-distance boundary objective. No endpoint head, renderer,
reconstruction head, presence gate, image conditioning on GT, or neighbor-shape
loss is introduced. Raw backbone(image).argmax(1) remains inference.

This is a bounded one-fold continuation pilot, not training from scratch or an
exact reproduction of the published schedule. Motivation: Kervadec et al.,
Boundary loss for highly unbalanced segmentation, MIDL 2019,
https://proceedings.mlr.press/v102/kervadec19a.html .

## Data, initialization and matching

Use original fold1 A/best.pt from job666174 (backbone seed0), verifying its hash
and frozen source/data/split provenance from corrected experiment666967.
Historical fitting166 / inner42 cases; outer52 provide no training or evaluation
examples. All data are reused internal development data. No external/general
anatomical claim or independent-backbone-seed confirmation.

Both arms start from exactly the original A weights with identical new AdamW
states: lr3e-5, weight_decay1e-5, batch2, six epochs, 83 updates/epoch, exactly
498 backbone updates each. Original optimizer was pruned; optimizer restart is
explicit. There is no shared preparation pass because no new head needs it.
Continuation object seed9301; matched per-epoch order/RNG seed10301+epoch.
No early stopping, inner checkpoint selection, hyperparameter grid or outcome-
driven extension. Epoch6 is the primary comparison; inner trajectories are
descriptive and never control training. Old experiments/checkpoints stay frozen.

## Distance field and loss

For GT union foreground G=(label>0), compute on the historical isotropic 1mm
grid phi=EDT(not G)-EDT(G), distances to opposite-label voxel centers. Phi is
strictly negative on all foreground, strictly positive on all background.
In particular, a single foreground voxel has phi=-1; its nearest background
neighbor has phi=+1. This discrete convention is not an exact subvoxel contour
distance. Unlike conventions that subtract one from the inside EDT, it does
not zero the supervision on one-voxel-thick annotated anatomy. State this
choice explicitly; do not claim an exact reproduction of author implementation.

The boundary term is mean over cases/voxels of
  phi * (softmax(raw_logits)[class1] + softmax(raw_logits)[class2]).
It directly supervises the same probabilities used for segmentation. GT-derived
fields are detached training targets only; no target enters model.forward.
Signed loss values may be negative, which is expected. No clipping/absolute
value, bounding box, overlap eligibility, hard argmax or ray-filling target.
Real gaps and multi-run anatomy retain their actual voxel labels. Three-class
Dice/CE continues to supervise internal class division. Empty/full foreground
targets have no finite defined opposite-label distance here and cause a visible
failure rather than a fabricated map; the registered organ data should have both.

Cache SDFs in cluster RAM keyed by target content; never export them. No on-disk
image/mask cache. Control computes the same diagnostic boundary term but only
backpropagates Dice/CE. Preserve the historical baseline arithmetic expression.

## Coefficient locked using fitting data only

Before any updates, use exactly four shuffled fitting batches in FP32 under
seed9302. Compute raw-logit gradient RMS for Dice/CE and boundary loss. Fix
lambda=0.1*median(base_RMS)/median(boundary_RMS). Log the four norms and gradient
cosines; do not use those outcomes to choose another ratio. Require finite lambda
in [1e-6,100], fail otherwise. This is a magnitude convention, not established
optimal tuning. Restore original model weights/buffers after calibration.
Linearly ramp the boundary coefficient across the first 83 updates; hold fixed
for epochs2–6. No outcome/epoch readiness gate. Baseline is unchanged.

Use independent, freshly constructed optimizer/scaler objects per arm. AMP with
FP32 boundary softmax/reduction; abort on any backbone AMP skip. CUDA deterministic
warn-only mode retains original mean CE (cluster build lacks a strict deterministic
kernel); fixed seeds/cuDNN are used but universal bitwise determinism is not claimed.

## Evaluation and decision

Evaluate the original model and each epoch on the same inner42 cases, labels
used only after raw inference. Compare final6 versus fresh matched control and
versus original A. Report union/class Dice, ASSD, HD95, actual thin-overlap and
thin-voxel recall, FP rays/voxels, core/true recall, true deletions/recoveries and
core/thin deletions. Thin recall uses historical nonborder span<=2; deletion
audit uses 1–2 true voxels regardless of span. Predictions stay in cluster RAM.

Record strict preservation guards against original A and, for the boundary arm,
same-epoch control: no worse Dice/thin recalls/core recall/FP burdens, zero new
core/thin deletions, true deletions<=recoveries. Guards are reports, not checkpoint
selectors. A safe gain also requires lower ASSD. Report partial improvements and
tradeoffs honestly; failed guards alone do not imply absent geometric learning.
No clinical or new-cohort claim; no automatic model promotion.

## Verification, resources and storage

Unit tests: signed EDT including thin voxels, correct direct logit gradient
signs inside/outside, distance weighting, preservation of GT gaps, detached
targets/class-union symmetry, caching and exact zero-weight AdamW parity.
GPU smoke: four fitting calibration batches, two pure baseline updates versus
two zero-coefficient updates with exact weight/optimizer/scaler equality; two
active boundary updates; finite weights and checkpoint roundtrip. Smoke outcomes
are execution checks, not scientific evidence or a tuning set.

Full run: stud, one gpu:4g.40gb, eight CPUs, 32GiB, one hour. Smoke 15 minutes.
Quota was about2.85GiB free; unchanged 2GiB reserve before checkpoint writes.
Store one ~70MB smoke roundtrip checkpoint and only two final model checkpoints
(no optimizer snapshots); peak includes one temporary model file, around280MB
logical, conservatively560MB quota allocation. No cleanup required/planned.
Epoch histories preserve progress, but this job has no optimizer-state resume.
Failure is reported without silent relaunch or schedule change. No duplicate jobs.

Only non-identifying aggregate results/provenance/job metadata may be downloaded
under standing authorization. Images, masks, distance maps, split/case identifiers,
individual records and checkpoints remain on cluster. Monitor through completion;

import numpy as np
import pytest
import torch
from loss import signed_distance,DistanceCache,boundary_loss,combined

def test_signed_edt_and_one_voxel_thin_target():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,3]=True
    d=signed_distance(fg)
    assert d[3,3,3]==-1 and d[3,3,4]==1 and np.isclose(d[4,4,3],np.sqrt(2))
    assert (d[fg]<0).all() and (d[~fg]>0).all()

def test_gradient_corrects_missed_thin_and_false_positive_directly():
    fg=np.zeros((5,5,5),bool);fg[2,2,2]=True
    raw=torch.zeros(1,3,5,5,5,requires_grad=True)
    d=torch.tensor(signed_distance(fg)[None])
    boundary_loss(raw,d).backward()
    assert raw.grad[0,1,2,2,2]<0 and raw.grad[0,2,2,2,2]<0 and raw.grad[0,0,2,2,2]>0
    assert raw.grad[0,1,0,0,0]>0 and raw.grad[0,2,0,0,0]>0 and raw.grad[0,0,0,0,0]<0

def test_more_distant_false_foreground_receives_larger_gradient():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,3]=True
    x=torch.zeros(1,3,7,7,7,requires_grad=True)
    boundary_loss(x,torch.tensor(signed_distance(fg)[None])).backward()
    assert x.grad[0,1,0,0,0]>x.grad[0,1,3,3,4]>0

def test_real_gaps_and_multirun_are_not_filled():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,1]=True;fg[3,3,5]=True
    d=signed_distance(fg)
    assert d[3,3,1]<0 and d[3,3,5]<0 and d[3,3,3]>0

def test_zero_weight_has_exact_optimizer_parity():
    torch.manual_seed(7);m=torch.nn.Conv3d(1,3,1);n=torch.nn.Conv3d(1,3,1);n.load_state_dict(m.state_dict())
    a=torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(),lr=3e-5);b=torch.optim.AdamW(n.parameters(),lr=3e-5)
    image=torch.randn(2,1,5,5,5);labels=torch.zeros(2,5,5,5,dtype=torch.long);labels[:,2,2,2]=1
    d=DistanceCache()(labels)
    for _ in range(2):
        a.zero_grad();b.zero_grad();x=m(image);y=n(image)
        loss=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(x,labels)
        total,_=combined(torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(y,labels),y,d,0.)
        loss.backward();total.backward();a.step();b.step()
    for p,q in zip(m.parameters(),n.parameters()):assert torch.equal(p,q)
    for k,v in a.state_dict()['state'].items():
        for name,t in v.items():assert torch.equal(t,b.state_dict()['state'][k][name])

def test_target_is_detached_and_class_union_symmetric():
    x=torch.randn(1,3,5,5,5,requires_grad=True);d=torch.randn(1,5,5,5,requires_grad=True)
    value=boundary_loss(x,d)
    assert torch.allclose(value,boundary_loss(x[:,[0,2,1]],d))
    value.backward();assert d.grad is None and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()

import argparse,copy,hashlib,json,os,random,sys,time

ROOT=Path('/home/3160552'); SOURCE=ROOT/'function_head_robustness_20260922'; PREV=ROOT/'boundary_auxiliary_20260923_34d3_v4'
ARMS=('control','direct_contour')
def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def save(path,value):
    temp=path.with_suffix('.tmp');temp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n');temp.replace(path)
def seed(n):random.seed(n);np.random.seed(n);torch.manual_seed(n);torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(n)
def base_loss(fn,raw,labels):
    v=fn(raw,labels);return (v+.5*v)/1.5
def objects(api,initial,device):
    seed(9301)
    model=api.FullModel(False,api.FunctionConfig()).to(device);api.load_weights(model,initial)
    opt=torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(),lr=3e-5,weight_decay=1e-5)
    scaler=torch.amp.GradScaler('cuda',enabled=device.type=='cuda')
    return model,opt,scaler
def epoch(api,obj,fit,fn,cache,device,coefficient,epoch_number,max_batches=None):
    model,opt,scaler=obj;model.train();seed(10301+epoch_number)
    records=[];start=time.monotonic()
    for i,batch in enumerate(fit):
        image=api.plain(batch['image'],device);labels=api.plain(batch['label'],device)
        field=cache(labels);opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        ramp=min(1.,((epoch_number-1)*len(fit)+i+1)/len(fit))
        with torch.autocast(device_type='cuda'):
            raw=model(image)['raw'];base=base_loss(fn,raw,labels)
            if coefficient is None:total=base;b=boundary_loss(raw,field)
            else:total,b=combined(base,raw,field,coefficient*ramp)
        if not torch.isfinite(total):raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite objective')
        previous=scaler.get_scale();scaler.scale(total).backward();scaler.step(opt);scaler.update()
        if scaler.get_scale()<previous:raise FloatingPointError('Backbone AMP skipped an update; matched comparison aborted')
        records.append([float(base.detach()),float(b.detach()),float(total.detach())])
        if i==0:print(json.dumps(dict(event='first_update',epoch=epoch_number,coefficient=coefficient,losses=records[-1])),flush=True)
        if max_batches and i+1>=max_batches:break
    return dict(updates=len(records),loss_means=np.mean(records,axis=0).tolist(),seconds=time.monotonic()-start,amp_skips=0)

def calibrate(api,obj,fit,fn,cache,device):
    model=obj[0];model.train();seed(9302);rows=[]
    for i,batch in enumerate(fit):
        labels=api.plain(batch['label'],device);raw=model(api.plain(batch['image'],device))['raw']
        base=base_loss(fn,raw,labels);bl=boundary_loss(raw,cache(labels))
        g0=torch.autograd.grad(base,raw,retain_graph=True)[0];g1=torch.autograd.grad(bl,raw)[0]
        norm0=float(g0.float().square().mean().sqrt());norm1=float(g1.float().square().mean().sqrt())
        cosine=float((g0*g1).sum()/(g0.norm()*g1.norm()).clamp_min(1e-30))
        rows.append(dict(base_rms=norm0,boundary_rms=norm1,cosine=cosine))
        if i==3:break
    assert len(rows)==4
    weight=.1*np.median([x['base_rms'] for x in rows])/np.median([x['boundary_rms'] for x in rows])
    if not np.isfinite(weight) or not 1e-6<=weight<=100:raise ValueError('Calibration outside frozen finite range')
    return dict(coefficient=float(weight),target_gradient_ratio=.1,batches=rows,source='first four fitting batches at initial A; no parameter update')

@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(api,model,loader,device,score,means,reference=None,matched=None):
    model.eval();rows=[];masks=[]
    for batch in loader:
        raw=model(api.plain(batch['image'],device))['raw']
        pred=raw.argmax(1)[0].cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8);truth=batch['label'][0,0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
        row=score(pred,truth);t=truth>0;p=pred>0;core=binary_erosion(t);thin=(t.sum(-1)>0)&(t.sum(-1)<=2)
        row['core_recall']=float((p&core).sum()/max(1,core.sum()));row['true_voxel_recall']=float((p&t).sum()/max(1,t.sum()))
        for name,bank in [('reference',reference),('matched',matched)]:
            if bank is None:continue
            old=bank[len(rows)]>0;deleted=old&t&~p
            row[name+'_deleted_true']=int(deleted.sum());row[name+'_recovered_true']=int((~old&t&p).sum())
            row[name+'_deleted_core']=int((deleted&core).sum());row[name+'_deleted_thin']=int(deleted[thin].sum())
        rows.append(row);masks.append(pred)
    return means(rows),np.stack(masks)

def preserved(candidate,ref,prefix):
    return all(candidate[k]>=ref[k] for k in ('union_dice','thin_overlap_recall','thin_voxel_recall','core_recall')) and all(candidate[k]<=ref[k] for k in ('presence_fp','fp_voxels')) and candidate[prefix+'_deleted_core']==0 and candidate[prefix+'_deleted_thin']==0 and candidate[prefix+'_deleted_true']<=candidate[prefix+'_recovered_true']

# Direct annotated-contour supervision — locked pilot, 2026-09-23

The user authorized testing annotated contour supervision directly on backbone
segmentation probabilities. The minimal comparison is Dice/CE versus the same
Dice/CE plus a signed-distance boundary objective. No endpoint head, renderer,
reconstruction head, presence gate, image conditioning on GT, or neighbor-shape
loss is introduced. Raw backbone(image).argmax(1) remains inference.

This is a bounded one-fold continuation pilot, not training from scratch or an
exact reproduction of the published schedule. Motivation: Kervadec et al.,
Boundary loss for highly unbalanced segmentation, MIDL 2019,
https://proceedings.mlr.press/v102/kervadec19a.html .

## Data, initialization and matching

Use original fold1 A/best.pt from job666174 (backbone seed0), verifying its hash
and frozen source/data/split provenance from corrected experiment666967.
Historical fitting166 / inner42 cases; outer52 provide no training or evaluation
examples. All data are reused internal development data. No external/general
anatomical claim or independent-backbone-seed confirmation.

Both arms start from exactly the original A weights with identical new AdamW
states: lr3e-5, weight_decay1e-5, batch2, six epochs, 83 updates/epoch, exactly
498 backbone updates each. Original optimizer was pruned; optimizer restart is
explicit. There is no shared preparation pass because no new head needs it.
Continuation object seed9301; matched per-epoch order/RNG seed10301+epoch.
No early stopping, inner checkpoint selection, hyperparameter grid or outcome-
driven extension. Epoch6 is the primary comparison; inner trajectories are
descriptive and never control training. Old experiments/checkpoints stay frozen.

Execution correction v2, before scientific training: smoke667057 failed exact
baseline parity. Diagnostic667061 found changing images on repeated fetches,
identical targets, exact warm/fresh model outputs on identical images, and exact
fresh zero-weight updates after those inputs had been revisited. The historical
MONAI nonzero normalization writes through tensor views into source arrays.
Copy each dataset record before the unchanged historical transform, in both
arms and evaluation. Audit every fit/inner example for exact repeated inputs and
unchanged backing arrays; verify matched whole-epoch input-stream hashes between
arms. Original disk data and historical experiment code/results remain unchanged.
This corrects execution, with no change to loss, coefficient rule or schedule.

## Distance field and loss

For GT union foreground G=(label>0), compute on the historical isotropic 1mm
grid phi=EDT(not G)-EDT(G), distances to opposite-label voxel centers. Phi is
strictly negative on all foreground, strictly positive on all background.
In particular, a single foreground voxel has phi=-1; its nearest background
neighbor has phi=+1. This discrete convention is not an exact subvoxel contour
distance. Unlike conventions that subtract one from the inside EDT, it does
not zero the supervision on one-voxel-thick annotated anatomy. State this
choice explicitly; do not claim an exact reproduction of author implementation.

The boundary term is mean over cases/voxels of
  phi * (softmax(raw_logits)[class1] + softmax(raw_logits)[class2]).
It directly supervises the same probabilities used for segmentation. GT-derived
fields are detached training targets only; no target enters model.forward.
Signed loss values may be negative, which is expected. No clipping/absolute
value, bounding box, overlap eligibility, hard argmax or ray-filling target.
Real gaps and multi-run anatomy retain their actual voxel labels. Three-class
Dice/CE continues to supervise internal class division. Empty/full foreground
targets have no finite defined opposite-label distance here and cause a visible
failure rather than a fabricated map; the registered organ data should have both.

Cache SDFs in cluster RAM keyed by target content; never export them. No on-disk
image/mask cache. Control computes the same diagnostic boundary term but only
backpropagates Dice/CE. Preserve the historical baseline arithmetic expression.

## Coefficient locked using fitting data only

Before any updates, use exactly four shuffled fitting batches in FP32 under
seed9302. Compute raw-logit gradient RMS for Dice/CE and boundary loss. Fix
lambda=0.1*median(base_RMS)/median(boundary_RMS). Log the four norms and gradient
cosines; do not use those outcomes to choose another ratio. Require finite lambda
in [1e-6,100], fail otherwise. This is a magnitude convention, not established
optimal tuning. Restore original model weights/buffers after calibration.
Linearly ramp the boundary coefficient across the first 83 updates; hold fixed
for epochs2–6. No outcome/epoch readiness gate. Baseline is unchanged.

Use independent, freshly constructed optimizer/scaler objects per arm. AMP with
FP32 boundary softmax/reduction; abort on any backbone AMP skip. CUDA deterministic
warn-only mode retains original mean CE (cluster build lacks a strict deterministic
kernel); fixed seeds/cuDNN are used but universal bitwise determinism is not claimed.

## Evaluation and decision

Evaluate the original model and each epoch on the same inner42 cases, labels
used only after raw inference. Compare final6 versus fresh matched control and
versus original A. Report union/class Dice, ASSD, HD95, actual thin-overlap and
thin-voxel recall, FP rays/voxels, core/true recall, true deletions/recoveries and
core/thin deletions. Thin recall uses historical nonborder span<=2; deletion
audit uses 1–2 true voxels regardless of span. Predictions stay in cluster RAM.

Record strict preservation guards against original A and, for the boundary arm,
same-epoch control: no worse Dice/thin recalls/core recall/FP burdens, zero new
core/thin deletions, true deletions<=recoveries. Guards are reports, not checkpoint
selectors. A safe gain also requires lower ASSD. Report partial improvements and
tradeoffs honestly; failed guards alone do not imply absent geometric learning.
No clinical or new-cohort claim; no automatic model promotion.

## Verification, resources and storage

Unit tests: signed EDT including thin voxels, correct direct logit gradient
signs inside/outside, distance weighting, preservation of GT gaps, detached
targets/class-union symmetry, caching and exact zero-weight AdamW parity.
GPU smoke: four fitting calibration batches, two pure baseline updates versus
two zero-coefficient updates with exact weight/optimizer/scaler equality; two
active boundary updates; finite weights and checkpoint roundtrip. Smoke outcomes
are execution checks, not scientific evidence or a tuning set.

Full run: stud, one gpu:4g.40gb, eight CPUs, 32GiB, one hour. Smoke 15 minutes.
Quota was about2.85GiB free; unchanged 2GiB reserve before checkpoint writes.
Store one ~70MB smoke roundtrip checkpoint and only two final model checkpoints
(no optimizer snapshots); peak includes one temporary model file, around280MB
logical, conservatively560MB quota allocation. No cleanup required/planned.
Epoch histories preserve progress, but this job has no optimizer-state resume.
Failure is reported without silent relaunch or schedule change. No duplicate jobs.

Only non-identifying aggregate results/provenance/job metadata may be downloaded
under standing authorization. Images, masks, distance maps, split/case identifiers,
individual records and checkpoints remain on cluster. Monitor through completion;
verify exit0, both498-update arms, hashes and provenance, then pause monitoring.

import numpy as np
import pytest
import torch
from loss import signed_distance,DistanceCache,boundary_loss,combined

def test_signed_edt_and_one_voxel_thin_target():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,3]=True
    d=signed_distance(fg)
    assert d[3,3,3]==-1 and d[3,3,4]==1 and np.isclose(d[4,4,3],np.sqrt(2))
    assert (d[fg]<0).all() and (d[~fg]>0).all()

def test_gradient_corrects_missed_thin_and_false_positive_directly():
    fg=np.zeros((5,5,5),bool);fg[2,2,2]=True
    raw=torch.zeros(1,3,5,5,5,requires_grad=True)
    d=torch.tensor(signed_distance(fg)[None])
    boundary_loss(raw,d).backward()
    assert raw.grad[0,1,2,2,2]<0 and raw.grad[0,2,2,2,2]<0 and raw.grad[0,0,2,2,2]>0
    assert raw.grad[0,1,0,0,0]>0 and raw.grad[0,2,0,0,0]>0 and raw.grad[0,0,0,0,0]<0

def test_more_distant_false_foreground_receives_larger_gradient():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,3]=True
    x=torch.zeros(1,3,7,7,7,requires_grad=True)
    boundary_loss(x,torch.tensor(signed_distance(fg)[None])).backward()
    assert x.grad[0,1,0,0,0]>x.grad[0,1,3,3,4]>0

def test_real_gaps_and_multirun_are_not_filled():
    fg=np.zeros((7,7,7),bool);fg[3,3,1]=True;fg[3,3,5]=True
    d=signed_distance(fg)
    assert d[3,3,1]<0 and d[3,3,5]<0 and d[3,3,3]>0

def test_zero_weight_has_exact_optimizer_parity():
    torch.manual_seed(7);m=torch.nn.Conv3d(1,3,1);n=torch.nn.Conv3d(1,3,1);n.load_state_dict(m.state_dict())
    a=torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(),lr=3e-5);b=torch.optim.AdamW(n.parameters(),lr=3e-5)
    image=torch.randn(2,1,5,5,5);labels=torch.zeros(2,5,5,5,dtype=torch.long);labels[:,2,2,2]=1
    d=DistanceCache()(labels)
    for _ in range(2):
        a.zero_grad();b.zero_grad();x=m(image);y=n(image)
        loss=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(x,labels)
        total,_=combined(torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(y,labels),y,d,0.)
        loss.backward();total.backward();a.step();b.step()
    for p,q in zip(m.parameters(),n.parameters()):assert torch.equal(p,q)
    for k,v in a.state_dict()['state'].items():
        for name,t in v.items():assert torch.equal(t,b.state_dict()['state'][k][name])

def test_target_is_detached_and_class_union_symmetric():
    x=torch.randn(1,3,5,5,5,requires_grad=True);d=torch.randn(1,5,5,5,requires_grad=True)
    value=boundary_loss(x,d)
    assert torch.allclose(value,boundary_loss(x[:,[0,2,1]],d))
    value.backward();assert d.grad is None and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()

def test_cache_consistency_and_invalid_target_rejection():
    labels=torch.zeros(2,1,5,5,5,dtype=torch.long);labels[:,:,2,2,2]=1
    c=DistanceCache();a=c(labels);b=c(labels)
    assert torch.equal(a,b) and len(c.cache)==1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):signed_distance(np.zeros((3,3,3),bool))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):signed_distance(np.ones((3,3,3),bool))

def test_preprocessing_cannot_mutate_backing_arrays():
    from input_guard import CopyBeforeTransform
    from monai.transforms import Compose,EnsureChannelFirstd,NormalizeIntensityd
    transform=Compose([EnsureChannelFirstd(keys=['image'],channel_dim='no_channel'),
                       NormalizeIntensityd(keys=['image'],nonzero=True,channel_wise=True)])
    image=np.arange(125,dtype=np.float32).reshape(5,5,5)
    original=image.copy();row={'image':image}
    safe=CopyBeforeTransform(transform);a=safe(row);b=safe(row)
    assert np.array_equal(image,original) and torch.equal(a['image'],b['image'])
    transform(row)
    assert not np.array_equal(image,original), 'Regression fixture must expose the original mutation'

def base_loss(fn,raw,labels):
    v=fn(raw,labels);return (v+.5*v)/1.5
def objects(api,initial,device):
    seed(9301)

def epoch(api,obj,fit,fn,cache,device,coefficient,epoch_number,max_batches=None):
    model,opt,scaler=obj;model.train();seed(10301+epoch_number)
    records=[];start=time.monotonic();input_stream=hashlib.sha256()
    for i,batch in enumerate(fit):
        for key in ('image','label'):input_stream.update(batch[key].detach().cpu().numpy().tobytes())
        image=api.plain(batch['image'],device);labels=api.plain(batch['label'],device)
        field=cache(labels);opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        ramp=min(1.,((epoch_number-1)*len(fit)+i+1)/len(fit))
        with torch.autocast(device_type='cuda'):
            raw=model(image)['raw'];base=base_loss(fn,raw,labels)
            if coefficient is None:total=base;b=boundary_loss(raw,field)
            else:total,b=combined(base,raw,field,coefficient*ramp)
        if not torch.isfinite(total):raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite objective')
        previous=scaler.get_scale();scaler.scale(total).backward();scaler.step(opt);scaler.update()
        if scaler.get_scale()<previous:raise FloatingPointError('Backbone AMP skipped an update; matched comparison aborted')
        records.append([float(base.detach()),float(b.detach()),float(total.detach())])
        if i==0:print(json.dumps(dict(event='first_update',epoch=epoch_number,coefficient=coefficient,losses=records[-1])),flush=True)
        if max_batches and i+1>=max_batches:break
    return dict(updates=len(records),loss_means=np.mean(records,axis=0).tolist(),seconds=time.monotonic()-start,amp_skips=0,input_stream_sha256=input_stream.hexdigest())

def calibrate(api,obj,fit,fn,cache,device):
    model=obj[0];model.train();seed(9302);rows=[]
    for i,batch in enumerate(fit):
        labels=api.plain(batch['label'],device);raw=model(api.plain(batch['image'],device))['raw']
        base=base_loss(fn,raw,labels);bl=boundary_loss(raw,cache(labels))
        g0=torch.autograd.grad(base,raw,retain_graph=True)[0];g1=torch.autograd.grad(bl,raw)[0]
        norm0=float(g0.float().square().mean().sqrt());norm1=float(g1.float().square().mean().sqrt())
        cosine=float((g0*g1).sum()/(g0.norm()*g1.norm()).clamp_min(1e-30))
        rows.append(dict(base_rms=norm0,boundary_rms=norm1,cosine=cosine))
        if i==3:break
    assert len(rows)==4
    weight=.1*np.median([x['base_rms'] for x in rows])/np.median([x['boundary_rms'] for x in rows])
    if not np.isfinite(weight) or not 1e-6<=weight<=100:raise ValueError('Calibration outside frozen finite range')
    return dict(coefficient=float(weight),target_gradient_ratio=.1,batches=rows,source='first four fitting batches at initial A; no parameter update')

@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(api,model,loader,device,score,means,reference=None,matched=None):
    model.eval();rows=[];masks=[]

        row=score(pred,truth);t=truth>0;p=pred>0;core=binary_erosion(t);thin=(t.sum(-1)>0)&(t.sum(-1)<=2)
        row['core_recall']=float((p&core).sum()/max(1,core.sum()));row['true_voxel_recall']=float((p&t).sum()/max(1,t.sum()))
        for name,bank in [('reference',reference),('matched',matched)]:
            if bank is None:continue
            old=bank[len(rows)]>0;deleted=old&t&~p
            row[name+'_deleted_true']=int(deleted.sum());row[name+'_recovered_true']=int((~old&t&p).sum())
            row[name+'_deleted_core']=int((deleted&core).sum());row[name+'_deleted_thin']=int(deleted[thin].sum())
        rows.append(row);masks.append(pred)
    return means(rows),np.stack(masks)

"""Inference-only spatial coherence audit of the nine 5%-data comparisons.

Uses the original frozen source payloads and selected checkpoints. No fitting,
checkpoint selection, or mutation of existing experiment artifacts occurs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def geometry(truth):
    y = truth > 0
    cross = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1)
    inner = y & ~ndi.binary_erosion(y, cross, iterations=2, border_value=0)
    outer = ndi.binary_dilation(y, cross, iterations=2, border_value=0) & ~y
    return y, inner, outer


def metrics(probability, pred, truth):
    """Uniform face means, split by GT relation to avoid rewarding smoothing.

    Hard predictions use foreground union of the three-class argmax. A pair
    is coherent if its endpoints agree, but can be coherently wrong; both
    correctness and disagreement are therefore recorded for same-side pairs.
    """
    y, inner, outer = geometry(truth)
    hard = pred > 0
    p = np.asarray(probability, dtype=np.float64)
    assert p.shape == y.shape and np.isfinite(p).all()
    support = inner | outer
    raw = {k: dict(n=0, soft_squared_error=0., soft_abs_difference=0.,
                   hard_squared_error=0, disagree=0, both_correct=0,
                   both_wrong=0, correct_transition=0, reversed_transition=0,
                   aligned_soft_jump=0.) for k in ('all', 'inner', 'outer', 'cross')}
    for axis in range(3):
        a = [slice(None)] * 3
        b = [slice(None)] * 3
        a[axis], b[axis] = slice(None, -1), slice(1, None)
        a, b = tuple(a), tuple(b)
        valid = support[a] & support[b]
        dy = y[a].astype(np.int8) - y[b].astype(np.int8)
        dp = p[a] - p[b]
        dh = hard[a].astype(np.int8) - hard[b].astype(np.int8)
        masks = dict(all=valid, inner=inner[a] & inner[b],
                     outer=outer[a] & outer[b], cross=valid & (dy != 0))
        for key, mask in masks.items():
            r = raw[key]
            r['n'] += int(mask.sum())
            r['soft_squared_error'] += float(np.square(dp[mask] - dy[mask]).sum())
            r['soft_abs_difference'] += float(np.abs(dp[mask]).sum())
            r['hard_squared_error'] += int(np.square(dh[mask] - dy[mask]).sum())
            r['disagree'] += int(((dh != 0) & mask).sum())
            r['both_correct'] += int(((hard[a] == y[a]) & (hard[b] == y[b]) & mask).sum())
            r['both_wrong'] += int(((hard[a] != y[a]) & (hard[b] != y[b]) & mask).sum())
            r['correct_transition'] += int(((dh == dy) & (dy != 0) & mask).sum())
            r['reversed_transition'] += int(((dh == -dy) & (dy != 0) & mask).sum())
            r['aligned_soft_jump'] += float((dp[mask] * dy[mask]).sum())
    result = {}
    for key, r in raw.items():
        result[key + '_face_count'] = r['n']
        for field, v in r.items():
            if field != 'n':
                result[key + '_' + field] = v / r['n'] if r['n'] else None
    for key, mask in dict(all=np.ones_like(y), inner=inner, outer=outer).items():
        result[key + '_fp'] = int((hard & ~y & mask).sum())
        result[key + '_fn'] = int((~hard & y & mask).sum())
        result[key + '_voxel_count'] = int(mask.sum())
    result['predicted_foreground_voxels'] = int(hard.sum())
    result['gt_foreground_voxels'] = int(y.sum())
    result['union_dice'] = float(2 * (hard & y).sum() / max(int(hard.sum() + y.sum()), 1))
    result['macro_dice'] = float(np.mean([2 * ((pred == c) & (truth == c)).sum() /
        max(int((pred == c).sum() + (truth == c).sum()), 1) for c in (1, 2)]))
    cross = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1)
    components, n = ndi.label(hard, cross)
    sizes = np.bincount(components.ravel())[1:]
    result['foreground_components_6'] = int(n)
    result['foreground_outside_largest_6'] = int(sizes.sum() - sizes.max()) if n else 0
    result['foreground_outside_largest_fraction_6'] = result['foreground_outside_largest_6'] / max(int(hard.sum()), 1)
    result['foreground_singletons_6'] = int((sizes == 1).sum())
    result['gt_components_6'] = int(ndi.label(y, cross)[1])
    result['enclosed_background_voxels_6'] = int((ndi.binary_fill_holes(hard, cross) & ~hard).sum())
    return result


def volume_match(p, count):
    """Exactly match another model's foreground volume using probability ranks.

    This descriptive control uses no GT to select a threshold. It changes the
    decision rule from the original three-class argmax, so is not a new model.
    """
    flat = p.ravel()
    mask = np.zeros(flat.size, dtype=np.uint8)
    if count:
        ids = np.argpartition(flat, flat.size - count)[flat.size - count:]
        mask[ids] = 1
    return mask.reshape(p.shape)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--base', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    import torch
    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
    frozen = args.base / 'edge_lowdata_folds12_20260924_01/source'
    sys.path[:0] = [str(frozen), str(frozen / 'scripts')]
    from thesis.new_constraints import train_swinunetr_constraints as trainer
    from train_edge_lowdata import data_arguments
    device = torch.device('cuda')
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    bindings, rows = [], []

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import numpy as np


KEYS = ['macro_dice', 'union_dice', 'all_fp', 'all_fn',
        'all_soft_squared_error', 'inner_soft_squared_error', 'outer_soft_squared_error',
        'cross_soft_squared_error', 'inner_disagree', 'outer_disagree',
        'inner_both_correct', 'outer_both_correct', 'inner_both_wrong', 'outer_both_wrong',
        'cross_correct_transition', 'cross_reversed_transition', 'cross_aligned_soft_jump',
        'foreground_components_6', 'foreground_outside_largest_6',

HIGHER = {'macro_dice', 'union_dice', 'inner_both_correct', 'outer_both_correct',
          'cross_correct_transition', 'cross_aligned_soft_jump'}
METHODS = ['dice', 'bands', 'edge', 'dice_volume_matched']


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('directory', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rows = json.loads((args.directory / 'cases.json').read_text())
    complete = json.loads((args.directory / 'completion.json').read_text())
    assert complete['status'] == 'complete' and complete['model_count'] == 27
    assert len(rows) == 9 * 4 * 62
    index = {(r['split'], r['fold'], r['seed'], r['method'], r['case_name']): r['metrics'] for r in rows}
    assert len(index) == len(rows)
    names = {split: {f: sorted({r['case_name'] for r in rows if r['split'] == split and r['fold'] == f})
                     for f in range(3)} for split in ('train', 'validation')}
    summary = {'completion': complete, 'splits': {}}
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20260928)
    for split, folds in names.items():
        n = 52 if split == 'validation' else 10
        assert all(len(ids) == n for ids in folds.values())
        unique = sorted(set().union(*map(set, folds.values())))
        overlap = sum(map(len, folds.values())) - len(unique)
        result = dict(unique_case_ids=len(unique), repeated_ids_across_folds=overlap, methods={}, contrasts={}, runs=[])
        arrays = {}
        for method in METHODS:
            arrays[method] = {}
            for metric in KEYS:
                if method == 'dice_volume_matched' and metric == 'macro_dice':
                    continue
                a = np.array([[[index[split, f, s, method, name][metric] for name in folds[f]]
                              for s in range(3)] for f in range(3)], dtype=float)
                assert np.isfinite(a).all(), (method, metric)
                arrays[method][metric] = a
            result['methods'][method] = {k: float(a.mean()) for k, a in arrays[method].items()}
            for f in range(3):
                for s in range(3):
                    result['runs'].append(dict(fold=f, seed=s, method=method,
                         metrics={k: float(a[f, s].mean()) for k, a in arrays[method].items()}))
        if overlap:
            # Shared case weights preserve dependence when a case appears in
            # several folds. Fold means remain equally weighted.
            weights = rng.exponential(size=(10000, len(unique)))
            loc = {name: j for j, name in enumerate(unique)}
            fw = [weights[:, [loc[name] for name in folds[f]]] for f in range(3)]
            fw = [w / w.sum(1, keepdims=True) for w in fw]
            result['bootstrap'] = 'Shared exponential case weights across overlapping folds; seeds averaged first; equal fold means.'
        else:
            draws = [rng.integers(0, n, size=(10000, n)) for f in range(3)]
            result['bootstrap'] = 'Paired case bootstrap within each fold; seeds averaged first; equal fold means; 10000 replicates.'
        for candidate, reference in [('edge', 'dice'), ('edge', 'bands'), ('bands', 'dice'), ('edge', 'dice_volume_matched')]:
            comparison = {}
            for metric in arrays[candidate].keys() & arrays[reference].keys():
                d = arrays[candidate][metric] - arrays[reference][metric]
                seed_mean = d.mean(1)
                if overlap:
                    sampled = np.mean([fw[f] @ seed_mean[f] for f in range(3)], axis=0)
                else:
                    sampled = np.mean([seed_mean[f][draws[f]].mean(1) for f in range(3)], axis=0)
                run_delta = d.mean(2)
                comparison[metric] = dict(delta=float(d.mean()),
                    interval95=np.quantile(sampled, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
                    fold_deltas=d.mean((1, 2)).tolist(), run_deltas=run_delta.tolist(),
                    runs_improved=int(((run_delta > 0) if metric in HIGHER else (run_delta < 0)).sum()),
                    cases_improved=int(((seed_mean > 0) if metric in HIGHER else (seed_mean < 0)).sum()),
                    cases_tied=int((seed_mean == 0).sum()))
            result['contrasts'][candidate + '_vs_' + reference] = comparison
        summary['splits'][split] = result
    drift = [abs(r['metrics']['macro_dice_minus_historical_audit']) for r in rows if r['method'] != 'dice_volume_matched']
    summary['historical_dice_max_absolute_drift'] = max(drift)

proposed probability-space edge consistency on the existing network output;
no auxiliary head and no degree-dependent voxel weighting.

the union of the existing two-step inner and outer bands. Positive-axis faces
are counted once, with an unweighted mean over faces per case and an equal
mean over valid cases. GT geometry is recomputed after augmentation. Dice and
ordinary bands remain the base objective; degree weighting stays disabled.

Stage 1 is a training-only diagnostic, not another validation sweep. Use the
32 training cases and deterministic mild_v1 views already registered in the
degree-band calibration, with input, split and checkpoint hashes checked.

edge/base logit-gradient RMS ratio 0.1, capped at p95 ratio 0.5. Base means
Dice plus ordinary bands, retaining the historical bands coefficient exactly.
No new baseline or calibration-source training is performed.

At the existing converged early-stopped ordinary-bands checkpoint, measure
raw gradient norms, edge/base gradient cosine, first-order directions on

calculations; no model parameters are changed.

# Signed face-contrast experiment

Requested after degree weighting failed to reduce boundary errors. Test the
proposed probability-space edge consistency on the existing network output;
no auxiliary head and no degree-dependent voxel weighting.

For whole hippocampus foreground y and p=p_A+p_P, penalize
`((p_i-p_j)-(y_i-y_j))**2` on face-adjacent pairs with **both** endpoints in
the union of the existing two-step inner and outer bands. Positive-axis faces
are counted once, with an unweighted mean over faces per case and an equal
mean over valid cases. GT geometry is recomputed after augmentation. Dice and
ordinary bands remain the base objective; degree weighting stays disabled.

Stage 1 is a training-only diagnostic, not another validation sweep. Use the
32 training cases and deterministic mild_v1 views already registered in the
degree-band calibration, with input, split and checkpoint hashes checked.
Calibrate edge lambda from the existing epoch-five Dice checkpoint to median
edge/base logit-gradient RMS ratio 0.1, capped at p95 ratio 0.5. Base means
Dice plus ordinary bands, retaining the historical bands coefficient exactly.
No new baseline or calibration-source training is performed.

At the existing converged early-stopped ordinary-bands checkpoint, measure
raw gradient norms, edge/base gradient cosine, first-order directions on
missed/extra foreground, and paired logit interventions. Update sizes 0.25
and 1.0 use the same base-gradient maximum for base and base+lambda*edge;
size 4.0 is a stress diagnostic only. All interventions are temporary tensor
calculations; no model parameters are changed.

Predeclared gate for a subsequent controlled training run:

- All gradients finite and nonzero; mean gradient cosine nonnegative.
- At both small steps, combined loss causes no increase over the base update
  in either pooled inner FN or outer FP, and no increase in total class errors.
- At least one small step strictly reduces pooled inner-FN plus outer-FP.

This is a conservative screening rule, not a proof that a failed candidate
could never help training, or that a passing candidate will generalize.
It specifically avoids accepting the missed-foreground/false-positive trade
observed with degree weighting. Failure stops promotion under this protocol;
do not switch loss formulations or tune lambda based on the outcome.

If it passes, train one seed-0 fold-0 Dice+ordinary-bands+edge model with the
existing augmentation and optimizer settings, using the same early stopping
(patience 8, minimum 25 epochs, delta 0.0005, maximum 50). Reuse the existing
Dice and Dice+bands controls, and assess paired boundary corrections on the
same validation cases. Record that the development fold has already been used.
