def audit_head(probe,cases,device):
    probe.eval()
    activation,receivers=activation_audit(probe,cases,device)
    params=tuple(p for p in probe.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    size=sum(p.numel() for p in params)
    gradients={name:torch.zeros(size,device=device) for name in NAMES}
    readouts={name:torch.zeros(size,device=device) for name in RECEIVERS}
    receiver_counts={name:sum(int(rr[i].sum()) for rr in receivers) for i,name in enumerate(RECEIVERS)}
    contributions={name:dict(rays=0,loss=0.,lower_hinge=0.,upper_hinge=0.,tie=0.,infeasible_zero=0.,
                            direct_output_gradient_sum=0.) for name in NAMES}
    baseline={name:0. for name in NAMES}
    full_gradient=torch.zeros(size,device=device)
    for case,receiver in zip(cases,receivers):
        delta=bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(case,device))
        groups,target,weight=partition(case,device)
        weight=weight/len(cases)
        components=loss_terms(delta,target)
        per_ray=sum(components.values())
        expected=interval_loss(delta,target,tuple(g.to(device) for g in case['groups']))/len(cases)
        torch.testing.assert_close((per_ray*weight).sum(),expected,atol=1e-7,rtol=1e-5)
        full_gradient+=flat_gradient(expected,params)
        base_per_ray=sum(loss_terms(torch.zeros_like(delta),target).values())
        for name,group in zip(NAMES,groups):
            value=(per_ray*weight*group).sum()
            gradients[name]+=flat_gradient(value,params)
            contributions[name]['rays']+=int(group.sum())
            contributions[name]['loss']+=float(value.detach())
            for term,v in components.items():
                contributions[name][term]+=float((v*weight*group).sum().detach())
            direct=torch.autograd.grad(value,delta,retain_graph=True)[0]
            contributions[name]['direct_output_gradient_sum']+=float(direct.sum())
            baseline[name]+=float((base_per_ray*weight*group).sum())
        for i,name in enumerate(RECEIVERS):
            if receiver_counts[name]:
                readouts[name]+=flat_gradient(delta[receiver[i].to(device)].sum()/receiver_counts[name],params)
        del delta,per_ray,components,expected
    total=sum(gradients.values())
    torch.testing.assert_close(total,full_gradient,atol=2e-6,rtol=5e-4)
    norms={name:float(g.norm()) for name,g in gradients.items()}
    total_norm=float(total.norm())
    cosines={a:{b:float(torch.dot(ga,gb)/(ga.norm()*gb.norm())) if norms[a]>1e-12 and norms[b]>1e-12 else None
        for b,gb in gradients.items()} for a,ga in gradients.items()}
    response={}
    for name,h in readouts.items():
        response[name]=dict(rays=receiver_counts[name],
            normalized_total_sgd_response=float(-torch.dot(h,total)/total.norm()) if total_norm>1e-12 else None,
            source_contributions={g:float(-torch.dot(h,v)/total.norm()) if total_norm>1e-12 else None
                                  for g,v in gradients.items()})
    return dict(loss_contributions=contributions,zero_correction_loss=baseline,
                total_loss=sum(v['loss'] for v in contributions.values()),
                gradient_norms=norms,total_gradient_norm=total_norm,
                gradient_cosines=cosines,parameter_response=response,activation=activation)

# Frozen-head loss, activation and gradient audit

Written before execution. Audit the 24 final heads of job 666786 on exactly
their four fitting cases per fold (seven distinct cases across folds). No
training, checkpoint reselection, inner or outer evaluation.

Decompose the original case/group-balanced interval objective exactly into six
disjoint groups: initially missed feasible thin rays, initially missed infeasible
thin rays, initially overlapping thin rays, other true rays, hard-empty rays,
and other empty rays. Preserve original four-group normalization; splitting a
group for reporting must not increase its loss weight. Split each contribution
into lower hinge, upper hinge, tie and infeasible-zero terms. Assert the losses
and parameter gradients sum back to the unchanged original objective. Compare
paired state-input versus original-input contributions and zero-correction loss.

For currently unrescued feasible thin rays, report distance in residual logits
to the safe rescue lower bound, allowed interval width and the derivative of the
bounded tanh correction. Report fractions of gaps within .01,.1,.25,.5,1,2 logits.
These label-defined measurements are retrospective diagnostics, not features.

Report actual masks for unchanged learned corrections and fixed +0.25/+0.5-logit
increments, clipped to the original domain. Also evaluate a explicitly
non-deployable oracle: increase only currently unrescued feasible true thin rays
to their target lower bound, leaving every other learned correction unchanged.
Assert that this oracle adds no FP voxel or true deletion relative to the learned
mask. It quantifies available selective rescue, not a deployable result or the
share of total ASSD attributable to thin rays. No ASSD is recomputed.

At each saved head, compute gradients for each weighted group contribution,
their norms and pairwise cosines. Compute derivatives of the mean correction
on currently unrescued feasible thin rays, hard-empty rays and already-overlapping
thin rays, pooling each receiver's rays over the four cases. Report the signed
first-order response to minus the total gradient normalized to unit parameter
L2 norm, and each loss group's additive contribution to that same direction.
Positive response means increased mean correction. Direct loss gradients with
respect to correction are reported separately. This is a local SGD diagnostic,
not an AdamW update, historical causal reconstruction or training forecast.
Saved optimizer states are not available and no parameter update is performed.

Numerical amendment after job 666811 stopped on a componentwise float32
gradient check: record reconstruction L2 error relative to the sum of subgroup
norms and the total norm. Require error <= 1e-5 times subgroup-norm sum + 1e-7.
Use the directly computed original-objective gradient for the total direction;
suppress signed responses if its norm is not at least ten times reconstruction
error. Record maximum absolute error as well. This changes diagnostic numerical
validation only, not model weights, loss definitions or subgroup weighting.

Discriminating findings:

- Concentrated loss reduction on feasible missed thin rays supports improvement
  on the intended target, but must be checked against actual threshold crossings.
- Small gaps with unsaturated correction suggest threshold placement is an
  actionable issue; large gaps refute a merely numerical near-threshold account.
- Opposing group gradients and adverse shared-parameter response despite the
  desired direct output signal support local gradient interference.
- Saturation, zero gradients or missing signal suggest different mechanisms.
  None alone establishes the cause of earlier training failures.

Report all heads, paired fold/seed differences and heterogeneous signs. Verify
source/input/checkpoint hashes and reproduce saved fitting losses. Export only
non-identifying aggregates under the user's authorization for current and future
aggregate reports in this investigation. Keep images and individual case records
on the cluster; preserve every saved model.

"""Check whether the eight-case oracle has unusually weak gains versus all 208."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
import torch

from semantic_constraints.pca_refiner.fit_eight import prepare_training
from semantic_constraints.spline_refinement.train import signed_distance, dice, write_json
from semantic_constraints.spectral_shape.audit import SIZE, shift_into_canvas, band_fit


def summarize(rows):
    gain = np.array([r["gain"] for r in rows])
    return dict(cases=len(rows), mean_baseline_dice=float(np.mean([r["baseline_dice"] for r in rows])),
        mean_oracle_dice=float(np.mean([r["oracle_dice"] for r in rows])), mean_gain=float(gain.mean()),
        median_gain=float(np.median(gain)), gain_quantiles=np.quantile(gain, [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]).tolist(),
        improved=int((gain > 1e-10).sum()), worsened=int((gain < -1e-10).sum()),
        unchanged=int((abs(gain) <= 1e-10).sum()), gain_at_least_0p1_percentage_points=int((gain >= .001).sum()),
        gain_at_least_1_percentage_point=int((gain >= .01).sum()),
        fixed=sum(r["fixed"] for r in rows), introduced=sum(r["introduced"] for r in rows))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for key in ("checkpoint", "pkl", "splits", "basis", "protocol", "output"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{key}", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert not args.output.exists()
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    selected = set(json.loads(args.protocol.read_text())["selected"])
    basis = torch.load(args.basis, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    records, provenance = prepare_training(args, device)
    rows = []
    for record in records:
        original = record["prediction"] > 0
        shift = np.rint((SIZE-1)/2 - np.argwhere(original).mean(0)).astype(int)
        p = shift_into_canvas(original, shift)
        g = shift_into_canvas(record["truth"] > 0, shift)
        support = ndi.binary_dilation(p, iterations=2) & ~ndi.binary_erosion(p, iterations=2)
        source = np.clip(signed_distance(p), -8, 8)
        residual = np.clip(signed_distance(g), -8, 8) - source
        idx = torch.from_numpy(np.flatnonzero(support)).to(device)
        design = basis["modes"][:, idx].T
        target = torch.from_numpy(residual[support]).to(device)
        delta, coefficients = band_fit(design, target, basis["error_mean"][idx])
        mask = p.copy()
        mask[support] = source[support] + delta.cpu().numpy() < 0
        baseline, oracle = dice(p, g), dice(mask, g)
        rows.append(dict(case=record["name"], selected=record["name"] in selected,
            baseline_dice=baseline, oracle_dice=oracle, gain=oracle-baseline,
            fixed=int(((p != g) & (mask == g)).sum()), introduced=int(((p == g) & (mask != g)).sum()),
            outside_band_changes=int(((p != mask) & ~support).sum())))
    result = dict(all_training=summarize(rows), selected_eight=summarize([r for r in rows if r["selected"]]),
                  other_200=summarize([r for r in rows if not r["selected"]]), cases=rows,
                  provenance=provenance, purpose="Post-hoc teacher-strength diagnostic, no network training or validation use")
    write_json(args.output, result)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in ("cases", "provenance")}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Evaluate the frozen eight-case coefficient regressor on fold-0 validation."""
import argparse
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
import torch
from monai.networks.nets import SwinUNETR

from baselines.swin_unetr.swin_unetr import _build_monai_dataset_from_pkl, _load_pkl_dataframe
from semantic_constraints.pca_refiner.fit_eight import CoefficientRegressor, translate_image
from semantic_constraints.spectral_shape.audit import SIZE, shift_into_canvas
from semantic_constraints.spline_refinement.train import (
    EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT, EXPECTED_DATA, EXPECTED_SPLITS, sha256, signed_distance,
    dice, surface_distances, restore_labels, write_json,
)


@torch.inference_mode()
def refine(image, prediction, probability, model, basis, device):
    """Predict a correction using image and baseline outputs only; no annotation."""
    foreground = prediction > 0
    assert foreground.any()
    shift = np.rint((SIZE - 1) / 2 - np.argwhere(foreground).mean(0)).astype(int)
    original = shift_into_canvas(prediction, shift)
    foreground = original > 0
    source = np.clip(signed_distance(foreground), -8, 8)
    inner = foreground & ~ndi.binary_erosion(foreground, iterations=2)
    outer = ndi.binary_dilation(foreground, iterations=2) & ~foreground
    support = inner | outer
    features = np.stack((translate_image(image, shift), translate_image(probability, shift),
                         np.clip(source / 4, -1, 1), inner, outer)).astype(np.float32)
    normalized = model(torch.from_numpy(features)[None].to(device))[0]
    coefficients = normalized / basis["common_scale"]
    delta = (coefficients @ basis["modes"] + basis["error_mean"]).cpu().numpy().reshape(source.shape)
    assert np.isfinite(delta).all()
    mask = np.where(support, source + delta < 0, foreground)
    labels = restore_labels(mask, original)
    assert np.array_equal(labels[~support], original[~support])
    retained = foreground & mask
    assert np.array_equal(labels[retained], original[retained])
    return dict(prediction=original, refined=labels, support=support, shift=shift,
                coefficients=coefficients.cpu().numpy())


def score(name, data, truth):
    original, corrected = data["prediction"] > 0, data["refined"] > 0
    row = dict(case=name, baseline_dice=dice(original, truth), refined_dice=dice(corrected, truth),
               fixed=int(((original != truth) & (corrected == truth)).sum()),
               introduced=int(((original == truth) & (corrected != truth)).sum()),
               changed=int((original != corrected).sum()),
               outside_band_changes=int(((original != corrected) & ~data["support"]).sum()))
    row["gain"] = row["refined_dice"] - row["baseline_dice"]
    for label, mask in (("baseline", original), ("refined", corrected)):
        row[f"{label}_assd_mm"], row[f"{label}_hd95_mm"] = surface_distances(mask, truth)
        row[f"{label}_components"] = int(ndi.label(mask)[1])
    return row


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for key in ("checkpoint", "pkl", "splits", "refiner", "basis", "protocol", "output"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{key}", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (args.output / "cases").mkdir()
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    hashes = {key: sha256(getattr(args, key)) for key in
              ("checkpoint", "pkl", "splits", "refiner", "basis", "protocol")}
    assert hashes["checkpoint"] == EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT
    assert hashes["pkl"] == EXPECTED_DATA and hashes["splits"] == EXPECTED_SPLITS
    fold = json.loads(args.splits.read_text())[0]
    protocol = json.loads(args.protocol.read_text())
    assert fold == protocol["split"]
    assert len(fold["val"]) == 52 and len(fold["train"]) == 208
    assert set(protocol["selected"]) <= set(fold["train"])
    assert not set(fold["train"]) & set(fold["val"])
    assert protocol["validation_used"] is False
    dataset = _build_monai_dataset_from_pkl(_load_pkl_dataframe(args.pkl), "MSD", 3)
    options = dict(in_channels=1, out_channels=3, use_checkpoint=False, drop_rate=0.)
    if "img_size" in inspect.signature(SwinUNETR).parameters:
        options["img_size"] = (64, 64, 64)
    baseline = SwinUNETR(**options).to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)
    baseline_state = torch.load(args.checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    baseline.load_state_dict(baseline_state.get("model", baseline_state), strict=True)
    del baseline_state
    model = CoefficientRegressor().to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)
    state = torch.load(args.refiner, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    model.load_state_dict(state["model"], strict=True)
    basis = torch.load(args.basis, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    assert basis["modes"].shape == (32, SIZE ** 3)
    rows = []
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for index, item in enumerate(dataset.data):
            name = item["case_name"]
            if name not in fold["val"]:
                continue
            sample = dataset[index]
            image = sample["image"].as_tensor().float()
            logits = baseline(image[None].to(device)).float()
            prediction = logits.argmax(1)[0].cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)
            probability = logits.softmax(1)[0, 1:].sum(0).cpu().numpy()
            data = refine(image[0].numpy(), prediction, probability, model, basis, device)
            # Annotation is accessed for scoring only after the output is fixed.
            labels = sample["label"].as_tensor()[0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
            truth = shift_into_canvas(labels, data["shift"])
            rows.append(score(name, data, truth > 0))
            np.savez_compressed(args.output / "cases" / f"{name}.npz", **data, truth=truth)
            print("VALIDATION", len(rows), "/52", json.dumps(rows[-1]), flush=True)
    assert {r["case"] for r in rows} == set(fold["val"])
    differences = np.array([r["gain"] for r in rows])
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    bootstrap = rng.choice(differences, size=(10000, len(rows)), replace=True).mean(1)
    summary = {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows])) for key in (
        "baseline_dice", "refined_dice", "baseline_assd_mm", "refined_assd_mm",
        "baseline_hd95_mm", "refined_hd95_mm")}
    assert abs(summary["baseline_dice"] - 0.9009775183944705) < 1e-10
    summary.update(cases=52, mean_dice_gain=float(differences.mean()),
        paired_bootstrap_95_ci=np.quantile(bootstrap, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
        improved=int((differences > 1e-10).sum()), worsened=int((differences < -1e-10).sum()),
        unchanged=int((np.abs(differences) <= 1e-10).sum()),
        fixed=sum(r["fixed"] for r in rows), introduced=sum(r["introduced"] for r in rows),
        outside_band_changes=sum(r["outside_band_changes"] for r in rows))
    # Evaluation must not modify the frozen artifacts.
    for key in ("refiner", "basis", "protocol"):
        assert hashes[key] == sha256(getattr(args, key))
    result = dict(summary=summary, cases=rows, hashes=hashes, split=fold,
        refiner_training_cases=protocol["selected"], basis_training_cases=208,
        checkpoint_step=state["step"], validation_fitting=False, oracle_fitting=False,
        coefficient_scaling="unchanged training common_scale", threshold=0,
        checkpoint_selection="lowest training field MSE; fixed before validation",
        source_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)), gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
        torch_version=torch.__version__)
    write_json(args.output / "results.json", result)
    print("COMPLETE", json.dumps(summary), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Recompute validation Dice and constraints from saved label volumes."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi


def main():
    root = Path(sys.argv[1])
    result = json.loads((root / "results.json").read_text())
    assert len(result["cases"]) == 52
    assert {r["case"] for r in result["cases"]} == set(result["split"]["val"])
    assert not set(result["refiner_training_cases"]) & set(result["split"]["val"])
    assert result["validation_fitting"] is False and result["oracle_fitting"] is False
    for row in result["cases"]:
        with np.load(root / "cases" / f"{row['case']}.npz") as data:
            original, refined, truth = data["prediction"], data["refined"], data["truth"] > 0
            p, q = original > 0, refined > 0
            support = ndi.binary_dilation(p, iterations=2) & ~ndi.binary_erosion(p, iterations=2)
            assert np.array_equal(support, data["support"])
            assert np.array_equal(original[~support], refined[~support])
            retained = p & q
            assert np.array_equal(original[retained], refined[retained])
            for key, mask in (("baseline", p), ("refined", q)):
                score = 2 * (mask & truth).sum() / (mask.sum() + truth.sum())
                assert abs(score - row[f"{key}_dice"]) < 1e-8
            assert row["fixed"] == int(((p != truth) & (q == truth)).sum())
            assert row["introduced"] == int(((p == truth) & (q != truth)).sum())
            assert row["changed"] == row["fixed"] + row["introduced"]
    for key in ("baseline_dice", "refined_dice"):

    verification = dict(cases=52, train_validation_disjoint=True,
        independent_dice_and_error_counts=True, exact_outside_band_labels=True,
        exact_retained_ap_labels=True)
    (root / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(verification, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(verification), flush=True)

    main()

# Full fold-0 PCA coefficient refiner

Train the 32-mode anatomical correction regressor on all 208 training cases,
then evaluate the frozen model on all 52 validation cases. This extends the
eight-case fitting diagnostic without replacing learned validation evaluation
with annotation-guided oracle scores.

## Protocol fixed before training

- Same canonical Dice-only, no-augmentation, early-stopped baseline checkpoint,
  historical data, and fold-0 split; all three hashes checked.
- Fresh seed-0 CNN initialization; no continuation from the eight-case model.
- All 208 training cases provide CNN examples, anatomical PCA directions,
  mean-error offset, and annotation-guided coefficient targets. No validation
  subject contributes to any of those quantities.
- Same 32-mode signed-distance representation, prediction-centroid integer
  alignment into an 80-cubed canvas, +/-8 clipping, and two-step prediction bands.
- Same five inputs and architecture: MRI, foreground probability, source SDF/4
  clipped to [-1, 1], inner band, outer band; stride-2 convolutions with channels
  16/32/64/64, GroupNorm/GELU, spatial pooling to 4 cubed, 4096->128->32 head.
- Same annotation-guided target fitting: per-case band least squares with
  per-mode RMS normalization and ridge 0.001. CNN coefficient normalization
  uses the union of predicted bands across all 208 training cases.
- Same objective: mean per-case normalized oracle-field MSE, with denominator
  floor 0.0001, plus 0.05 whole-foreground soft Dice loss. No augmentation.
- Adam, initial lr 0.0003 cosine-decaying to 0.000003, gradient clip 5, FP32,
  no weight decay; 200 epochs, batch 8, 26 batches/epoch, 5,200 updates. Each
  epoch uses a fresh seed-0 permutation covering every training case once.
- Evaluate training metrics every five epochs, including epoch zero. Select
  the checkpoint with lowest training normalized field MSE. No validation
  early stopping, checkpoint selection, coefficient fitting, or tuning.
- Preserve labels outside the prediction bands and AP labels on retained
  foreground; newly added foreground receives its nearest original AP label.
- After training and independent training-output verification, freeze all
  artifacts and evaluate all 52 validation subjects. Annotation access is only
  for scoring after predictions are fixed. The refiner has no annotation input.
- Primary endpoint: mean foreground Dice excluding background, paired against
  the baseline. Secondary: ASSD, HD95, improved/worsened/unchanged subjects,
  errors fixed/introduced, and a paired subject bootstrap (10,000, seed 0).
- Save and independently verify masks, metrics, outside-band preservation, and
  retained AP labels. Confirm frozen-artifact hashes and canonical baseline Dice.

All computation, including unit checks and verification, runs in one `sbatch`
job. The baseline stays frozen. Its training predictions are in-sample; this
run tests the requested direct training setup, without out-of-fold retraining.
The model changes distance fields, with no claim of invertibility or guaranteed
topology preservation. Validation has been used for earlier experiments and is
not a final untouched test set.

"""Measure saved correction directions and fixed amplification diagnostics."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
import torch

CONSTANT_MAGNITUDES = (.25, .6, .8, 1., 1.2, 1.6, 2.)


def sdf(mask):
    return np.clip(np.where(mask, -(ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask) - .5),
                           ndi.distance_transform_edt(~mask) - .5), -8, 8).astype(np.float32)


def ratio(numerator, denominator):
    return float(numerator / denominator) if denominator else None


def dice(mask, truth):
    return float(2 * (mask & truth).sum() / (mask.sum() + truth.sum()))


def mask_score(p, g, support, source, correction):
    mask = p.copy()
    mask[support] = source[support] + correction < 0
    assert np.array_equal(mask[~support], p[~support])
    changed = mask != p
    fixed = int((changed & (mask == g)).sum())
    introduced = int((changed & (mask != g)).sum())
    assert fixed + introduced == int(changed.sum())
    added, removed = mask & ~p, p & ~mask
    return dict(dice=dice(mask, g), gain=dice(mask, g)-dice(p, g),
        fixed=fixed, introduced=introduced, changed=int(changed.sum()),
        correct_additions=int((added & g).sum()), incorrect_additions=int((added & ~g).sum()),
        correct_removals=int((removed & ~g).sum()), incorrect_removals=int((removed & g).sum()))


def summarize(rows, magnitudes):
    methods = {}
    for method in rows[0]["methods"]:
        items = [r["methods"][method] for r in rows]
        gains = np.array([r["gain"] for r in items])
        fixed, introduced = sum(r["fixed"] for r in items), sum(r["introduced"] for r in items)
        bootstrap = np.random.default_rng(0).choice(gains, (5000, len(rows)), replace=True).mean(1)
        methods[method] = dict(mean_dice=float(np.mean([r["dice"] for r in items])),
            mean_gain=float(gains.mean()), paired_bootstrap_95_ci=np.quantile(bootstrap, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
            fixed=fixed, introduced=introduced, edit_precision=ratio(fixed, fixed+introduced),
            improved=int((gains > 1e-10).sum()), worsened=int((gains < -1e-10).sum()),
            unchanged=int((np.abs(gains) <= 1e-10).sum()))
        for key in ("correct_additions", "incorrect_additions", "correct_removals", "incorrect_removals"):
            methods[method][key] = sum(r[key] for r in items)
    counts = {key: sum(r[key] for r in rows) for key in (
        "total_errors", "band_errors", "band_false_positives", "band_false_negatives",
        "fp_direction_right", "fn_direction_right", "error_direction_zero", "band_voxels",
        "target_nonzero_voxels", "target_sign_agrees", "distance_error_reduced_voxels")}
    energy = sum(r["target_squared_norm"] for r in rows)
    predicted_energy = sum(r["predicted_squared_norm"] for r in rows)
    dot = sum(r["predicted_target_dot"] for r in rows)
    return dict(cases=len(rows), baseline_dice=float(np.mean([r["baseline_dice"] for r in rows])),
        **counts,
        right_direction_on_errors=ratio(counts["fp_direction_right"]+counts["fn_direction_right"], counts["band_errors"]),
        right_direction_on_fp=ratio(counts["fp_direction_right"], counts["band_false_positives"]),
        right_direction_on_fn=ratio(counts["fn_direction_right"], counts["band_false_negatives"]),
        signed_distance_direction_agreement=ratio(counts["target_sign_agrees"], counts["target_nonzero_voxels"]),
        baseline_band_sdf_mse=ratio(energy, counts["band_voxels"]),
        corrected_band_sdf_mse=ratio(sum(r["remaining_squared_norm"] for r in rows), counts["band_voxels"]),
        pooled_field_cosine=ratio(dot, np.sqrt(energy*predicted_energy)),
        absolute_correction_quantiles_mm=dict(zip(("minimum", "median", "p90", "p99", "maximum"),
            np.quantile(np.concatenate(magnitudes), [0, .5, .9, .99, 1]).tolist())),
        methods=methods)


def analyze(root, modes, offset):
    rows, magnitudes = [], []
    for path in sorted((root / "cases").glob("*.npz")):
        with np.load(path) as saved:
            p, g, support = saved["prediction"] > 0, saved["truth"] > 0, saved["support"]
            source, target = sdf(p), sdf(g)
            indices = np.flatnonzero(support)
            delta = saved["coefficients"] @ modes[:, indices] + offset[indices]
            reconstructed = p.copy()
            reconstructed[support] = source[support] + delta < 0
            assert np.array_equal(reconstructed, saved["refined"] > 0)
            assert np.isfinite(delta).all()
            residual = target[support] - source[support]
            pb, gb = p[support], g[support]
            fp, fn = pb & ~gb, ~pb & gb
            err = fp | fn
            needed = np.abs(residual) > 1e-6
            row = dict(case=path.stem, baseline_dice=dice(p, g),
                total_errors=int((p != g).sum()), band_errors=int(err.sum()),
                band_false_positives=int(fp.sum()), band_false_negatives=int(fn.sum()),
                fp_direction_right=int((fp & (delta > 0)).sum()),
                fn_direction_right=int((fn & (delta < 0)).sum()),
                error_direction_zero=int((err & (delta == 0)).sum()),
                band_voxels=int(support.sum()), target_nonzero_voxels=int(needed.sum()),
                target_sign_agrees=int((needed & (delta*residual > 0)).sum()),
                distance_error_reduced_voxels=int((np.abs(residual-delta) < np.abs(residual)).sum()),
                target_squared_norm=float(np.square(residual.astype(np.float64)).sum()),
                predicted_squared_norm=float(np.square(delta.astype(np.float64)).sum()),
                remaining_squared_norm=float(np.square((residual-delta).astype(np.float64)).sum()),
                predicted_target_dot=float(np.dot(delta.astype(np.float64), residual.astype(np.float64))),
                methods={})
            magnitudes.append(np.abs(delta))
            for gain in (1, 2, 4, 8):
                row["methods"][f"scale_{gain}"] = mask_score(p, g, support, source, gain*delta)
            for magnitude in CONSTANT_MAGNITUDES:
                row["methods"][f"sign_{magnitude:g}mm"] = mask_score(p, g, support, source, magnitude*np.sign(delta))
            row["methods"]["sign_mean_offset"] = mask_score(p, g, support, source, np.sign(offset[indices]))
            rows.append(row)
        if len(rows) % 40 == 0:
            print("AUDIT", root.name, len(rows), flush=True)
    return rows, summarize(rows, magnitudes)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("run_root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    destination = args.run_root / "correction_accuracy.json"
    assert not destination.exists()
    basis = torch.load(args.run_root / "results" / "fixed_basis.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    modes, offset = basis["modes"].numpy(), basis["error_mean"].numpy()
    train_rows, train = analyze(args.run_root / "results", modes, offset)
    assert len(train_rows) == 208
    # This rule is fixed before validation is read. The complete sweep remains
    # an exploratory diagnostic, not an independent test-set performance claim.
    candidates = ["scale_1", "scale_2", "scale_4", "scale_8"] + [f"sign_{c:g}mm" for c in CONSTANT_MAGNITUDES]
    selected = max(candidates,
                   key=lambda name: train["methods"][name]["mean_dice"])
    val_rows, validation = analyze(args.run_root / "validation", modes, offset)
    assert len(val_rows) == 52
    assert not {r["case"] for r in train_rows} & {r["case"] for r in val_rows}
    assert abs(train["baseline_dice"] - .9383332742805718) < 1e-9
    assert abs(validation["baseline_dice"] - .9009775183944705) < 1e-9
    assert validation["methods"]["scale_1"]["fixed"] == 0
    assert validation["methods"]["scale_1"]["introduced"] == 0
    result = dict(training=train, validation=validation, selected_using_training_only=selected,
        training_cases=train_rows, validation_cases=val_rows,
        definitions=dict(edit_precision="fixed / (fixed + introduced); undefined if no edits",
            right_direction_on_errors="positive correction on false positives; negative on false negatives; pooled within prediction bands",
            amplification="multiply complete predicted SDF correction including mean-error offset",
            sign_constants="replace complete correction by c times its sign; c in .25, .6, .8, 1, 1.2, 1.6, 2 mm; zero stays zero; avoid half-voxel constants that land exactly on zero for grid-aligned boundaries",
            sign_mean_offset="annotation-free-at-inference control using the fixed training mean-error direction alone",
            caution="Post-hoc descriptive analysis of previously examined validation data; no model retraining or validation-selected scale"))
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    print("COMPLETE", json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ("training", "validation", "selected_using_training_only")}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Reconstruct validation band outputs from saved coefficients, without inference."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
import torch


def norm_summary(coefficients):
    norms = np.linalg.norm(np.stack(coefficients), axis=1)
    return dict(cases=len(norms), nonzero=int((norms > 0).sum()),
                minimum=float(norms.min()), median=float(np.median(norms)), maximum=float(norms.max()))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("run_root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    train = args.run_root / "results"
    validation = args.run_root / "validation"
    basis = torch.load(train / "fixed_basis.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    modes = basis["modes"].numpy()
    offset = basis["error_mean"].numpy()
    train_coefficients = []
    for path in sorted((train / "cases").glob("*.npz")):
        with np.load(path) as saved:
            train_coefficients.append(saved["coefficients"])
    rows, coefficients = [], []
    for path in sorted((validation / "cases").glob("*.npz")):
        with np.load(path) as saved:
            p = saved["prediction"] > 0
            support = saved["support"]
            c = saved["coefficients"]
            coefficients.append(c)
            source = np.clip(np.where(p, -(ndi.distance_transform_edt(p) - .5),
                                      ndi.distance_transform_edt(~p) - .5), -8, 8).astype(np.float32)
            indices = np.flatnonzero(support)
            delta = c @ modes[:, indices] + offset[indices]
            assert np.isfinite(delta).all() and np.isfinite(c).all()
            corrected = p.copy()
            corrected[support] = source[support] + delta < 0
            assert np.array_equal(corrected, saved["refined"] > 0)
            signed_margin = np.where(p[support], -(source[support] + delta), source[support] + delta)
            rows.append(dict(case=path.stem, coefficient_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(c)),
                band_correction_min=float(delta.min()), band_correction_max=float(delta.max()),
                band_max_abs_correction=float(np.abs(delta).max()),
                minimum_margin_to_label_change=float(signed_margin.min()),
                reconstructed_changed_voxels=int((p != corrected).sum())))
    assert len(train_coefficients) == 208 and len(coefficients) == 52
    result = dict(training_coefficient_norms=norm_summary(train_coefficients),
        validation_coefficient_norms=norm_summary(coefficients),
        distinct_validation_coefficient_vectors=int(len(np.unique(np.stack(coefficients), axis=0))),
        maximum_absolute_validation_band_correction=float(max(r["band_max_abs_correction"] for r in rows)),
        smallest_validation_margin_to_label_change=float(min(r["minimum_margin_to_label_change"] for r in rows)),
        independently_reconstructed_masks_match_saved=True, cases=rows,
        interpretation="Corrections are additive signed-distance values in mm, not guaranteed physical displacements")
    (validation / "field_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != "cases"}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())

def save(p, value):
    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')

    ap.add_argument('--home', type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)

        assert base != out and base not in out.parents
        manifest = read(base/'source/PAYLOAD.json')['files']
        for name, expected in manifest.items():
            assert sha(base/'source'/name) == expected, name
        manifests[base.name] = manifest
    # All shared inference implementations must be byte-identical.
    for name, expected in manifests[old.name].items():
        assert manifests[new.name][name] == expected, name
    sys.path[:0] = [str(new/'source'), str(new/'source/scripts')]

        for key in ('pkl', 'splits_json'):
            assert sha(config[key]) == config[key+'_sha256']
        cp_hash = sha(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt')
        assert cp_hash == done['checkpoint_sha256']
        assert sha(folder/'selected_cases.json') == done['selected_cases_sha256']
        trainer.seed_everything(0)
        train, val, _, _ = get_loaders(config)
        cp = torch.load(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt', map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
        assert cp['epoch'] == done['selected_epoch'] and cp['run'] == done['run']
        model = build_model(config, device)
        model.load_state_dict(cp['model'], strict=True)
        model.eval()
        del cp
        _, objective = objectives(config)
        bands = objective.bands
        assert bands.inner_focal_gamma == bands.outer_focal_gamma == bands.degree_alpha == 0
        assert bands.adherence_threshold == .9 and bands.steps == 2
        original = {(r['split'],r['case_name']):r['metrics'] for r in read(folder/'selected_cases.json')}
        rows = []
        for split, loader in [('train',DataLoader(train.dataset,batch_size=1,shuffle=False)),('validation',val)]:
            for batch in loader:
                with torch.inference_mode(), torch.autocast('cuda',enabled=config['run']['amp']):
                    logits = model(batch['image'].to(device))
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    result = bands(logits,batch['label'].to(device))
                p = logits[0].float().softmax(0).cpu().numpy()
                truth = batch['label'][0,0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
                pred = p.argmax(0).astype(np.uint8)
                fresh = metrics(p[1:].sum(0),pred,truth)
                name = str(batch['case_name'][0])
                b = {k:float(result.details[k][0]) for k in ('inner_loss','outer_loss','case_loss')}
                b.update(truth=float(result.truth[0]),inner_truth=float(result.value[0,0]),
                    outer_truth=float(result.value[0,1]),confidence_adherent=bool(result.details['confidence_adherent'][0]))
                # Distances are in the evaluation grid's voxel units, not millimetres.
                struct = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3,1)
                a, y = pred>0, truth>0
                sa = a & ~ndi.binary_erosion(a,struct,border_value=0)
                sy = y & ~ndi.binary_erosion(y,struct,border_value=0)
                assert sa.any() and sy.any()
                distances = np.concatenate([ndi.distance_transform_edt(~sy)[sa],ndi.distance_transform_edt(~sa)[sy]])
                surface = dict(symmetric_mean_surface_distance_voxels=float(distances.mean()),
                    symmetric_surface_distance_p95_voxels=float(np.percentile(distances,95)))
                old_metrics = original[(split,name)]
                rows.append(dict(split=split,case_name=name,bands=b,surface=surface,
                    recomputed_metrics=fresh,drift={k:fresh[k]-old_metrics[k] for k in fresh}))
        assert {(r['split'],r['case_name']) for r in rows} == set(original)
        assert sha(folder/'checkpoint_best.pt') == cp_hash
        verification['runs'][label] = dict(checkpoint_sha256=cp_hash,
            selected_epoch=done['selected_epoch'],selected_cases_sha256=done['selected_cases_sha256'],
            max_drift={k:max(abs(r['drift'][k]) for r in rows) for k in rows[0]['drift']})
        save(out/(label+'.json'),dict(label=label,selected_epoch=done['selected_epoch'],cases=rows))
        print(json.dumps(dict(label=label,cases=len(rows),max_dice_drift=verification['runs'][label]['max_drift']['macro_dice'])),flush=True)
        del model, objective, bands
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    verification.update(status='complete',training=False,outputs={p.name:sha(p) for p in out.glob('*.json')})
    save(out/'VERIFICATION.json',verification)

# PCGrad pilot: fold 0, three seeds

User-authorized follow-up to the completed separated-edge pilot. Exactly fold 0,
seeds 0/1/2, two matched arms per seed: sum and PCGrad. Six new models. No other
folds, weighting variants or algorithms launch automatically.

## Hypothesis and confirmation before fitting

At each seed's retained selected separated-control checkpoint, evaluate all ten
training cases in FP32 eval mode. Record parameter-gradient norms and pairwise
cosines for Dice, weighted bands, raw inner, outer and crossing edge rules.
The prespecified descriptive confirmation gate is inner-versus-crossing conflict
in a majority (at least 6/10) of cases in EACH seed. All three audits must finish
and pass before any new training starts. This is a confirmation of the sampled
pattern, not a significance test or a claim that gradient interference causes
validation errors. No validation cases enter this gate or any recalibration.

## Primary matched comparison

The prior separated arm supplies unchanged coefficients and reference data/source
hashes. Keep the same ten training/52 validation case files, no augmentation,
random initialization seeds, model, Dice supervision, unary bands, edge geometry,
equal one-third edge rule weights, AdamW 1e-4 / weight decay 1e-5, StepLR every
20 epochs / gamma .5, AMP, batch 1 and five-epoch auxiliary warmup. Maximum 75
epochs, minimum 60, patience 8, minimum delta .0005; select greatest validation
hard macro Dice. The original stopped/selected epochs need not equal 75.

For each batch define five weighted objectives:
1. Dice.
2. Scheduled existing weighted bands (inner and outer BCE remain combined).
3. Scheduled existing edge coefficient times inner-edge mean / 3.
4. Scheduled existing edge coefficient times outer-edge mean / 3.
5. Scheduled existing edge coefficient times crossing-edge mean / 3.

Both arms calculate the same five separate parameter gradients on the SAME AMP
forward graph. The sum control adds them directly. PCGrad symmetrically projects
each task gradient against the ORIGINAL other task gradients in an independently
randomized order, then sums the modified gradients. Zero gradients are skipped.
No mean reduction, adaptive loss weights, component normalization, protected task,
post-projection norm restoration, or clipping is added. Sequential projections
can reintroduce conflicts; do not claim all final pairwise cosines must be positive.

This follows Algorithm 1 of Yu et al., Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning:
https://arxiv.org/html/2001.06782v4 . We implement random order explicitly as in
the paper, rather than copying the reference TensorFlow code's unused shuffle
return value. Weighted losses and sum reduction preserve the prior objective
when projection is disabled. A dedicated CPU RNG seeded 20260930+training_seed
chooses projection orders; model/data RNG streams are untouched. Its state is
saved for exact resumption along with optimizer, scheduler, AMP scaler and all
other RNG state.

Separate-gradient evaluation can introduce AMP rounding differences versus one
backward call. Therefore the primary control uses the same separate-gradient path;
the completed separated runs remain a SECONDARY historical reference, and their
learning-curve drift is reported. Test summed gradients against joint derivatives.

## Mixed precision and diagnostics

Scale each task loss with the current common GradScaler, obtain parameter
derivatives, divide by that scale in FP32, project, and restore scale before one
scaler.step/update. Any nonfinite task gradient causes the WHOLE optimizer update
to be skipped through GradScaler's overflow path. Never silently discard a bad
task. Keep grad=None for parameters unused by every task. GPU preflight tests
exercise both ordinary unscaling and overflow/skip behavior before fitting.

Projection dot products use FP64 Gram accumulation in bounded chunks. An equivalent
coefficient basis avoids repeatedly projecting large full parameter vectors.
Independent explicit-vector tests verify sequential projection and sum reduction.

Every training update records weighted pre/post task Gram matrices, projection
orders/counts, coefficients, original/projected norms and angle, AMP scale and
skipped-update status, plus case identity. This covers all ten cases every epoch.
These are actual AMP-forward parameter derivatives before AdamW, not the actual
momentum/preconditioned parameter displacement. Retain the earlier two-case FP32
probes for direct comparison as well. No online coefficient changes occur.

## Outcomes

geometry at the same monitoring epochs (5,15,30,45,60,75 and final stop). Primary

# Presence mechanism: frozen development experiments

Status: specified before new checkpoint inference or training. These are internal
mechanism experiments on the reused MSD pool, not independent confirmation.
Existing A/D/E checkpoints and historical reports must never be overwritten.

## Stage 1: component interventions and surface attribution

Evaluate all 208 outer cases from folds 1–4 using saved A and E checkpoints.
Verify each checkpoint against its done.json hash, dataset/split hashes, and
reproduce the saved case-level ASSD before accepting any new results.

Prespecified E interventions: raw output; original renderer; oracle presence in
the renderer only with fitted edges fixed; oracle edges on true rays with
presence fixed; both; oracle presence in the fit only; oracle presence in fit
and renderer; unit presence only on true thin rays; edge distribution moments
without fitting; interval-distance occupancy with all predictions fixed; restore
raw masks on erased true thin rays; reference-mask replacement on missed thin,
missed thicker, empty false-positive, and present-but-wrong true rays separately.
Every intervention using reference labels is explicitly non-deployable.

Primary mechanistic outcomes: correctly overlapping thin-ray recall, thin voxel
recall, and directional ASSD contributions. Ray presence alone is insufficient.
Record empty-ray FPs, FP voxels/components, signed volume error, class/union Dice,
HD95, all-present and conditional edge MAE, and raw/rendered decision margins.
Thin means a contiguous reference interval of span 1 or 2; two disconnected
voxels are multi-run, not thin. Report border rays separately.

Partition surface contributions into empty, thin length 1, thin length 2,
length 3–5, length >=6, multi-run, and border rays. Subdivide true rays using
the original E final presence decision, fixed for every compared output.
Contributions use each method's own prediction-surface denominator and the
common reference-surface denominator, and must sum to its original ASSD.
Also report fixed-reference coverage at 0, 1, and 2 mm. Counterfactual effects
are nonadditive; they are not achievable bounds or proof of learnability.

## Stage 2: capacity versus pooling, conditional on the saved E representation

Four arms form a 2x2 comparison: width 24 or 48, with duplicated-mean pooling
or mean-plus-max pooling. Every arm is a dedicated trainable presence stem
cloned from E; the backbone, feature projection, edge distributions, fitted
edges, renderer temperature, and beta remain frozen. Presence changes only the
renderer. Thus this stage isolates classification from geometry co-adaptation.

The presence output convolution receives 2*width channels in every arm. Its
first half is initialized from E; the second half is zero. The mean control
duplicates the mean features, matching parameter count to mean-plus-max.
Width 48 uses function-preserving channel duplication with cancelling output
perturbations to break duplicate-channel gradient symmetry. Assert identical
initial presence and final masks for all arms against E.

Train all arms for 12 epochs, AdamW lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-5, batch size one
volume. Seeds 0, 1, 2 determine paired case order and symmetry-breaking noise.
Use E's 166 fitting cases; its 42 inner cases select checkpoints; the 52 outer
cases are processed only after all arm/seed selections for that fold are fixed.
The fitting data previously trained E: this is explicitly conditional on E and
may contain in-sample feature optimism. These are presence-training seeds, not
independent backbone-training seeds.

Loss: equal mean BCE over four nonempty groups per case: true thin rays,
other true rays, hard empty rays, and other empty rays. Hard empty means raw E
has any positive argmax voxel OR original E head presence >=0.5. All empty rays
receive supervision. Freeze groups from original E/reference labels; no outer
label-dependent feature construction or selection. No focal-weight grid.

At epochs 0, 4, 8, 12, evaluate unshifted head probabilities and the prespecified
presence-logit offsets -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 on inner validation only. Include
unchanged E as a fallback. Select maximum case-mean correctly overlapping
thin-ray recall subject to mean FP rays and total FP voxels <= E, mean thin
voxel recall >= E, and ASSD <= E+0.002 mm. Break ties by lower ASSD, then lower
FP rays, earlier epoch, smaller absolute offset. The 0.002 mm margin is a
development guard, not a clinical noninferiority margin. Also save unconstrained
training/inner losses and epoch-zero metrics to distinguish optimization
failure, overfitting, and failure of the operating constraint.

Report selected and final uncalibrated heads, not just fallback-selected output.
Primary contrasts are width48-minus-width24 within each pooling strategy and
max-minus-mean at each width. Report all folds/seeds, paired case changes after
averaging seeds, and seed-to-seed variability separately. Do not count seeds or
rays as independent patients. A null result is evidence about this intervention,
not a proof that arbitrary larger end-to-end heads cannot help.

## Decision rules and next stage

If oracle renderer presence does not restore correct thin anatomy, do not
interpret more capacity as the primary remedy. If it restores anatomy but
larger heads do not improve held-out FP-matched preservation, capacity at these
widths is unsupported. A pooling advantage with no width advantage favors an
evidence-aggregation bottleneck. Improvements confined to fitting cases favor
overfitting; universal no-op selection requires inspecting unselected metrics.

Only a clear capacity/pooling improvement proceeds to matched end-to-end
training with independent backbone seeds. A separate three-arm gradient study
(D-prime, rendered loss with detached geometry, full E) remains a subsequent
experiment; this frozen-head study cannot answer that question.

No automatic promotion, external generalization claim, clinical claim, pruning
of previous checkpoints, or modification of historical primary results.

## Reproduction amendment before component results were available

Job 666639 stopped at the 1e-4 mm case-level reproduction guard on fold 1,
hippocampus_166. The original record is 0.3497679963 mm; multiple existing
read-only re-evaluations give 0.3504276702 mm. REFERENCE_E.csv is frozen from
the previously saved raw-thin-rescue baseline, with source/hash in its provenance
JSON. The rerun checks E against this previously recorded re-evaluation at the
same 1e-4 tolerance and records BOTH old and repeated references. A is still
checked against the original record. All treatment comparisons use the current
paired baseline. This is a reproducibility amendment, not a changed scientific
endpoint, selection rule, or intervention. A repeated-inference diagnostic also
compares the old evaluator with the new metric code on the affected case.

"""Create readable reports from completed studies without tuning any choices."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("result", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = json.loads((args.result / "summary.json").read_text())
    lines = ["# Decisive presence experiments", "", "Internal development results; not external confirmation.", ""]
    if "arms" not in result:
        lines += ["## Saved-model component interventions", "",
                  "Oracle rows use labels and are non-deployable. Ray overlap requires a correctly predicted foreground voxel on the true ray.", "",
                  "| Intervention | ASSD mm | Thin ray overlap recall | Thin voxel recall | FP rays | FP voxels |",
                  "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
        for name, entry in result.items():
            m = entry["means"]
            lines.append(f"| {name} | {m['assd_mm']:.6f} | {100*m['thin_overlap_recall']:.2f}% | {100*m['thin_voxel_recall']:.2f}% | {m['presence_fp']:.2f} | {m['fp_voxels']:.2f} |")
        rows = []
        for path in sorted(args.result.glob("fold*_cases.json")):
            rows.extend(json.loads(path.read_text()))
        lines += ["", "## Exact surface attribution", "",
                  "Each contribution is already divided by its method's full surface denominator; these are contributions to ASSD, not subgroup conditional means.", "",
                  "| Reference ray stratum / original E presence | A | E raw | E final | E minus A |",
                  "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
        names = sorted({k for r in rows for k in r.get("surface_contributions", {})})
        for name in names:
            values = {}
            for arm in ("A", "E_raw", "E"):
                selected = [r for r in rows if r["arm"] == arm]
                values[arm] = np.mean([r["surface_contributions"].get(name, {}).get("total", 0.) for r in selected])
            lines.append(f"| {name} | {values['A']:.6f} | {values['E_raw']:.6f} | {values['E']:.6f} | {values['E']-values['A']:+.6f} |")
        lines += ["", "## Conditional paired ASSD uncertainty", ""]
        for name, entry in result.items():
            p = entry["paired_minus_E"]["assd_mm"]
            lines.append(f"- {name}: {p['mean']:+.6f} mm; conditional case-bootstrap interval {p['ci95_conditional_case_bootstrap']}.")
    else:
        lines += ["## Frozen-backbone capacity/pooling study", "",
                  result["uncertainty"], "",
                  "| Arm/output | ASSD mm | Thin overlap recall | Thin voxel recall | FP rays | FP voxels |",
                  "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
        for name, entry in result["arms"].items():
            m = entry["means"]
            lines.append(f"| {name} | {m['assd_mm']:.6f} | {100*m['thin_overlap_recall']:.2f}% | {100*m['thin_voxel_recall']:.2f}% | {m['presence_fp']:.2f} | {m['fp_voxels']:.2f} |")
        lines += ["", "## Prespecified contrasts", ""]
        for name, metrics in result["contrasts"].items():
            lines.append(f"- {name}: ASSD {metrics['assd_mm']['mean']:+.6f} mm; thin overlap recall {100*metrics['thin_overlap_recall']['mean']:+.3f} percentage points.")
        lines += ["", "## Selections", ""]
        for path in sorted(args.result.glob("fold*/ALL_SELECTIONS_LOCKED.json")):
            selected = json.loads(path.read_text())
            for name, entry in selected.items():
                s = entry["selected"]
                lines.append(f"- {path.parent.name} {name}: epoch {s['epoch']}, offset {s['offset']}, fallback {s['fallback']}.")
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Non-deployable component oracles and exact directional surface attribution."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
import torch

from common import (checkpoint, geometry, mask, means, paired, provenance,
                    ray_strata, render, save_json, score, verify_inputs)


def interventions(out, truth, quadratic_fit, config):
    raw, lower, upper, lp, beta = (out[k] for k in ("raw", "lower", "upper", "log_pres", "beta"))
    g = geometry(truth)
    tensor = lambda x: torch.as_tensor(x, device=raw.device)[None]
    present = tensor(g["present"])
    # Finite approximations to presence 0/1; no gradients are evaluated here.
    oracle_lp = torch.where(present, torch.zeros_like(lp), torch.full_like(lp, -80.))
    oracle_l = torch.where(present, tensor(g["lower"]).float(), lower)
    oracle_u = torch.where(present, tensor(g["upper"]).float(), upper)
    def draw(l=lower, u=upper, p=lp, mode="product"):
        return mask(render(raw, l, u, p, beta, mode=mode, tau=config.tau))
    original = draw()
    if not np.array_equal(original, mask(out["rendered"])):
        raise AssertionError("Standalone renderer changed the original segmentation")
    fit_l = quadratic_fit(out["log_phi_l"], oracle_lp.exp(), config)
    fit_u = quadratic_fit(out["log_phi_u"], oracle_lp.exp(), config)
    z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device)
    result = dict(E=original, E_raw=mask(raw),
                  oracle_presence_renderer=draw(p=oracle_lp),
                  oracle_edges=draw(l=oracle_l, u=oracle_u),
                  oracle_presence_and_edges=draw(l=oracle_l, u=oracle_u, p=oracle_lp),
                  oracle_presence_fit_only=draw(l=fit_l, u=fit_u),
                  oracle_presence_fit_and_renderer=draw(l=fit_l, u=fit_u, p=oracle_lp),
                  oracle_thin_presence=draw(p=torch.where(tensor(g["thin"]), 0., lp)),
                  no_quadratic_fit=draw(l=(out["log_phi_l"].exp()*z).sum(-1),
                                        u=(out["log_phi_u"].exp()*z).sum(-1)),
                  distance_renderer=draw(mode="distance"))
    pp = (original > 0).any(-1)
    raw_present = (result["E_raw"] > 0).any(-1)
    erased = g["thin"] & raw_present & ~pp
    repaired = original.copy()
    repaired[erased] = result["E_raw"][erased]
    result["oracle_raw_restore_erased_thin"] = repaired
    selections = dict(missed_thin=g["thin"] & ~pp,
                      missed_thicker=g["present"] & ~g["thin"] & ~pp,
                      empty_fp=~g["present"] & pp,
                      present_wrong=g["present"] & pp & (original != truth).any(-1))
    for name, select in selections.items():
        repaired = original.copy()
        repaired[select] = truth[select]
        result["oracle_gt_replace_" + name] = repaired
    margin_raw = (raw[:, 1:].amax(1) - raw[:, 0])[0].cpu().numpy()
    margin_final = (out["rendered"][:, 1:].amax(1) - out["rendered"][:, 0])[0].cpu().numpy()
    q = lp[0].exp().cpu().numpy()
    trace = []
    for x, y in np.argwhere(g["thin"]):
        fg = g["fg"][x, y]
        trace.append(dict(x=int(x), y=int(y), count=int(g["count"][x, y]),
                          head_presence=float(q[x, y]), raw_present=bool(raw_present[x, y]),
                          final_present=bool(pp[x, y]),
                          raw_correct_overlap=bool(((result["E_raw"][x, y] > 0) & fg).any()),
                          final_correct_overlap=bool(((original[x, y] > 0) & fg).any()),
                          raw_max_true_margin=float(margin_raw[x, y][fg].max()),
                          final_max_true_margin=float(margin_final[x, y][fg].max()),
                          lower=float(lower[0, x, y]), upper=float(upper[0, x, y]),
                          gt_lower=int(g["lower"][x, y]), gt_upper=int(g["upper"][x, y])))
    return result, trace


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ("source", "root", "pkl", "splits", "output"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--folds", nargs="+", type=int, default=[1, 2, 3, 4])
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify_inputs(args)
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.source))
    from thesis.new_constraints.function_head import FunctionConfig, quadratic_fit
    from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import FullModel, load_weights, plain, split_loaders
    save_json(args.output / "provenance.json", provenance(args))
    device = torch.device(args.device)
    config = FunctionConfig(rescue=False)
    rows, traces = [], []
    repeated_reference = {r["case"]: float(r["assd_mm"]) for r in csv.DictReader(
        (Path(__file__).parent / "REFERENCE_E.csv").open())}
    reproduction = []
    for fold in args.folds:
        split_args = SimpleNamespace(pkl=args.pkl, splits=args.splits, fold=fold,
                                     inner_seed=0, batch_size=1, run_status="prespecified component audit")
        _, _, outer, split = split_loaders(split_args)
        save_json(args.output / f"fold{fold}_split.json", split)
        models = {}
        for arm in ("A", "E"):
            model = FullModel(arm == "E", config).to(device)
            load_weights(model, checkpoint(args, fold, arm))
            model.eval()
            models[arm] = model
        saved = list(csv.DictReader((args.root / f"fold{fold}" / "robustness_case_metrics.csv").open()))
        expected = {(r["arm"], r["case"]): float(r["final_assd_mm"]) for r in saved}
        seen = set()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in outer:
                name = str(batch["case_name"][0])
                if name in seen:
                    raise AssertionError("Duplicate outer case")
                seen.add(name)
                truth = batch["label"][0, 0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
                image = plain(batch["image"], device)
                out = models["E"](image, render=True, warmup=1.)
                predictions, trace = interventions(out, truth, quadratic_fit, config)
                predictions["A"] = mask(models["A"](image)["raw"])
                strata = ray_strata(truth, predictions["E"])
                for arm, prediction in predictions.items():
                    metrics = score(prediction, truth, strata)
                    if arm in ("A", "E"):
                        reference = repeated_reference[name] if arm == "E" else expected[arm, name]
                        reproduction.append(dict(fold=fold, case=name, arm=arm,
                                                 current=metrics["assd_mm"], historical=expected[arm, name],
                                                 repeated_reference=reference))
                        save_json(args.output / "reproduction.json", reproduction)
                        if abs(metrics["assd_mm"] - reference) > 1e-4:
                            raise AssertionError(f"Baseline reproduction failed: {fold} {name} {arm}: {metrics['assd_mm']} vs {reference}")
                    rows.append(dict(fold=fold, case=name, arm=arm,
                                     non_deployable=arm.startswith("oracle_"), **metrics))
                traces.extend(dict(fold=fold, case=name, **r) for r in trace)
                print(f"fold={fold} cases={len(seen)} case={name}", flush=True)
        if seen != set(split["outer_val"]):
            raise AssertionError("Outer split mismatch")
        save_json(args.output / f"fold{fold}_cases.json", [r for r in rows if r["fold"] == fold])
        del models
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    baseline = {(r["fold"], r["case"]): r for r in rows if r["arm"] == "E"}
    summary = {}
    for arm in sorted({r["arm"] for r in rows}):
        chosen = [r for r in rows if r["arm"] == arm]
        comparisons = {}
        for metric in ("assd_mm", "thin_overlap_recall", "thin_voxel_recall", "presence_fp", "fp_voxels"):
            comparisons[metric] = paired([r[metric]-baseline[r["fold"], r["case"]][metric]
                                           for r in chosen if r[metric] is not None])
        summary[arm] = dict(means=means(chosen), paired_minus_E=comparisons,
                            folds={str(f): means([r for r in chosen if r["fold"] == f]) for f in args.folds})
    save_json(args.output / "summary.json", summary)
    with (args.output / "thin_rays.csv").open("w", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(traces[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(traces)
    print(json.dumps({k: v["means"]["assd_mm"] for k, v in summary.items()}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Auditable helpers shared by the presence mechanism experiments."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt, label


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def geometry(truth):
    fg = np.asarray(truth) > 0
    z = np.arange(fg.shape[-1])
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    lower = np.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).min(-1)
    upper = np.where(fg, z, -1).max(-1)
    present = count > 0
    span = np.where(present, upper - lower + 1, 0)
    border = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (count < span)
    thin = present & (span <= 2) & ~border
    return dict(fg=fg, count=count, lower=lower, upper=upper, present=present,
                span=span, border=border, multi=multi, thin=thin)


def render(raw, lower, upper, log_presence, beta, mode="product", tau=0.5):
    """Original log-space renderer, also usable with detached geometry."""
    z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    if mode == "product":
        log_o = (log_presence[..., None]
                 + F.logsigmoid((z - lower[..., None] + .5) / tau)
                 + F.logsigmoid((upper[..., None] - z + .5) / tau))
    elif mode == "distance":
        centre, radius = (upper + lower) / 2, (upper - lower + 1) / 2
        log_o = log_presence[..., None] + F.logsigmoid(
            (radius[..., None] - (z - centre[..., None]).abs()) / tau)
    else:
        raise ValueError(mode)
    logit_o = log_o - torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
    shift = 6 * torch.tanh(logit_o / 6)
    return torch.cat(((raw[:, 0] - beta * shift)[:, None], raw[:, 1:]), 1)


def mask(logits):
    return logits.argmax(1)[0].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)


def ray_strata(truth, original_e):
    g = geometry(truth)
    s = np.full(g["present"].shape, "empty", dtype="U32")
    s[g["span"] == 1] = "thin1"
    s[g["span"] == 2] = "thin2"
    s[(g["span"] >= 3) & (g["span"] <= 5)] = "length3_5"
    s[g["span"] >= 6] = "length6plus"
    s[g["multi"]] = "multi_run"
    s[g["border"]] = "border"
    present_e = (original_e > 0).any(-1)
    for name in ("thin1", "thin2", "length3_5", "length6plus", "multi_run", "border"):
        chosen = s == name
        s[chosen & present_e] = name + "_E_present"
        s[chosen & ~present_e] = name + "_E_missed"
    return s


def score(pred, truth, strata=None):
    """Match historical surface-voxel ASSD; additionally measure actual overlap."""
    p, g = pred > 0, geometry(truth)
    t = g["fg"]
    pr = p.any(-1)
    overlap = (p & t).any(-1)
    thin = g["thin"]
    nt = int(thin.sum())
    nvox = int(t[thin].sum())
    denom = int(p.sum() + t.sum())
    result = dict(union_dice=float(2 * (p & t).sum() / denom) if denom else 1.,
                  presence_fp=int((pr & ~g["present"]).sum()),
                  presence_fn=int((~pr & g["present"]).sum()),
                  fp_voxels=int((p & ~t).sum()), fn_voxels=int((~p & t).sum()),
                  signed_volume_error_vox=int(p.sum()) - int(t.sum()),
                  thin_rays=nt, thin_voxels=nvox,
                  thin_present=int((pr & thin).sum()),
                  thin_overlap_rays=int((overlap & thin).sum()),
                  thin_true_positive_voxels=int((p & t)[thin].sum()),
                  thin_presence_recall=float((pr & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_overlap_recall=float((overlap & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_voxel_recall=float((p & t)[thin].sum()/nvox) if nvox else None,
                  fp_components=int(label(p & ~t)[1]))
    for cls in (1, 2):
        pc, tc = pred == cls, truth == cls
        n = pc.sum() + tc.sum()
        result[f"class{cls}_dice"] = float(2*(pc & tc).sum()/n) if n else 1.
    pg = geometry(pred)
    both = pr & g["present"]
    errors = (abs(pg["lower"] - g["lower"]) + abs(pg["upper"] - g["upper"])) / 2
    result["conditional_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both].mean()) if both.any() else None
    result["conditional_thin_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both & thin].mean()) if (both & thin).any() else None
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        penalty = float(np.linalg.norm(pred.shape)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
        result.update(assd_mm=penalty, hd95_mm=penalty, p_to_t_mm=penalty, t_to_p_mm=penalty)
        for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
            result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = 0. if t.any() else None
        result["surface_contributions"] = {"empty_mask_penalty": penalty}
        return result
    ps, ts = p ^ binary_erosion(p), t ^ binary_erosion(t)
    pd = distance_transform_edt(~ts)[ps]
    td = distance_transform_edt(~ps)[ts]
    assd = (float(pd.mean()) + float(td.mean())) / 2
    result.update(assd_mm=assd, hd95_mm=float(np.percentile(np.r_[pd, td], 95)),
                  p_to_t_mm=float(pd.mean()), t_to_p_mm=float(td.mean()))
    for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
        result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = float((td <= tolerance).mean())
    if strata is not None:
        volume_strata = np.broadcast_to(strata[..., None], p.shape)
        p_names, t_names = volume_strata[ps], volume_strata[ts]
        contributions = {}
        for name in np.unique(strata):
            a = float(pd[p_names == name].sum() / len(pd) / 2)
            b = float(td[t_names == name].sum() / len(td) / 2)
            contributions[str(name)] = dict(p_to_t=a, t_to_p=b, total=a+b)
        if not np.isclose(sum(x["total"] for x in contributions.values()), assd, atol=1e-10):
            raise AssertionError("Surface contribution decomposition does not sum to ASSD")
        result["surface_contributions"] = contributions
    return result


def means(rows):
    return {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows if r.get(key) is not None]))
            for key in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][key], (int, float)) or rows[0][key] is None
            if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in rows)}


def paired(values, seed=0):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = [float(rng.choice(values, size=len(values), replace=True).mean()) for _ in range(3000)]
    return dict(mean=float(values.mean()), median=float(np.median(values)),
                ci95_conditional_case_bootstrap=np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5]).tolist(),
                improved=int((values < 0).sum()), worsened=int((values > 0).sum()), n=len(values))

                records.append(dict(repeat=repeat, audit_assd=own["assd_mm"], original_evaluator_assd=official[0],
                                    historical_assd=float(historical["final_assd_mm"]),

"""Function-preserving capacity/pooling interventions on a frozen E model."""
from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class PresenceProbe(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original, width=24, pooling="mean", seed=0):
        super().__init__()
        if width not in (24, 48) or pooling not in ("mean", "meanmax"):
            raise ValueError("Only the prespecified width/pooling factorial is allowed")
        self.width, self.pooling = width, pooling
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(7, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU(),
                                  nn.Conv2d(width, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU())
        self.presence = nn.Conv1d(width * 2, 1, 3, padding=1)
        multiplier = width // 24
        idx = torch.arange(width) % 24
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.stem[0].weight.copy_(original.stem[0].weight[idx])
            self.stem[0].bias.copy_(original.stem[0].bias[idx])
            self.stem[2].weight.copy_(original.stem[2].weight[idx][:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.stem[2].bias.copy_(original.stem[2].bias[idx])
            self.presence.weight.zero_()
            self.presence.weight[:, :width].copy_(original.presence.weight[:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.presence.bias.copy_(original.presence.bias)
            if multiplier == 2:
                generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
                noise = torch.randn((1, 24, 3), generator=generator) * 1e-3
                # Identical initial output; unequal channel gradients allow extra
                # channels to become useful rather than remain exact duplicates.
                self.presence.weight[:, :24].add_(noise)
                self.presence.weight[:, 24:48].sub_(noise)

    def forward(self, inputs, anchor):
        hidden = self.stem(inputs)
        mean = hidden.mean(-1)
        second = mean if self.pooling == "mean" else hidden.amax(-1)
        residual = self.presence(torch.cat((mean, second), 1)).squeeze(1)
        return anchor + residual


def ray_groups(truth, raw_mask, original_q):
    """Frozen fitting labels/negative groups, never used to construct features."""
    fg = truth > 0
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    z = torch.arange(fg.shape[-1], device=truth.device)
    lower = torch.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).amin(-1)
    upper = torch.where(fg, z, -1).amax(-1)
    present = count > 0
    thin = present & ((upper-lower+1) <= 2) & ~fg[..., 0] & ~fg[..., -1]
    hard_empty = ~present & ((raw_mask > 0).any(-1) | (original_q >= .5))
    return (thin, present & ~thin, hard_empty, ~present & ~hard_empty)


def balanced_presence_loss(logits, groups):
    losses = []
    for index, group in enumerate(groups):
        if group.any():
            target = torch.full_like(logits[group], float(index < 2))
            losses.append(F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits[group], target))
    if not losses:
        raise ValueError("No supervised rays")
    return torch.stack(losses).mean()


def eligible(metrics, baseline):
    return (metrics["presence_fp"] <= baseline["presence_fp"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["fp_voxels"] <= baseline["fp_voxels"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["thin_voxel_recall"] >= baseline["thin_voxel_recall"] - 1e-9
            and metrics["assd_mm"] <= baseline["assd_mm"] + .002 + 1e-9)


def selection_key(metrics, epoch, offset):
    return (-metrics["thin_overlap_recall"], metrics["assd_mm"], metrics["presence_fp"],
            epoch, abs(offset), offset)

def head_metrics(logits, truth, groups):
