"""Auditable helpers shared by the presence mechanism experiments."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt, label


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def geometry(truth):
    fg = np.asarray(truth) > 0
    z = np.arange(fg.shape[-1])
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    lower = np.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).min(-1)
    upper = np.where(fg, z, -1).max(-1)
    present = count > 0
    span = np.where(present, upper - lower + 1, 0)
    border = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (count < span)
    thin = present & (span <= 2) & ~border
    return dict(fg=fg, count=count, lower=lower, upper=upper, present=present,
                span=span, border=border, multi=multi, thin=thin)


def render(raw, lower, upper, log_presence, beta, mode="product", tau=0.5):
    """Original log-space renderer, also usable with detached geometry."""
    z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    if mode == "product":
        log_o = (log_presence[..., None]
                 + F.logsigmoid((z - lower[..., None] + .5) / tau)
                 + F.logsigmoid((upper[..., None] - z + .5) / tau))
    elif mode == "distance":
        centre, radius = (upper + lower) / 2, (upper - lower + 1) / 2
        log_o = log_presence[..., None] + F.logsigmoid(
            (radius[..., None] - (z - centre[..., None]).abs()) / tau)
    else:
        raise ValueError(mode)
    logit_o = log_o - torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
    shift = 6 * torch.tanh(logit_o / 6)
    return torch.cat(((raw[:, 0] - beta * shift)[:, None], raw[:, 1:]), 1)


def mask(logits):
    return logits.argmax(1)[0].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)


def ray_strata(truth, original_e):
    g = geometry(truth)
    s = np.full(g["present"].shape, "empty", dtype="U32")
    s[g["span"] == 1] = "thin1"
    s[g["span"] == 2] = "thin2"
    s[(g["span"] >= 3) & (g["span"] <= 5)] = "length3_5"
    s[g["span"] >= 6] = "length6plus"
    s[g["multi"]] = "multi_run"
    s[g["border"]] = "border"
    present_e = (original_e > 0).any(-1)
    for name in ("thin1", "thin2", "length3_5", "length6plus", "multi_run", "border"):
        chosen = s == name
        s[chosen & present_e] = name + "_E_present"
        s[chosen & ~present_e] = name + "_E_missed"
    return s


def score(pred, truth, strata=None):
    """Match historical surface-voxel ASSD; additionally measure actual overlap."""
    p, g = pred > 0, geometry(truth)
    t = g["fg"]
    pr = p.any(-1)
    overlap = (p & t).any(-1)
    thin = g["thin"]
    nt = int(thin.sum())
    nvox = int(t[thin].sum())
    denom = int(p.sum() + t.sum())
    result = dict(union_dice=float(2 * (p & t).sum() / denom) if denom else 1.,
                  presence_fp=int((pr & ~g["present"]).sum()),
                  presence_fn=int((~pr & g["present"]).sum()),
                  fp_voxels=int((p & ~t).sum()), fn_voxels=int((~p & t).sum()),
                  signed_volume_error_vox=int(p.sum()) - int(t.sum()),
                  thin_rays=nt, thin_voxels=nvox,
                  thin_present=int((pr & thin).sum()),
                  thin_overlap_rays=int((overlap & thin).sum()),
                  thin_true_positive_voxels=int((p & t)[thin].sum()),
                  thin_presence_recall=float((pr & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_overlap_recall=float((overlap & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_voxel_recall=float((p & t)[thin].sum()/nvox) if nvox else None,
                  fp_components=int(label(p & ~t)[1]))
    for cls in (1, 2):
        pc, tc = pred == cls, truth == cls
        n = pc.sum() + tc.sum()
        result[f"class{cls}_dice"] = float(2*(pc & tc).sum()/n) if n else 1.
    pg = geometry(pred)
    both = pr & g["present"]
    errors = (abs(pg["lower"] - g["lower"]) + abs(pg["upper"] - g["upper"])) / 2
    result["conditional_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both].mean()) if both.any() else None
    result["conditional_thin_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both & thin].mean()) if (both & thin).any() else None
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        penalty = float(np.linalg.norm(pred.shape)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
        result.update(assd_mm=penalty, hd95_mm=penalty, p_to_t_mm=penalty, t_to_p_mm=penalty)
        for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
            result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = 0. if t.any() else None
        result["surface_contributions"] = {"empty_mask_penalty": penalty}
        return result
    ps, ts = p ^ binary_erosion(p), t ^ binary_erosion(t)
    pd = distance_transform_edt(~ts)[ps]
    td = distance_transform_edt(~ps)[ts]
    assd = (float(pd.mean()) + float(td.mean())) / 2
    result.update(assd_mm=assd, hd95_mm=float(np.percentile(np.r_[pd, td], 95)),
                  p_to_t_mm=float(pd.mean()), t_to_p_mm=float(td.mean()))
    for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
        result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = float((td <= tolerance).mean())
    if strata is not None:
        volume_strata = np.broadcast_to(strata[..., None], p.shape)
        p_names, t_names = volume_strata[ps], volume_strata[ts]
        contributions = {}
        for name in np.unique(strata):
            a = float(pd[p_names == name].sum() / len(pd) / 2)
            b = float(td[t_names == name].sum() / len(td) / 2)
            contributions[str(name)] = dict(p_to_t=a, t_to_p=b, total=a+b)
        if not np.isclose(sum(x["total"] for x in contributions.values()), assd, atol=1e-10):
            raise AssertionError("Surface contribution decomposition does not sum to ASSD")
        result["surface_contributions"] = contributions
    return result


def means(rows):
    return {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows if r.get(key) is not None]))
            for key in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][key], (int, float)) or rows[0][key] is None
            if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in rows)}


def paired(values, seed=0):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = [float(rng.choice(values, size=len(values), replace=True).mean()) for _ in range(3000)]
    return dict(mean=float(values.mean()), median=float(np.median(values)),
                ci95_conditional_case_bootstrap=np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5]).tolist(),
                improved=int((values < 0).sum()), worsened=int((values > 0).sum()), n=len(values))

"""Function-preserving capacity/pooling interventions on a frozen E model."""
from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import copy
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class PresenceProbe(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original, width=24, pooling="mean", seed=0):
        super().__init__()
        if width not in (24, 48) or pooling not in ("mean", "meanmax"):
            raise ValueError("Only the prespecified width/pooling factorial is allowed")
        self.width, self.pooling = width, pooling
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(7, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU(),
                                  nn.Conv2d(width, width, 3, padding=1), nn.GELU())
        self.presence = nn.Conv1d(width * 2, 1, 3, padding=1)
        multiplier = width // 24
        idx = torch.arange(width) % 24
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.stem[0].weight.copy_(original.stem[0].weight[idx])
            self.stem[0].bias.copy_(original.stem[0].bias[idx])
            self.stem[2].weight.copy_(original.stem[2].weight[idx][:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.stem[2].bias.copy_(original.stem[2].bias[idx])
            self.presence.weight.zero_()
            self.presence.weight[:, :width].copy_(original.presence.weight[:, idx] / multiplier)
            self.presence.bias.copy_(original.presence.bias)
            if multiplier == 2:
                generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
                noise = torch.randn((1, 24, 3), generator=generator) * 1e-3
                # Identical initial output; unequal channel gradients allow extra
                # channels to become useful rather than remain exact duplicates.
                self.presence.weight[:, :24].add_(noise)
                self.presence.weight[:, 24:48].sub_(noise)
        # GPU convolution algorithms may round duplicated channels differently.
        # Subtract an identical frozen initial branch, making the initial update
        # bitwise zero rather than relying on algebraic Net2Wider equivalence.
        self.initial_stem = copy.deepcopy(self.stem).requires_grad_(False)
        self.initial_presence = copy.deepcopy(self.presence).requires_grad_(False)

    def _residual(self, inputs, stem, presence):
        hidden = stem(inputs)
        mean = hidden.mean(-1)
        second = mean if self.pooling == "mean" else hidden.amax(-1)
        return presence(torch.cat((mean, second), 1)).squeeze(1)

    def forward(self, inputs, anchor):
        """Anchor is the cached full E presence logit, not its voxel-only anchor."""
        residual = self._residual(inputs, self.stem, self.presence)
        with torch.no_grad():
            initial = self._residual(inputs, self.initial_stem, self.initial_presence)
        return anchor + (residual - initial)


def ray_groups(truth, raw_mask, original_q):
    """Frozen fitting labels/negative groups, never used to construct features."""
    fg = truth > 0
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    z = torch.arange(fg.shape[-1], device=truth.device)
    lower = torch.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).amin(-1)
    upper = torch.where(fg, z, -1).amax(-1)
    present = count > 0
    thin = present & ((upper-lower+1) <= 2) & ~fg[..., 0] & ~fg[..., -1]
    hard_empty = ~present & ((raw_mask > 0).any(-1) | (original_q >= .5))
    return (thin, present & ~thin, hard_empty, ~present & ~hard_empty)


def balanced_presence_loss(logits, groups):
    losses = []
    for index, group in enumerate(groups):
        if group.any():
            target = torch.full_like(logits[group], float(index < 2))
            losses.append(F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits[group], target))
    if not losses:
        raise ValueError("No supervised rays")
    return torch.stack(losses).mean()


def eligible(metrics, baseline):
    return (metrics["presence_fp"] <= baseline["presence_fp"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["fp_voxels"] <= baseline["fp_voxels"] + 1e-9
            and metrics["thin_voxel_recall"] >= baseline["thin_voxel_recall"] - 1e-9
            and metrics["assd_mm"] <= baseline["assd_mm"] + .002 + 1e-9)


def selection_key(metrics, epoch, offset):
    return (-metrics["thin_overlap_recall"], metrics["assd_mm"], metrics["presence_fp"],
            epoch, abs(offset), offset)

from common import (checkpoint, digest, geometry, mask, means, paired, provenance, render,
                    save_json, score, verify_inputs)
from presence_model import (PresenceProbe, balanced_presence_loss, eligible,
                            ray_groups, selection_key)

OFFSETS = (-1., -.5, 0., .5, 1.)
ARMS = ((24, "mean"), (48, "mean"), (24, "meanmax"), (48, "meanmax"))


def head_metrics(logits, truth, groups):
    probability = logits.sigmoid().cpu().numpy()
    gt = geometry(truth)
    result = dict(head_presence_brier=float(((probability-gt["present"])**2).mean()),
                  head_presence_fp=int(((probability >= .5) & ~gt["present"]).sum()),
                  head_presence_fn=int(((probability < .5) & gt["present"]).sum()))
    for name, group in zip(("thin", "other_true", "hard_empty", "other_empty"), groups):
        chosen = group.numpy()
        result[f"head_mean_q_{name}"] = float(probability[chosen].mean()) if chosen.any() else None
    positive = logits.cpu().numpy()[groups[0].numpy()]
    negative = logits.cpu().numpy()[groups[2].numpy()]
    if len(positive) and len(negative):
        ranks = rankdata(np.r_[positive, negative])
        n, m = len(positive), len(negative)
        result["thin_vs_hard_empty_auc"] = float((ranks[:n].sum()-n*(n+1)/2)/(n*m))
    else:
        result["thin_vs_hard_empty_auc"] = None
    return result


@torch.no_grad()
def collect(model, loader, device, plain):
    captured = {}
    def capture(_module, inputs):
        captured["inputs"] = inputs[0].detach().cpu()
    hook = model.function.residual.stem.register_forward_pre_hook(capture)
    cases = []
    try:
        for batch in loader:
            out = model(plain(batch["image"], device), render=True, warmup=1.)
            truth = batch["label"][0, 0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
            base = mask(out["rendered"])
            original_logit = out["hits"]["log_pi"] - out["hits"]["log_m"] + out["g_p"]
            case = dict(case=str(batch["case_name"][0]), inputs=captured["inputs"],
                        anchor=original_logit[0].cpu(),
                        original_logit=original_logit[0].cpu(), truth=truth,
                        baseline=base, baseline_metrics=score(base, truth),
                        **{k: out[k].cpu() for k in ("raw", "lower", "upper", "beta")})
            case["groups"] = ray_groups(torch.from_numpy(truth), out["raw"].argmax(1)[0].cpu(),
                                         out["log_pres"][0].exp().cpu())
            case["baseline_metrics"].update(head_metrics(case["original_logit"], truth, case["groups"]))
            cases.append(case)
    finally:
        hook.remove()
    return sorted(cases, key=lambda c: c["case"])


def tensors(case, device):
    return case["inputs"].to(device), case["anchor"].to(device)


def prediction(case, presence_logit, offset, device):
    # Presence intervention only: geometry and beta are fixed throughout training.
    return mask(render(case["raw"].to(device), case["lower"].to(device),
                       case["upper"].to(device), F.logsigmoid(presence_logit + offset)[None],
                       case["beta"].to(device)))


def _score_prediction(job):
    offset, name, pred, truth, diagnostics = job
    return offset, dict(case=name, **score(pred, truth), **diagnostics)


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(model, cases, offsets, device, check_initial=False):
    model.eval()
    rows = {offset: [] for offset in offsets}
    losses = []
    jobs = []
    for case in cases:
        logits = model(*tensors(case, device))
        losses.append(float(balanced_presence_loss(logits, tuple(g.to(device) for g in case["groups"]))))
        if check_initial:
            torch.testing.assert_close(logits.cpu(), case["original_logit"], atol=2e-4, rtol=1e-5)
        for offset in offsets:
            pred = prediction(case, logits, offset, device)
            if check_initial and offset == 0 and not np.array_equal(pred, case["baseline"]):
                raise AssertionError(f"Initial head changes labels: {case['case']}")
            jobs.append((offset, case["case"], pred, case["truth"],
                         head_metrics(logits+offset, case["truth"], case["groups"])))
    # SciPy distance transforms release the GIL. The order of records and all
    # metric/selection definitions stay identical to sequential evaluation.
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
        for offset, record in executor.map(_score_prediction, jobs):
            rows[offset].append(record)
    return {offset: means(values) for offset, values in rows.items()}, float(np.mean(losses)), rows


def train_one(original, fit, inner, baseline, width, pooling, seed, device, output, epochs):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    model = PresenceProbe(original, width, pooling, seed).to(device)
    # Verify functional equivalence on the entire inner set, not just a toy input.
    initial, initial_loss, _ = evaluate(model, inner, (0.,), device, check_initial=True)
    best = dict(epoch=0, offset=0., metrics=baseline, fallback=True)
    best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.cpu().state_dict())
    model.to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-5)
    history = [dict(epoch=0, inner=initial[0.], inner_presence_loss=initial_loss)]
    generator = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        model.train()
        losses = []
        for index in generator.permutation(len(fit)):
            case = fit[int(index)]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            logits = model(*tensors(case, device))
            loss = balanced_presence_loss(logits, tuple(g.to(device) for g in case["groups"]))
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
                raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite presence loss")
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
        entry = dict(epoch=epoch, fit_loss=float(np.mean(losses)), train_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
        if epoch in (4, 8, 12):
            validation_started = time.perf_counter()
            metrics, inner_loss, _ = evaluate(model, inner, OFFSETS, device)
            entry.update(inner_presence_loss=inner_loss, validation_seconds=time.perf_counter()-validation_started,
                         candidates={str(offset): dict(metrics=values, eligible=eligible(values, baseline))
                                     for offset, values in metrics.items()})
            for offset, values in metrics.items():
                if eligible(values, baseline) and selection_key(values, epoch, offset) < selection_key(best["metrics"], best["epoch"], best["offset"]):
                    best = dict(epoch=epoch, offset=offset, metrics=values, fallback=False)
                    best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
        history.append(entry)
        save_json(output / "history.json", history)
        print(json.dumps(dict(arm=f"w{width}_{pooling}", seed=seed, **entry)), flush=True)
    final_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
    torch.save(dict(state=best_state, selected=best, width=width, pooling=pooling, seed=seed), output / "selected.pt")
    torch.save(dict(state=final_state, width=width, pooling=pooling, seed=seed), output / "final.pt")
    selection = dict(selected=best, parameter_count=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                     selected_sha256=digest(output / "selected.pt"), final_sha256=digest(output / "final.pt"))
    save_json(output / "selection.json", selection)
    del model
    return selection


def summarize_outer(rows, folds, seeds):
    summary = {}
    metrics = ("assd_mm", "thin_overlap_recall", "thin_voxel_recall", "presence_fp", "fp_voxels")
    for arm in sorted({r["arm"] for r in rows}):
        selected = [r for r in rows if r["arm"] == arm]
        summary[arm] = dict(means=means(selected),
                            by_fold_seed={f"fold{f}_seed{s}": means([r for r in selected if r["fold"] == f and r["seed"] == s])
                                          for f in folds for s in seeds})
    # Paired patients after averaging the three training seeds: not 624 patients.
    contrasts = {}
    for left, right in (("w48_mean_selected", "w24_mean_selected"),
                        ("w48_meanmax_selected", "w24_meanmax_selected"),
                        ("w24_meanmax_selected", "w24_mean_selected"),
                        ("w48_meanmax_selected", "w48_mean_selected")):
        values = {}
        for arm in (left, right):
            data = [r for r in rows if r["arm"] == arm]
            values[arm] = {case: {metric: float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in data if r["case"] == case]))
                                  for metric in metrics}
                           for case in {r["case"] for r in data}}
        contrasts[f"{left}_minus_{right}"] = {
            metric: paired([values[left][case][metric] - values[right][case][metric]
                            for case in sorted(values[left])]) for metric in metrics}
    return dict(arms=summary, contrasts=contrasts,
                uncertainty="case bootstrap after averaging presence seeds; conditional on saved E backbones")

# Training overhead audit — 16 September 2026

The dominant slowdown was a reproducible CPU metadata bug in the training loss,
including when all constraints were disabled. It was not the inherent cost of
SwinUNETR. The replacement baseline completed 25 epochs in **364.01 seconds of
epoch-loop time**, with a **14.223-second median epoch**. Startup and final export
are additional. Its best validation hard Dice was 0.87859894 at epoch 16.

Both Slurm jobs completed successfully. Baseline: **7m33s total**. Dropout:
**9m54s total**, including the shared four-checkpoint train/validation audit.
Dropout also stopped at epoch 25, with a 14.928-second median epoch and
380.647 seconds of epoch-loop time. Exact observations are saved in
`overhead_run_status.json`; generalization results are in `RESULTS.md`.

## Scope and evidence

Inspected the active trainer, data construction, objective dispatch, constraint
losses, validation/calibration, telemetry, checkpoint/provenance handling,
Slurm launchers, and the paired post-training evaluator. Measurements come from
the actual A100 MIG allocation unless marked as an import or code audit.
Microbenchmarks, profiler timings, and full-epoch timings are different
measurements: do not add them together or interpret profiler time as an exact
prediction of unprofiled runtime.

Evidence files: `loop_profile.profile.txt`, `loop_profile.log`,
`speed_benchmark.json`, `smoke_baseline.log`, `epoch1_parity.json`,
`import_audit.json`, and `overhead_run_status.json` in this directory.

Executes even with `constraint_set=none`. | Fixed in the submitted pair. Additional occurrences fixed locally; see below. |

## The severe defect and additional fixes

The previous expression was:

```python
logits.float().reshape(-1)[0] * 0.0
```

A batched MONAI `MetaTensor` retained its batch flag after flattening. The `[0]`
operation then attempted to decollate metadata along a dimension of 786,432
elements for a `1 × 3 × 64 × 64 × 64` output. It paid this cost to construct zero.

The local shared `differentiable_zero()` helper obtains a plain tensor view
before flattening/indexing. Storage and autograd connectivity are preserved;
the caller's dtype is retained. The submitted pair already has the equivalent
objective fix and uses plain tensors throughout the model.

The broader audit replaced **eight additional occurrences in seven core
modules**: AP posterior, existential AP plane, AP plane location, conditional
A/P cross-entropy, outer boundary, boundary Tversky, and outer one-cut (two
occurrences). Some were unconditional; others only ran for invalid geometry.
The one-cut per-case occurrence may already have lost its batch flag, but now
uses the same safe helper. The local-ray prototype also converts to a plain
tensor before its scalar-zero index.

The zeroth-order ray-moment path unnecessarily constructed a `linspace` that
it never used. It now returns the same reduction before allocating coordinates.
This is a small allocation cleanup, not a claimed major speedup.

Historical check: the unsafe objective expression is present in the frozen
September 6 augmentation and September 15 early-stopping source snapshots.
Local history traces that expression to commit `d20d01c` (6 August 2026).
Earlier runs using that path with batched metadata were exposed to the same
defect; their exact runtime penalty has not been individually measured.

## Costs specific to the previous constraint/augmentation experiments

These are code-level findings unless quantified above. They are **inactive** in
the current Dice-only baseline and dropout runs.

- **AP plane location computes extensive hard-prediction diagnostics inside
  every loss forward.** It fits a second cut on raw predictions, computes
  foreground overlap, swaps and displaced-slab statistics, and repeatedly
  converts GPU reductions to Python `int`/`float`/`bool`. It then constructs GPU
  metric tensors that the trainer reduces back to the CPU. Those diagnostics
  do not enter the loss. A loss-only training path with scheduled diagnostics
  is the appropriate optimization; dropping diagnostics silently would change
  the existing experiment's observable output.
- **Label-derived plane costs and boundary geometry are recomputed.** Fixed
  preprocessed labels permit caching candidate cuts, target costs, support and
  boundary masks. Any cache must account for actual transformed labels, axis,
  spacing and loss configuration; case identity alone is unsafe with spatial
  augmentation.
- **Outer one-cut still transfers the foreground mask GPU→CPU to hash it on
  every forward**, even on cache hits, and uploads cached coordinates back to
  the GPU. The expensive ray geometry already has a 512-entry CPU cache; it is
  incorrect to claim the distance/normal construction reruns every batch for
  this fixed 260-case cohort. Precomputing stable geometry and caching device
  coordinates can remove the remaining transfers.
- **Translation augmentation explicitly trains on identity plus translated
  views.** This means two model forwards and their backward work per batch.
  It is a defined two-view objective, not ordinary one-view augmentation with
  negligible extra compute. Replacing it with a single random view changes the
  experiment. When augmentation and equivariance are combined, the shifted
  logits are already passed through for reuse; they are not blindly recomputed.
- **Gradient telemetry performs additional work when enabled:** a separate
  probe forward and three component-gradient calls per sampled case on chosen
  epochs, plus spatial-output writes. It is not ordinary scalar logging. The
  current pair disables it, as well as constraint evaluation and W&B.
- The objective imports/constructs inactive constraint classes. This adds
  initialization/import overhead, but their costly geometry is lazy. There is
  no evidence that disabled ray constraints build rays on every baseline batch.

## Post-training evaluation and scheduling

The paired evaluator rebuilds identical dataset/transforms for each arm, creates
four models, loads optimizer-containing checkpoints although inference only
uses model weights, and preprocesses the same cases for each checkpoint.
Reusing the cohort/transformed cases/model allocation is a reasonable future
cleanup. `empty_cache()` is called only between models, not per batch.

# Matched execution speedup for the early-stopping baseline and dropout

The user authorized speeding up both jobs, including stopping the recently
started baseline and checking the code for unnecessary work. The replacements
start from seed 0 in fresh directories; previous outputs and source are retained.
The statistical protocol is unchanged: fold 0, 208/52 cases, Dice, AdamW 1e-4,
weight decay 1e-5, StepLR 20/0.5, batch 1, AMP, early stopping 8/0.0005/min25,
maximum 50 epochs, best raw validation Dice selection. Dropout is 0 versus 0.1.

## Root cause

The unconditional zero-loss initializer in `NewConstraintObjective.forward` used
`logits.float().reshape(-1)[0] * 0.0`. The flattened MONAI MetaTensor retained its
batch flag, so indexing triggered metadata decollation across 786,432 elements.
This ran even for `constraint_set=none`. In an eight-batch CPU profile it consumed
86.664 of 89.181 seconds (profiler overhead included), with 6.29 million metadata
handling calls. This is accidental overhead, not constraint computation.

The fix obtains a plain tensor view before scalar indexing, preserving the exact
zero expression and its autograd connection. A regression test rejects any
decollation in this code path and verifies zero gradients on the original tensor.

## Other measured changes

- Both runs discard metadata only after identical preprocessing. Case names and
  voxel values are preserved; the model and losses do not use affine metadata.
- Disable activation recomputation. This changes execution memory/computation,
  not the architecture or dropout masks. The original CUDA microbenchmark found
  80.8/82.8 ms forward/backward for baseline/dropout versus 47.6/48.0 ms with both
  optimizations, at peak allocated memory 1.43/1.44 GB. Identical outputs, losses,
  and the checked parameter gradient were observed for both dropout settings.
- Keep batch size, precision, deterministic settings, validation frequency,
  diagnostics, checkpoint durability, and zero data-loader workers unchanged.
- Print train/validation/checkpoint/total seconds after each durable epoch.
- Perform the shared best/latest train/validation audit after the dropout job,
  avoiding a historical-model audit delaying its start. Both new runs are audited.

Other measured costs on the A100 MIG allocation: data loading approximately
8–13 ms/batch, optimizer updates 4 ms after warmup, checkpoint write 0.59 s for
196 MB, source hashing 0.25 s. Validation diagnostics on plain tensors took about
8 ms/case versus 20 ms for metadata tensors after warmup. Library imports took
83 s in the instrumented process: a startup cost, not a per-batch delay.

The profile records are `loop_profile.log`, `loop_profile.profile.txt`, and
`speed_benchmark.json`. A complete fast epoch is run before job replacement to
measure actual throughput and compare metrics to the saved original epoch 1.

# Matched execution speedup for the early-stopping baseline and dropout

The user authorized speeding up both jobs, including stopping the recently
started baseline and checking the code for unnecessary work. The replacements
start from seed 0 in fresh directories; previous outputs and source are retained.
The statistical protocol is unchanged: fold 0, 208/52 cases, Dice, AdamW 1e-4,
weight decay 1e-5, StepLR 20/0.5, batch 1, AMP, early stopping 8/0.0005/min25,
maximum 50 epochs, best raw validation Dice selection. Dropout is 0 versus 0.1.

## Root cause

The unconditional zero-loss initializer in `NewConstraintObjective.forward` used
`logits.float().reshape(-1)[0] * 0.0`. The flattened MONAI MetaTensor retained its
batch flag, so indexing triggered metadata decollation across 786,432 elements.
This ran even for `constraint_set=none`. In an eight-batch CPU profile it consumed
86.664 of 89.181 seconds (profiler overhead included), with 6.29 million metadata
handling calls. This is accidental overhead, not constraint computation.

The fix obtains a plain tensor view before scalar indexing, preserving the exact
zero expression and its autograd connection. A regression test rejects any
decollation in this code path and verifies zero gradients on the original tensor.

## Other measured changes

- Both runs discard metadata only after identical preprocessing. Case names and
  voxel values are preserved; the model and losses do not use affine metadata.
- Disable activation recomputation. This changes execution memory/computation,
  not the architecture or dropout masks. The original CUDA microbenchmark found
  80.8/82.8 ms forward/backward for baseline/dropout versus 47.6/48.0 ms with both
  optimizations, at peak allocated memory 1.43/1.44 GB. Identical outputs, losses,
  and the checked parameter gradient were observed for both dropout settings.
- Keep batch size, precision, deterministic settings, validation frequency,
  diagnostics, checkpoint durability, and zero data-loader workers unchanged.
- Print train/validation/checkpoint/total seconds after each durable epoch.
- Perform the shared best/latest train/validation audit after the dropout job,
  avoiding a historical-model audit delaying its start. Both new runs are audited.

Other measured costs on the A100 MIG allocation: data loading approximately
8–13 ms/batch, optimizer updates 4 ms after warmup, checkpoint write 0.59 s for
196 MB, source hashing 0.25 s. Validation diagnostics on plain tensors took about
8 ms/case versus 20 ms for metadata tensors after warmup. Library imports took
83 s in the instrumented process: a startup cost, not a per-batch delay.

The profile records are `loop_profile.log`, `loop_profile.profile.txt`, and
`speed_benchmark.json`. A complete fast epoch is run before job replacement to
measure actual throughput and compare metrics to the saved original epoch 1.

User clarification after submission: evaluate general segmentation performance,
not just A/P swaps. The submitted jobs already select best checkpoints on mean
validation foreground-class Dice. A/P swaps remain a secondary diagnostic.

Read SUBMISSION.json for exact job IDs and frozen source. Jobs 660258
(augmentation) and 660259 (weight decay) are the two authorized runs in this
batch. Do not modify their frozen source, change hyperparameters mid-run, or
duplicate submissions.

Review best and latest checkpoints with:

1. Mean per-case foreground-class Dice (primary), plus anterior and posterior
   Dice separately. Compare cases in pairs with the existing baseline.
2. Foreground-union Dice, foreground false positives and false negatives,
   precision/recall, and normalized A/P errors. Reject apparent swap improvements
   that merely assign more foreground to background.
3. Per-case distribution: median, lower tail, worst cases, and improved/worsened
   cases. Check whether an average gain hides a concentrated regression.
4. Train/validation Dice gap and calibration diagnostics. A smaller gap from
   reduced training accuracy alone is not evidence of better generalization.

   The current 52 validation cases have already supported many experiments;

# Dice-only baseline with validation early stopping

User-authorized submission: fold 0, seed 0, from-scratch Dice-only SwinUNETR.

## Fixed training settings

- MSD Task04, canonical 208 training / 52 validation split, 64³ inputs, no resize.
- Batch size 1; no translation augmentation or auxiliary constraint; AMP enabled.
- AdamW: learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-5; StepLR every 20 epochs, factor 0.5.
- Maximum 50 epochs. Validation hard foreground Dice every epoch.
- Patience 8, significant improvement strictly greater than 0.0005 over the last
  significant reference score; earliest stop epoch 25.
- Best checkpoint uses every strict improvement in raw validation hard Dice,
  including improvements smaller than the patience threshold.
- At termination, export and evaluate the best checkpoint. Preserve latest
  weights/optimizer/scheduler/RNG at the stopping epoch for reproducible resume.
- Replay durable metric history on resume to recover the stopping state. If a
  stopped run resumes, finalize/evaluate it without any new optimizer updates.
- Existing validation confidence diagnostics enabled; W&B disabled as in the
  historical matched baseline. No NLL-based selection rule is added.

## Evaluation and interpretation

After training, evaluate the new best/latest and the historical matched seed-0
baseline best/latest on the identical 208 training and 52 validation cases.
Record the same supervised Dice loss, foreground soft/hard Dice, confusion counts,
NLL/Brier/ECE, error confidence, and per-case metrics for both cohorts. The new
best versus historical best comparison tests reproducibility; the new best versus
historical epoch 50 comparison quantifies checkpoint-selection benefit.

Early stopping does not change optimizer updates before termination. If trajectories
match, expect the historical epoch-16 model selected around stopping epoch 25.
The baseline has been inspected repeatedly on fold 0; this rerun does not constitute
independent evidence of improved generalization to a new fold.

# Matched execution speedup for the early-stopping baseline and dropout

The user authorized speeding up both jobs, including stopping the recently
started baseline and checking the code for unnecessary work. The replacements
start from seed 0 in fresh directories; previous outputs and source are retained.
The statistical protocol is unchanged: fold 0, 208/52 cases, Dice, AdamW 1e-4,
weight decay 1e-5, StepLR 20/0.5, batch 1, AMP, early stopping 8/0.0005/min25,
maximum 50 epochs, best raw validation Dice selection. Dropout is 0 versus 0.1.

## Root cause

The unconditional zero-loss initializer in `NewConstraintObjective.forward` used
`logits.float().reshape(-1)[0] * 0.0`. The flattened MONAI MetaTensor retained its
batch flag, so indexing triggered metadata decollation across 786,432 elements.
This ran even for `constraint_set=none`. In an eight-batch CPU profile it consumed
86.664 of 89.181 seconds (profiler overhead included), with 6.29 million metadata
handling calls. This is accidental overhead, not constraint computation.

The fix obtains a plain tensor view before scalar indexing, preserving the exact
zero expression and its autograd connection. A regression test rejects any
decollation in this code path and verifies zero gradients on the original tensor.

## Other measured changes

- Both runs discard metadata only after identical preprocessing. Case names and
  voxel values are preserved; the model and losses do not use affine metadata.
- Disable activation recomputation. This changes execution memory/computation,
  not the architecture or dropout masks. The original CUDA microbenchmark found
  80.8/82.8 ms forward/backward for baseline/dropout versus 47.6/48.0 ms with both
  optimizations, at peak allocated memory 1.43/1.44 GB. Identical outputs, losses,
  and the checked parameter gradient were observed for both dropout settings.
- Keep batch size, precision, deterministic settings, validation frequency,
  diagnostics, checkpoint durability, and zero data-loader workers unchanged.
- Print train/validation/checkpoint/total seconds after each durable epoch.
- Perform the shared best/latest train/validation audit after the dropout job,
  avoiding a historical-model audit delaying its start. Both new runs are audited.

Other measured costs on the A100 MIG allocation: data loading approximately
8–13 ms/batch, optimizer updates 4 ms after warmup, checkpoint write 0.59 s for
196 MB, source hashing 0.25 s. Validation diagnostics on plain tensors took about
8 ms/case versus 20 ms for metadata tensors after warmup. Library imports took
83 s in the instrumented process: a startup cost, not a per-batch delay.

The profile records are `loop_profile.log`, `loop_profile.profile.txt`, and
`speed_benchmark.json`. A complete fast epoch is run before job replacement to
measure actual throughput and compare metrics to the saved original epoch 1.

"""Broader segmentation metrics from saved per-case confusion matrices."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


def case_metrics(case):
    c = np.asarray(case['confusion'], dtype=np.int64)
    true_fg, pred_fg = int(c[1:, :].sum()), int(c[:, 1:].sum())
    fg_tp = int(c[1:, 1:].sum())
    result = {'case_name': case['case_name'], 'dice_mean': case['dice_hard'],
        'foreground_union_dice': 2 * fg_tp / (true_fg + pred_fg) if true_fg + pred_fg else None,
        'foreground_precision': fg_tp / pred_fg if pred_fg else None,
        'foreground_recall': fg_tp / true_fg if true_fg else None,
        'foreground_false_positive': int(c[0, 1:].sum()),
        'foreground_false_negative': int(c[1:, 0].sum()),
        'ap_swaps_per_1000_true_foreground': 1000 * int(c[1, 2] + c[2, 1]) / true_fg if true_fg else None}
    for label, name in ((1, 'anterior'), (2, 'posterior')):
        denominator = int(c[label, :].sum() + c[:, label].sum())
        result[f'dice_{name}'] = 2 * int(c[label, label]) / denominator if denominator else None
    return result


def summarize(directory):
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(directory.glob('*.json')):
        raw = json.loads(path.read_text())
        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not isinstance(raw.get('validation'), dict):
            continue
        if 'cases' not in raw['validation']:
            continue
        arm = {'epoch': raw['epoch'], 'splits': {}}
        for split in ('train', 'validation'):
            cases = [case_metrics(case) for case in raw[split]['cases']]
            scores = np.array([case['dice_mean'] for case in cases], dtype=float)
            metrics = {key: float(np.mean([case[key] for case in cases if case[key] is not None]))
                for key in ('dice_mean', 'dice_anterior', 'dice_posterior', 'foreground_union_dice',
                            'foreground_precision', 'foreground_recall')}
            metrics.update({'case_count': len(cases), 'dice_median': float(np.median(scores)),
                'dice_10th_percentile': float(np.quantile(scores, 0.1)),
                'worst_five_cases': sorted(cases, key=lambda case: case['dice_mean'])[:5],
                'foreground_false_positive_voxels': raw[split]['foreground_false_positive_voxels'],
                'foreground_false_negative_voxels': raw[split]['foreground_false_negative_voxels'],
                'ap_swaps_per_1000_true_foreground': raw[split]['ap_swaps_per_1000_true_foreground']})
            arm['splits'][split] = metrics
        arm['dice_train_validation_gap'] = arm['splits']['train']['dice_mean'] - arm['splits']['validation']['dice_mean']
        result[path.stem] = arm
    if not result:
        raise ValueError('No completed per-case audit files found.')
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('audit_directory', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(summarize(args.audit_directory), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')

# Frozen E: remove presence only from rendering

Written before execution. User requested the proposed single mechanism test.
Use saved E on the same 208 internal outer cases, folds 1–4, 52 cases per fold.
No fitting, tuning, selection, new cohort claim or additional seed runs.

Run E once per case. Reuse its raw logits, fitted lower/upper boundaries, beta,
tau=0.5 and product-renderer implementation. Replace only log presence in the
renderer with exactly zero (presence exactly one). Do not refit boundaries,
change smoothing, alter the head or update parameters. Geometry retains the
historical influence of presence through the fit. This tests the explicit
rendering multiplier, not a model trained without a presence branch.

Primary diagnostics: restoration of raw-detected true thin rays deleted by E,
restoration of true overlap, and additional FP rays/voxels. Count ray presence
and true overlap separately. Report standard nonborder span<=2 thin definition
and an additional count-of-true-voxels 1–2 definition. Do not silently compare
denominators with earlier reports. Secondary: union and per-class Dice, ASSD,
HD95, true voxel recoveries, FN counts, and case/fold heterogeneity. Bootstrap
case differences conditional on fitted models; reused development labels limit
interpretation. No intervention selection on these results.

For remaining true rays without overlap, partition into: raw true overlap existed
(geometry suppresses it even at presence one); no raw true overlap but positive
geometric foreground correction on some true voxel; no raw true overlap and no
positive correction on any true voxel. These are endpoint descriptions, not
independent causal effects of geometry versus raw logits. The last two can have
joint deficits. Labels are used only for metrics and attribution.

Check original renderer exact reproduction, historical E metric reproduction,
unchanged foreground logits/classes, monotone foreground masks when presence
increases, unchanged checkpoints, source/data hashes, and complete nonduplicated
case coverage. Tests cover one-voxel rescue, residual geometric suppression,
label-independent intervention, and false presence versus actual overlap.
Store individual records only on the cluster. Export only aggregate reports
under the user's standing authorization for this investigation.

"""Single frozen-E intervention: presence equals one only inside the renderer."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from common import (checkpoint, digest, geometry, mask, means, paired, provenance,
                    render, save_json, score, verify_inputs)


@torch.no_grad()
def intervene(out):
    """Do not recompute edges: presence still affected their historical fit."""
    return render(out['raw'], out['lower'], out['upper'],
                  torch.zeros_like(out['log_pres']), out['beta'])


def transitions(raw, before, after, truth, supportive):
    """Counts use labels only for evaluation; preserve distinct ray endpoints."""
    g = geometry(truth)
    t, r, e, a = g['fg'], raw > 0, before > 0, after > 0
    if (e & ~a).any():
        raise AssertionError('Increasing presence deleted foreground')
    if not np.array_equal(before[e], after[e]):
        raise AssertionError('Existing foreground class changed')
    result = dict(newly_deleted_true_voxels=int((t & e & ~a).sum()),
                  recovered_true_voxels=int((t & ~e & a).sum()),
                  added_fp_voxels=int((~t & ~e & a).sum()))
    groups = dict(all_true=g['present'], thin=g['thin'],
                  count_thin=(g['count'] >= 1) & (g['count'] <= 2),
                  thick=g['present'] & ~g['thin'], empty=~g['present'])
    rp, ep, ap = r.any(-1), e.any(-1), a.any(-1)
    ro, eo, ao = (r & t).any(-1), (e & t).any(-1), (a & t).any(-1)
    for name, group in groups.items():
        erased = group & rp & ~ep
        erased_overlap = group & ro & ~eo
        remaining = group & ~ao
        has_support = (supportive & t).any(-1)
        values = dict(rays=group, raw_present=group & rp, E_present=group & ep,
                      one_present=group & ap, raw_overlap=group & ro,
                      E_overlap=group & eo, one_overlap=group & ao,
                      raw_present_erased_by_E=erased,
                      erased_presence_restored=erased & ap,
                      erased_presence_restored_with_overlap=erased & ao,
                      raw_overlap_erased_by_E=erased_overlap,
                      erased_overlap_restored=erased_overlap & ao,
                      E_missed_overlap_rescued=group & ~eo & ao,
                      remaining_no_overlap=remaining,
                      remaining_raw_overlap_geometrically_suppressed=remaining & ro,
                      remaining_no_raw_overlap_some_positive_geometry=remaining & ~ro & has_support,
                      remaining_no_raw_overlap_no_positive_geometry=remaining & ~ro & ~has_support)
        # The remaining-ray categories are meaningful only on true rays.
        result.update({f'{name}_{k}': int(v.sum()) for k, v in values.items()})
    return result


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_output(out, truth):
    rebuilt = render(out['raw'], out['lower'], out['upper'], out['log_pres'], out['beta'])
    torch.testing.assert_close(rebuilt, out['rendered'], rtol=0, atol=0)
    changed = intervene(out)
    assert torch.equal(changed[:, 1:], out['raw'][:, 1:])
    assert (changed[:, 0] <= rebuilt[:, 0] + 1e-6).all()
    raw, before, after = (mask(v) for v in (out['raw'], rebuilt, changed))
    # A positive foreground-margin correction means background was lowered.
    supportive = (out['raw'][:, 0] - changed[:, 0] > 0)[0].cpu().numpy()
    return ({'raw_E': score(raw, truth), 'E': score(before, truth),
             'presence_one': score(after, truth)},
            transitions(raw, before, after, truth, supportive))


def summary(rows, diagnostics):
    arms = ('raw_E', 'E', 'presence_one')
    metrics = ('assd_mm', 'union_dice', 'hd95_mm', 'thin_overlap_recall',
               'thin_voxel_recall', 'presence_fp', 'presence_fn', 'fp_voxels',
               'fn_voxels', 'class1_dice', 'class2_dice')
    by_arm = {arm: {r['case']: r for r in rows if r['arm'] == arm} for arm in arms}
    assert all(len(v) == 208 for v in by_arm.values())
    contrasts = {}
    for metric in metrics:
        values = [by_arm['presence_one'][c][metric] - by_arm['E'][c][metric]
                  for c in sorted(by_arm['E']) if by_arm['E'][c][metric] is not None]
        item = paired(values)
        # Avoid the helper's lower-is-better names on recall and Dice.
        item['decreased'] = item.pop('improved')
        item['increased'] = item.pop('worsened')
        contrasts[metric] = item
    def counts(part):
        return {k: sum(r[k] for r in part) for k in part[0] if k not in ('case', 'fold')}
    return dict(cases=208, arms={a: means(list(by_arm[a].values())) for a in arms},
                presence_one_minus_E=contrasts, transition_totals=counts(diagnostics),
                folds={str(f): dict(arms={a: means([r for r in rows if r['fold'] == f and r['arm'] == a])
                                         for a in arms},
                    transition_totals=counts([r for r in diagnostics if r['fold'] == f])) for f in (1,2,3,4)},
                interpretation='One fixed inference intervention, reused internal outer cases; no selection, no retraining. Intervals retain historical presence dependence. Bootstrap conditional on fitted E models.')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('source', 'root', 'pkl', 'splits', 'reference', 'output'):
        parser.add_argument('--' + name, type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify_inputs(args)
    ref = json.loads(args.reference.read_text())
    for name, expected in ref['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(args.source / name) == expected
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.source))
    from thesis.new_constraints.function_head import FunctionConfig
    from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import FullModel, load_weights, plain, split_loaders
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    save_json(args.output / 'provenance.json', provenance(args))
    rows, diagnostics, seen_all = [], [], set()
    device = torch.device('cuda')
    for fold in (1,2,3,4):
        _, _, loader, split = split_loaders(SimpleNamespace(pkl=args.pkl, splits=args.splits,
            fold=fold, inner_seed=0, batch_size=1, run_status='frozen renderer presence-one audit'))
        path = checkpoint(args, fold, 'E')
        before_hash = digest(path)
        model = FullModel(True, FunctionConfig(rescue=False)).to(device)
        load_weights(model, path)
        model.eval().requires_grad_(False)
        reference = json.loads((args.reference.parent / f'fold{fold}_cases.json').read_text())
        expected = {r['case']: r for r in reference if r['arm'] == 'E'}
        seen = set()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in loader:
                case = str(batch['case_name'][0])
                assert case not in seen and case not in seen_all
                seen.add(case)
                truth = batch['label'][0, 0].numpy().astype(np.uint8)
                out = model(plain(batch['image'], device), render=True, warmup=1.)
                results, counts = evaluate_output(out, truth)
                for metric in ('assd_mm', 'union_dice'):
                    assert abs(results['E'][metric] - expected[case][metric]) < 1e-4
                rows.extend(dict(case=case, fold=fold, arm=arm, **value) for arm, value in results.items())
                diagnostics.append(dict(case=case, fold=fold, **counts))
        assert seen == set(split['outer_val']) and len(seen) == 52
        assert digest(path) == before_hash and all(p.grad is None for p in model.parameters())
        seen_all.update(seen)
        save_json(args.output / f'fold{fold}_cases.json', [r for r in rows if r['fold'] == fold])
        save_json(args.output / f'fold{fold}_transitions.json', [r for r in diagnostics if r['fold'] == fold])
        print(json.dumps(dict(fold=fold, cases=len(seen), means={a:means([r for r in rows if r['fold']==fold and r['arm']==a])
                          for a in ('E','presence_one')})), flush=True)
        del model, loader
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    save_json(args.output / 'summary.json', summary(rows, diagnostics))
    save_json(args.output / 'DONE.json', dict(cases=len(seen_all), trained=False, selected=False))
    print('Completed frozen presence-one renderer audit on 208 cases', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Auditable helpers shared by the presence mechanism experiments."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt, label


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def geometry(truth):
    fg = np.asarray(truth) > 0
    z = np.arange(fg.shape[-1])
    count = fg.sum(-1)
    lower = np.where(fg, z, fg.shape[-1]).min(-1)
    upper = np.where(fg, z, -1).max(-1)
    present = count > 0
    span = np.where(present, upper - lower + 1, 0)
    border = present & (fg[..., 0] | fg[..., -1])
    multi = present & (count < span)
    thin = present & (span <= 2) & ~border
    return dict(fg=fg, count=count, lower=lower, upper=upper, present=present,
                span=span, border=border, multi=multi, thin=thin)


def render(raw, lower, upper, log_presence, beta, mode="product", tau=0.5):
    """Original log-space renderer, also usable with detached geometry."""
    z = torch.arange(raw.shape[-1], device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    if mode == "product":
        log_o = (log_presence[..., None]
                 + F.logsigmoid((z - lower[..., None] + .5) / tau)
                 + F.logsigmoid((upper[..., None] - z + .5) / tau))
    elif mode == "distance":
        centre, radius = (upper + lower) / 2, (upper - lower + 1) / 2
        log_o = log_presence[..., None] + F.logsigmoid(
            (radius[..., None] - (z - centre[..., None]).abs()) / tau)
    else:
        raise ValueError(mode)
    logit_o = log_o - torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
    shift = 6 * torch.tanh(logit_o / 6)
    return torch.cat(((raw[:, 0] - beta * shift)[:, None], raw[:, 1:]), 1)


def mask(logits):
    return logits.argmax(1)[0].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.uint8)


def ray_strata(truth, original_e):
    g = geometry(truth)
    s = np.full(g["present"].shape, "empty", dtype="U32")
    s[g["span"] == 1] = "thin1"
    s[g["span"] == 2] = "thin2"
    s[(g["span"] >= 3) & (g["span"] <= 5)] = "length3_5"
    s[g["span"] >= 6] = "length6plus"
    s[g["multi"]] = "multi_run"
    s[g["border"]] = "border"
    present_e = (original_e > 0).any(-1)
    for name in ("thin1", "thin2", "length3_5", "length6plus", "multi_run", "border"):
        chosen = s == name
        s[chosen & present_e] = name + "_E_present"
        s[chosen & ~present_e] = name + "_E_missed"
    return s


def score(pred, truth, strata=None):
    """Match historical surface-voxel ASSD; additionally measure actual overlap."""
    p, g = pred > 0, geometry(truth)
    t = g["fg"]
    pr = p.any(-1)
    overlap = (p & t).any(-1)
    thin = g["thin"]
    nt = int(thin.sum())
    nvox = int(t[thin].sum())
    denom = int(p.sum() + t.sum())
    result = dict(union_dice=float(2 * (p & t).sum() / denom) if denom else 1.,
                  presence_fp=int((pr & ~g["present"]).sum()),
                  presence_fn=int((~pr & g["present"]).sum()),
                  fp_voxels=int((p & ~t).sum()), fn_voxels=int((~p & t).sum()),
                  signed_volume_error_vox=int(p.sum()) - int(t.sum()),
                  thin_rays=nt, thin_voxels=nvox,
                  thin_present=int((pr & thin).sum()),
                  thin_overlap_rays=int((overlap & thin).sum()),
                  thin_true_positive_voxels=int((p & t)[thin].sum()),
                  thin_presence_recall=float((pr & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_overlap_recall=float((overlap & thin).sum()/nt) if nt else None,
                  thin_voxel_recall=float((p & t)[thin].sum()/nvox) if nvox else None,
                  fp_components=int(label(p & ~t)[1]))
    for cls in (1, 2):
        pc, tc = pred == cls, truth == cls
        n = pc.sum() + tc.sum()
        result[f"class{cls}_dice"] = float(2*(pc & tc).sum()/n) if n else 1.
    pg = geometry(pred)
    both = pr & g["present"]
    errors = (abs(pg["lower"] - g["lower"]) + abs(pg["upper"] - g["upper"])) / 2
    result["conditional_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both].mean()) if both.any() else None
    result["conditional_thin_edge_mae"] = float(errors[both & thin].mean()) if (both & thin).any() else None
    if not p.any() or not t.any():
        penalty = float(np.linalg.norm(pred.shape)) if p.any() != t.any() else 0.
        result.update(assd_mm=penalty, hd95_mm=penalty, p_to_t_mm=penalty, t_to_p_mm=penalty)
        for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
            result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = 0. if t.any() else None
        result["surface_contributions"] = {"empty_mask_penalty": penalty}
        return result
    ps, ts = p ^ binary_erosion(p), t ^ binary_erosion(t)
    pd = distance_transform_edt(~ts)[ps]
    td = distance_transform_edt(~ps)[ts]
    assd = (float(pd.mean()) + float(td.mean())) / 2
    result.update(assd_mm=assd, hd95_mm=float(np.percentile(np.r_[pd, td], 95)),
                  p_to_t_mm=float(pd.mean()), t_to_p_mm=float(td.mean()))
    for tolerance in (0, 1, 2):
        result[f"reference_coverage_{tolerance}mm"] = float((td <= tolerance).mean())
    if strata is not None:
        volume_strata = np.broadcast_to(strata[..., None], p.shape)
        p_names, t_names = volume_strata[ps], volume_strata[ts]
        contributions = {}
        for name in np.unique(strata):
            a = float(pd[p_names == name].sum() / len(pd) / 2)
            b = float(td[t_names == name].sum() / len(td) / 2)
            contributions[str(name)] = dict(p_to_t=a, t_to_p=b, total=a+b)
        if not np.isclose(sum(x["total"] for x in contributions.values()), assd, atol=1e-10):
            raise AssertionError("Surface contribution decomposition does not sum to ASSD")
        result["surface_contributions"] = contributions
    return result


def means(rows):
    return {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows if r.get(key) is not None]))
            for key in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][key], (int, float)) or rows[0][key] is None
            if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in rows)}


def paired(values, seed=0):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = [float(rng.choice(values, size=len(values), replace=True).mean()) for _ in range(3000)]
    return dict(mean=float(values.mean()), median=float(np.median(values)),
                ci95_conditional_case_bootstrap=np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5]).tolist(),
                improved=int((values < 0).sum()), worsened=int((values > 0).sum()), n=len(values))


def verify_inputs(args):

import numpy as np
import torch

from common import render
from audit_renderer_presence_one import intervene, transitions, evaluate_output


def test_original_equivalence_and_monotone_presence_intervention():
    torch.manual_seed(4)
    raw = torch.randn(1, 3, 2, 3, 8)
    lower = torch.ones(1, 2, 3) * 2
    upper = lower + 2
    lp = torch.full_like(lower, -1.)
    beta = torch.tensor(1.2)
    out = dict(raw=raw, lower=lower, upper=upper, log_pres=lp, beta=beta)
    out['rendered'] = render(raw, lower, upper, lp, beta)
    snapshots = {k:v.clone() for k,v in out.items()}
    truth = np.zeros((2,3,8), dtype=np.uint8)
    truth[:, :, 3] = 1
    _, diag = evaluate_output(out, truth)
    assert diag['newly_deleted_true_voxels'] == 0
    assert torch.equal(intervene(out)[:,1:], raw[:,1:])
    for k,v in snapshots.items():
        assert torch.equal(out[k], v)


def test_one_voxel_rescue_and_misplaced_interval_still_suppresses():
    raw = torch.zeros(1,3,1,2,7)
    raw[:,1:] = -5
    raw[:,1,:,:,3] = .1
    lower = torch.tensor([[[3., 0.]]])
    lp = torch.full_like(lower, np.log(.5))
    out = dict(raw=raw, lower=lower, upper=lower, log_pres=lp, beta=torch.tensor(1.))
    out['rendered'] = render(raw, lower, lower, lp, out['beta'])
    changed = intervene(out).argmax(1)
    assert out['rendered'].argmax(1)[0,0,0,3] == 0
    assert changed[0,0,0,3] == 1
    assert changed[0,0,1,3] == 0


def test_restored_presence_is_not_necessarily_true_overlap():
    truth = np.zeros((1,3,7),dtype=np.uint8)
    truth[0,:2,3] = 1
    raw = truth.copy()
    before = np.zeros_like(truth)
    after = before.copy()
    after[0,0,2] = 1  # Returns to the ray, but misses its true voxel.
    after[0,1,3] = 1
    after[0,2,3] = 1  # Empty-ray false positive.
    diag = transitions(raw,before,after,truth,np.zeros_like(truth,dtype=bool))
    assert diag['thin_erased_presence_restored'] == 2
    assert diag['thin_erased_presence_restored_with_overlap'] == 1
    assert diag['thin_remaining_raw_overlap_geometrically_suppressed'] == 1
    assert diag['added_fp_voxels'] == 2
    assert diag['empty_one_present'] == 1

# Frozen fitting-only renderer-state overfit comparison

Written before training. This is a diagnostic of learning on fitting examples,
not a candidate model-selection or generalization experiment.

Use the first four sorted fitting case identifiers from each existing fold.
Do not choose cases by performance, rescue feasibility or observed loss. Record
the chosen identifiers only on the cluster and export a subset hash/count.
No inner or outer images are inferred or evaluated. Freeze original E entirely.

Fit two matched arms from E's original residual initialization, with width 24
and unchanged z mean pooling. Both allocate 13 stem input channels, the same
weights and exactly zero initial correction. Copy the original seven-channel
weights and initialize six additional input-channel weights to zero. The
original-input control receives zeros in those six channels. The state arm
receives frozen, prediction-only channels:

1. Original presence-logit anchor / 8, broadcast along z.
2. Signed lower-edge offset `(z-lower+0.5)/4`.
3. Signed upper-edge offset `(upper-z+0.5)/4`.
4. Raw three-class argmax margin `(max(fg logits)-bg logit)/8`.
5. E-rendered three-class argmax margin / 8.
6. Renderer beta / 2, broadcast spatially.

Clamp all six channels to [-4,4]. Ground-truth labels, feasible intervals and
ray groups never construct input features. Both arms have identical allocated
parameter counts; extra-channel weights are inactive in the zero-input control.
Thus this tests access to renderer information through additional active input
connections, not a perfectly equal effective-capacity claim. Width is unchanged.

Keep the existing bounded correction, product renderer, fixed geometry and
fitting-only interval target/loss including group balancing and 0.01 tie term.
For this overfit diagnostic use unscaled interval loss, AdamW lr=3e-4,
weight_decay=0 and default betas/epsilon. These settings are identical between
arms but differ from the earlier full fitting experiment; do not attribute a
cross-experiment change solely to input features.

Three head-fitting seeds per fold, one full cached case per update, matching
case permutations between arms. Run exactly 1,024 updates (256 passes over four
cases), reporting steps 0,128,512,1024. Step 1024 is primary; no checkpoint
selection, early stopping, learning-rate sweep or adaptive extension. There
are 24 fits. Original E weights and prior head checkpoints remain unchanged.

Primary diagnostic: learned fitting objective versus the representable best
constant and paired state-versus-control objectives at step 1024. Report all
fold/seed outcomes and intermediate curves. Meaningful selective fitting also
requires increased thin overlap/voxel recall without increased mean FP rays,
FP voxels or additional true-foreground deletions relative to E. Report
correction distributions, rescue-relevant AUROC, feasible-ray interval
violations, actual recovered/deleted true voxels and both FP burdens. AUC alone
is not a success criterion. Constants are optimized on the same four cases;
they are diagnostic comparators, not deployable selections. ASSD is not the
target of this fitting-only test and is not recomputed.

Predictions and falsification:

- If explicit-state inputs are limiting, the state arm should fit the interval
  target and selective corrections materially better than its matched control.
  Equal failure weakens this specific feature-access explanation.
- If original inputs already suffice for fitting under longer optimization,
  the control should beat its constant and learn selective edits too. This
  weakens the claim that adding renderer-state inputs is necessary.
- If objectives fall but FP/retention tradeoffs remain, fitting the current
  objective is insufficient; do not promote either arm on loss alone.
- Failure after 1,024 updates does not prove that either function class cannot
  fit the examples. Optimization, target conflicts, feature normalization and
  pooling still need discrimination before a capacity claim.

Verify feature construction, initial equality, matched parameter counts,
nonzero gradient access through state channels, and unchanged E in tests.
Write only new small-head weights and numerical results on the cluster. Export
non-identifying aggregates only, following the user's authorized audit-report
workflow. Any future held-out evaluation needs a separately frozen protocol.

class RendererStateProbe(PresenceProbe):
    """Both arms allocate identical weights; control extras receive zeros."""
    def __init__(self, original, seed=0):
        super().__init__(original,24,'mean',seed)
        old=self.stem[0]
        layer=torch.nn.Conv2d(13,24,3,padding=1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            layer.weight.zero_()
            layer.weight[:,:7].copy_(old.weight)
            layer.bias.copy_(old.bias)
        self.stem[0]=layer
        self.initial_stem=copy.deepcopy(self.stem).requires_grad_(False)


@torch.no_grad()
def renderer_inputs(case, enabled):
    """Uses frozen predictions only. No truth, target, or group access."""
    inputs=case['inputs'].float()
    raw=case['raw'][0].float()
    shape=raw.shape[1:]
    if not enabled:
        return torch.cat((inputs,torch.zeros((shape[0],6,shape[1],shape[2]),dtype=inputs.dtype)),1)
    z=torch.arange(shape[-1],dtype=torch.float32)
    anchor=case['anchor'].float()[...,None].expand(shape)
    lower=case['lower'][0].float()[...,None]
    upper=case['upper'][0].float()[...,None]
    beta=case['beta'].float()
    raw_margin=raw[1:].amax(0)-raw[0]
    log_o=(torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid(anchor)
           +torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid((z-lower+.5)/.5)
           +torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid((upper-z+.5)/.5))
    occupancy_logit=log_o-torch.log(-torch.expm1(log_o.clamp(max=-1e-7)))
    final_margin=raw_margin+beta*6*torch.tanh(occupancy_logit/6)
    channels=(anchor/8,(z-lower+.5).expand(shape)/4,(upper-z+.5).expand(shape)/4,
              raw_margin/8,final_margin/8,beta.expand(shape)/2)
    extra=torch.stack(channels,1).clamp(-4,4)
    assert extra.shape==(shape[0],6,shape[1],shape[2]) and torch.isfinite(extra).all()
    return torch.cat((inputs,extra),1)


@torch.no_grad()
def assess(probe,cases,device):
    probe.eval()
    deltas=[bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(c,device)).cpu().numpy() for c in cases]
    controls=fit_constants(cases,deltas,'interval')
    return dict(controls=controls,diagnostics=diagnostics(cases,deltas,controls,device))


def fit_one(original,cases,enabled,seed,device,dest):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if device.type=='cuda':
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    probe=RendererStateProbe(original,seed).to(device)
    prepared=[dict(c,inputs=renderer_inputs(c,enabled)) for c in cases]
    for c in prepared:
        with torch.no_grad():
            assert bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(c,device)).eq(0).all()
    optimizer=torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in probe.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                               lr=3e-4,weight_decay=0.)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    history={"0":assess(probe,prepared,device)}
    step=0
    while step<STEPS[-1]:
        for index in rng.permutation(len(prepared)):
            c=prepared[int(index)]
            probe.train()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            delta=bounded_delta(probe,*tensors(c,device))
            target={k:v.to(device) for k,v in c['diagnostic_targets'].items()}
            loss=interval_loss(delta,target,tuple(g.to(device) for g in c['groups']))
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
                raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite overfit loss')
            loss.backward()
            if not all(torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in probe.parameters() if p.grad is not None):
                raise FloatingPointError('Nonfinite overfit gradient')
            optimizer.step()
            step+=1
            if step in STEPS:
                history[str(step)]=assess(probe,prepared,device)
                print(json.dumps(dict(renderer_state=enabled,seed=seed,step=step,
                    fit_objective=history[str(step)]['controls']['objective_learned'],
                    constant_objective=history[str(step)]['controls']['objective_optimal_constant'])),flush=True)
            if step==STEPS[-1]:
                break
    dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    torch.save(dict(state={k:v.detach().cpu() for k,v in probe.state_dict().items()}),dest/'final.pt')
    return dict(history=history,parameter_count=sum(p.numel() for p in probe.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                final_sha256=digest(dest/'final.pt'))


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('source','root','pkl','splits','reference','output'):
        parser.add_argument('--'+name,type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    verify_inputs(args)
    ref=json.loads(args.reference.read_text())
    for name,sha in ref['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(args.source/name)==sha
    sys.path.insert(0,str(args.source))
    from thesis.new_constraints.train_function_head import plain
    device=torch.device('cuda')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    records={}
    for fold in (1,2,3,4):
        fit_loader,_,_,split=get_loaders(args,fold)
        chosen=sorted(split['fit'])[:4]
        model=frozen_model(args,fold,device)
        original=copy.deepcopy(model.function.residual).cpu()
        selected_batches=(b for b in fit_loader if str(b['case_name'][0]) in chosen)
        cases=collect(model,selected_batches,device,plain)
        assert {c['case'] for c in cases}==set(chosen)
        prepare_targets(cases,device)
        subset_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(chosen).encode()).hexdigest()
        # Only this on-cluster provenance file has case identifiers.
        save_json(args.output/f'fold{fold}_subset.json',chosen)
        for seed in (0,1,2):
            for enabled in (False,True):
                arm='renderer_state' if enabled else 'original_inputs'
                key=f'{arm}_fold{fold}_seed{seed}'
                result=fit_one(original,cases,enabled,seed,device,args.output/key)
                records[key]=dict(fold=fold,seed=seed,arm=arm,fitting_cases=4,subset_sha256=subset_hash,**result)
                save_json(args.output/'aggregates.json',records)
        assert all(p.grad is None for p in model.parameters())
        del model,original,cases,fit_loader
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    save_json(args.output/'DONE.json',dict(fits=len(records),inner_evaluated=False,outer_evaluated=False,
        source_sha256=ref['source_sha256'],audit_sha256=digest(Path(__file__))))
    print('Completed 24 fitting-only overfit comparisons',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Submit from the cluster checkout:
#   sbatch scripts/run_nnunet_cluster.sh
#
# Runs the archived MSD fold 0 (208 train / 52 validation) used by SwinUNETR
# for at most 50 epochs. Validation-Dice early stopping is implemented by
# nnUNetTrainer_50epochsEarlyStopping.
#SBATCH --job-name=nnunet-msd-es
#SBATCH --partition=stud
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=6
#SBATCH --mem=64G
#SBATCH --time=08:00:00
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%x-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=slurm-%x-%j.err

set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  sbatch scripts/run_nnunet_cluster.sh [options]

Options:
  --dataset NAME       Dataset folder (default: Dataset101_MSD)
  --fold N             Existing CV fold (default: 0)
  --env-name NAME      Conda environment (default: hippocampus)
  --run-root PATH      Persistent run directory
  -h, --help           Show this help
EOF
}

if [[ -n "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}" && pwd)"
else
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
fi

DATASET="Dataset101_MSD"
FOLD="0"
ENV_NAME="hippocampus"
RUN_ROOT=""
TRAINER="nnUNetTrainer_50epochsEarlyStopping"

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --dataset) DATASET="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --fold) FOLD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --env-name) ENV_NAME="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-root) RUN_ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "[ERROR] Unknown option: $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

if [[ -z "${RUN_ROOT}" ]]; then
  RUN_BASE="${NNUNET_RUN_BASE:-$(dirname "${REPO_ROOT}")/hippopotamus_runs}"
  RUN_ROOT="${RUN_BASE}/nnunet_${DATASET}_fold${FOLD}_es50_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-local}"
fi

if ! command -v conda >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[ERROR] conda is not on PATH." >&2
  exit 1
fi
CONDA_BASE="$(conda info --base)"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${CONDA_BASE}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda activate "${ENV_NAME}"

export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-6}"
export nnUNet_compile="false"

echo "[INFO] host=$(hostname), job=${SLURM_JOB_ID:-local}, gpu=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-unset}"
echo "[INFO] repo_root=${REPO_ROOT}"
echo "[INFO] run_root=${RUN_ROOT}"
echo "[INFO] dataset=${DATASET}, existing_fold=${FOLD}, trainer=${TRAINER}"

python - <<'PY'
import sys
import torch

print(f"[INFO] python={sys.version.split()[0]}, torch={torch.__version__}, cuda={torch.cuda.is_available()}")
if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    raise RuntimeError("No CUDA device is visible. Submit with --gres=gpu:1.")
print(f"[INFO] gpu_name={torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
PY

if ! command -v nnUNetv2_train >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[INFO] Installing the vendored nnU-Net package into ${ENV_NAME}"
  python -m pip install -e "${REPO_ROOT}/baselines/nnUNet"
fi

DATASET_ID="$(echo "${DATASET}" | sed -E 's/^Dataset([0-9]+)_.+$/\1/')"
SOURCE_DATASET_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/datasets/${DATASET}"
SOURCE_SPLITS="${SOURCE_DATASET_DIR}/splits_final.json"
RAW_ROOT="${RUN_ROOT}/datasets"
PREPROC_ROOT="${RUN_ROOT}/preprocessed"
RESULTS_ROOT="${RUN_ROOT}/results"
RAW_DATASET_DIR="${RAW_ROOT}/${DATASET}"

if [[ ! -f "${SOURCE_SPLITS}" ]]; then
  echo "[ERROR] Existing split file not found: ${SOURCE_SPLITS}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python - "${SOURCE_SPLITS}" "${FOLD}" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

splits = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
fold = int(sys.argv[2])
split = splits[fold]
if len(split["train"]) != 208 or len(split["val"]) != 52:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected archived 208/52 split for fold {fold}, got "
        f"{len(split['train'])}/{len(split['val'])}"
    )
if set(split["train"]) & set(split["val"]):
    raise RuntimeError("Train/validation overlap in archived split")
print(f"[INFO] verified archived split fold {fold}: 208 train / 52 validation")
PY

mkdir -p "${RAW_ROOT}" "${PREPROC_ROOT}" "${RESULTS_ROOT}"
if [[ -e "${RAW_DATASET_DIR}" ]]; then
  echo "[ERROR] Fresh run directory expected, but dataset staging path exists: ${RAW_DATASET_DIR}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "${RAW_DATASET_DIR}"
cp -a "${SOURCE_DATASET_DIR}/." "${RAW_DATASET_DIR}/"
find "${RAW_DATASET_DIR}" -type f -name '._*' -delete

export nnUNet_raw="${RAW_ROOT}"
export nnUNet_preprocessed="${PREPROC_ROOT}"
export nnUNet_results="${RESULTS_ROOT}"

nnUNetv2_plan_and_preprocess -d "${DATASET_ID}" --verify_dataset_integrity
cp "${SOURCE_SPLITS}" "${PREPROC_ROOT}/${DATASET}/splits_final.json"
nnUNetv2_train "${DATASET_ID}" 3d_fullres "${FOLD}" -tr "${TRAINER}"

MODEL_DIR="${RESULTS_ROOT}/${DATASET}/${TRAINER}__nnUNetPlans__3d_fullres/fold_${FOLD}"

# Preserve the validation produced from the stopping checkpoint, then evaluate
# checkpoint_best.pth on the same validation cases. This makes any degradation
# between the best epoch and the stopping epoch directly visible.
if [[ -f "${MODEL_DIR}/validation/summary.json" ]]; then
  cp "${MODEL_DIR}/validation/summary.json" "${MODEL_DIR}/validation_final_summary.json"
fi
nnUNetv2_train "${DATASET_ID}" 3d_fullres "${FOLD}" -tr "${TRAINER}" --val --val_best
if [[ -f "${MODEL_DIR}/validation/summary.json" ]]; then
  cp "${MODEL_DIR}/validation/summary.json" "${MODEL_DIR}/validation_best_summary.json"
fi

python "${REPO_ROOT}/evaluation/summarize_nnunet_training.py" \
  --model-dir "${MODEL_DIR}" \
  --output "${RUN_ROOT}/training_summary.json"

echo "[DONE] run_root=${RUN_ROOT}"
echo "[DONE] summary=${RUN_ROOT}/training_summary.json"
